attributes.name: accumulation_area_type
attributes.description: Classification of the on-site hazardous waste accumulation area based on RCRA generator category and applicable time limits. LQGs may accumulate up to 90 days; SQGs up to 180 days (or 270 days in rural areas); VSQGs have no time limit but volume limits apply. Satellite areas are small accumulation points feeding a central accumulation area.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262 Subparts Aa, Bb, Cc; EPA Generator Improvements Rule

attributes.name: biennial_report_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the next EPA Biennial Hazardous Waste Report submission. Required for LQGs in even-numbered years under RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.41. Tracks compliance calendar obligations for large quantity generators.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.41; EPA Biennial Hazardous Waste Report

attributes.name: contingency_plan_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a RCRA-compliant emergency contingency plan is on file for this generator. LQGs are required to maintain a formal contingency plan under 40 CFR Part 262.261; SQGs must have an emergency plan. Critical for compliance verification and emergency response readiness.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste generator profile record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements under RCRA and SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; RCRA Recordkeeping Requirements; ISO 14001

attributes.name: e_manifest_registered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this generator is registered in the EPA's national e-Manifest system for electronic hazardous waste tracking. The e-Manifest system replaced paper manifests and is operated by the EPA under RCRA authority.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart B; EPA e-Manifest (RCRAInfo)

attributes.name: emergency_coordinator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated emergency coordinator responsible for implementing the contingency plan and coordinating emergency response at the generator site. Required to be listed in the contingency plan and available to local emergency responders under RCRA.

attributes.name: emergency_coordinator_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour contact phone number for the designated emergency coordinator at the generator site. Must be posted at the facility and provided to local emergency response agencies as required under RCRA contingency plan regulations.

attributes.name: estimated_hazardous_volume_kg_per_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Hazardous Waste Volume (Kilograms per Month)
attributes.description: Estimated monthly generation quantity of RCRA-regulated hazardous waste in kilograms. This is the primary metric used to classify the generator into VSQG (≤100 kg), SQG (100–999 kg), or LQG (≥1,000 kg) categories and must be re-evaluated whenever operations change.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.13; EPA Generator Improvements Rule

attributes.name: estimated_monthly_volume_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Monthly Waste Volume (Tons Per Day equivalent, monthly)
attributes.description: Estimated total waste generation volume per month expressed in short tons. Used to determine and validate RCRA generator category (VSQG/SQG/LQG), plan collection frequency, and support TPD (Tons Per Day) capacity planning for routing and disposal.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.13; EPA Generator Category Thresholds

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of EPA hazardous waste codes (e.g., D001, F003, U080) applicable to the waste streams generated at this site as determined by TCLP (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure) testing or listed waste classification. Required for manifest preparation and RCRA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261 Subparts C and D; EPA Hazardous Waste Codes

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent regulatory inspection at this generator site. Significant violations may trigger enforcement actions, fines, or mandatory corrective measures under RCRA or CERCLA authority.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; EPA RCRA Compliance Monitoring; CERCLA

attributes.name: last_biennial_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent EPA Biennial Hazardous Waste Report was submitted for this generator. Used to verify compliance with LQG biennial reporting obligations and to support audit documentation.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.41; EPA Biennial Hazardous Waste Report

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory compliance inspection conducted at this generator site by the EPA, state environmental agency, or Local Enforcement Agency (LEA). Used to track inspection history and assess compliance standing.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; CERCLA; State Environmental Quality Departments; LEA

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this waste generator profile record in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; RCRA Recordkeeping Requirements; ISO 14001

attributes.name: last_notification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent RCRA Site ID notification update submitted to the EPA or authorized state agency. Generators must re-notify when their generator category changes, when they begin generating new hazardous waste streams, or when site information changes.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.18; EPA Generator Improvements Rule (2016)

attributes.name: manifest_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this generator is required to use a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest (EPA Form 8700-22) for off-site shipments of hazardous waste. Mandatory for SQGs and LQGs; VSQGs are exempt from manifest requirements under 40 CFR Part 262.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart B; EPA e-Manifest System

attributes.name: max_accumulation_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days this generator is permitted to accumulate hazardous waste on-site before it must be shipped to a TSDF, as determined by generator category and applicable RCRA regulations. Exceeding this limit triggers LQG-level requirements or potential RCRA violation.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.17 (LQG); 40 CFR Part 262.16 (SQG); EPA Generator Improvements Rule

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code representing the primary industry classification of the waste-generating facility. Used by EPA and state agencies to categorize generator type, assess typical waste streams, and benchmark regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; U.S. Census Bureau NAICS

attributes.name: next_notification_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the next required RCRA notification or re-notification. LQGs must notify every four years under the 2016 Generator Improvements Rule. Used by compliance teams to proactively manage regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.18(d); EPA Generator Improvements Rule (2016)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers and environmental managers to record supplementary information about the generator's regulatory status, special handling requirements, enforcement history, or operational context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS; SAP S/4HANA EHS Module

attributes.name: open_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this generator currently has one or more open, unresolved regulatory violations on record with the EPA or state environmental agency. Triggers enhanced compliance monitoring and may affect service agreements and manifest acceptance.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; EPA Enforcement and Compliance Assurance; CERCLA

attributes.name: personnel_training_current_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personnel Hazardous Waste Training Current Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all relevant facility personnel have completed current RCRA hazardous waste management training as required for the generator's category. LQGs must provide formal classroom or on-the-job training; SQGs must ensure familiarity with emergency procedures.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.17(a)(7) (LQG); 40 CFR Part 262.16(b)(9) (SQG); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: profile_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this waste generator regulatory profile is considered valid and active. Represents the start of the current regulatory classification period, which may be triggered by initial registration, a generator category change, or a site re-notification.

attributes.name: profile_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this waste generator regulatory profile expires or must be renewed. Applicable when state permits or generator registrations have fixed validity periods. Null for open-ended federal EPA registrations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 262.18; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: rcra_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Notification Date
attributes.description: Date on which the generator submitted the initial RCRA Site Identification (Site ID) notification to the EPA or authorized state agency, establishing the generator's regulatory identity and obligations. Required under 40 CFR Part 262.18.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Legal or operating name of the waste-generating facility or site as registered with the EPA and state environmental agency. May differ from the customer account name if the customer operates multiple sites.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this waste generator profile was originated or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Enviance EHS, SAP S/4HANA EHS module, EPA RCRAInfo, Salesforce CRM, and Waste Logics.
attributes.references: Enviance EHS; SAP S/4HANA EHS; EPA RCRAInfo; Salesforce CRM; Waste Logics

attributes.name: source_system_profile_reference

attributes.references: Enviance EHS; SAP S/4HANA EHS; EPA RCRAInfo

attributes.name: state_permit_number

attributes.references: RCRA State Authorization 40 CFR Part 271; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: state_program_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the RCRA-authorized state program under which this generator is regulated. In RCRA-authorized states, the state program operates in lieu of the federal program; in non-authorized states, the EPA directly administers RCRA.

attributes.name: universal_waste_handler_flag

attributes.name: complaint_description

attributes.name: complaint_number

attributes.name: complaint_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_amount_usd

attributes.name: credit_issued_flag

attributes.name: escalation_reason

Class A for combination vehicles over 26,001 lbs, Class B for single vehicles over 26,001 lbs, Class C for vehicles designed to transport 16+ passengers or hazardous materials.
attributes.references: DOT Commercial Driver License Standards 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: cdl_endorsements_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CDL endorsements required for the assignment. Common endorsements include H (Hazardous Materials), N (Tank Vehicle), P (Passenger), S (School Bus), T (Double/Triple Trailers). Empty if no special endorsements required.
attributes.references: DOT Commercial Driver License Standards 49 CFR Part 383

attributes.name: dispatch_sequence
attributes.description: The sequential order in which this driver assignment was dispatched from the depot on the service date. Used for operational tracking and first-out/last-in analysis.

attributes.name: dot_hos_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hours-of-Service (HOS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the driver assignment complies with DOT hours-of-service regulations at the time of assignment. True indicates the driver has sufficient available hours and rest periods to legally execute the route, false indicates a compliance violation or risk.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: estimated_route_duration_hours
attributes.description: The estimated total duration in hours required to complete the assigned route execution, including driving time, service stops, and breaks. Used for scheduling and DOT hours-of-service compliance planning.

attributes.name: helper_assigned_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a helper (second crew member) is assigned to assist the driver on this route execution. True indicates a two-person crew, false indicates solo driver operation. Common for residential rear-loader routes and heavy commercial pickups.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route type that the driver is assigned to execute. Residential for curbside household collection, commercial for business waste pickup, roll_off for large container haul, recycling for materials recovery collection, hazardous for special waste handling.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the driver is assigned to execute the route. This is the business event date for the assignment and the primary date dimension for operational reporting.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: The scheduled timestamp when the driver is expected to complete their shift and return to the depot. Used for workforce scheduling and DOT hours-of-service compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: The scheduled timestamp when the driver is expected to begin their shift and commence route execution. Used for workforce scheduling and Department of Transportation (DOT) hours-of-service compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT Hours of Service Regulations 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this driver assignment record. Locus_dispatch for automated dispatch assignments, workday_hcm for workforce management initiated assignments, manual_entry for dispatcher-created assignments.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique record identifier from the source operational system (Locus Dispatch or Workday HCM). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation with source systems.

products.name: truck_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the assignment of a specific collection vehicle (ASL, FEL, REL, roll-off, CNG/RNG unit) to a route execution on a given service date. Records vehicle ID, route execution reference, truck type, fuel type (diesel, CNG, RNG), odometer at assignment, pre-trip inspection pass/fail, assigned capacity (cubic yards), and assignment status. Sourced from AMCS Platform and Geotab Fleet Telematics. Distinct from driver_assignment — a truck and driver are assigned independently and may change mid-route.
products.reference: AMCS Vehicle Assignment / Geotab Asset Assignment

attributes.name: truck_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the truck assignment record. Primary key for this transactional entity capturing the assignment of a collection vehicle to a route execution on a specific service date.

attributes.name: inspection_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: truck_assignment records pre-trip and post-trip inspection statuses. When an inspection fails, a maintenance work order is generated to remediate the defect before dispatch. This link enables DOT comp

attributes.name: pre_post_trip_inspection_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre Post Trip Inspection Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.pre_post_trip_inspection. Business justification: DOT FMCSA mandates linking vehicle assignments to actual inspection records. pre_trip_inspection_status/timestamp and post_trip_inspection_status/timestamp on truck_assignment are denormalized from pr

attributes.name: primary_truck_dispatch_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or yard from which the truck was dispatched for this route execution. Typically a collection operations center, transfer station, or regional depot.

attributes.name: route_execution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific route execution instance that this truck is assigned to perform. Links to the route_execution transactional record.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection vehicle (truck) assigned to this route execution. Links to the fleet vehicle master record.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the truck completed the route execution and returned to the facility or disposal site. Captured from Geotab GPS tracking or driver mobile app check-out.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the truck departed the facility or yard to begin route execution. Captured from Geotab GPS tracking or driver mobile app check-in.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for this truck assignment, typically formatted as a combination of date, route, and sequence number for operational tracking and dispatch communication.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification for this truck assignment. Emergency assignments for service failures or complaints; special event for large-scale temporary collections; routine for standard scheduled service.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the truck assignment. Tracks progression from initial scheduling through dispatch, execution, and completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the truck was assigned to the route execution. Represents the business event time when dispatch confirmed the vehicle-to-route pairing.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the truck assignment was cancelled before or during execution. Captures operational context for weather delays, vehicle failures, route cancellations, or customer service suspensions.

attributes.name: capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Rated capacity of the assigned truck in cubic yards. Represents the maximum volume of waste the vehicle can carry per load, used for route optimization and load planning.

attributes.name: capacity_tons
attributes.description: Rated weight capacity of the assigned truck in tons. Represents the maximum weight the vehicle can legally and safely carry, constrained by DOT regulations and vehicle GVWR.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this truck assignment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation, distinct from the business assignment timestamp.

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental incident occurred during this truck assignment. True if a spill, leak, unauthorized discharge, or EPA-reportable event was logged during route execution.
attributes.references: EPA CERCLA and RCRA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel or energy source for the assigned vehicle. CNG (Compressed Natural Gas), RNG (Renewable Natural Gas), diesel, electric, or hybrid powertrain. Critical for sustainability reporting and GHG emissions tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Fuel Standards

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time GPS tracking was active for this truck assignment. True if Geotab telematics was operational and transmitting location data during route execution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this truck assignment record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking updates to assignment status, times, or other attributes throughout the assignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments related to this truck assignment. Captures dispatcher instructions, driver feedback, route conditions, or any contextual information relevant to the assignment execution.

attributes.name: odometer_end
attributes.description: Odometer reading in miles at the time the truck completed the route execution and returned. Used to calculate route mileage and update vehicle lifecycle metrics.

attributes.name: odometer_start
attributes.description: Odometer reading in miles at the time the truck was assigned and departed for route execution. Used for mileage tracking, fuel efficiency analysis, and preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: reassignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the truck was reassigned during route execution. Captures operational context for vehicle breakdowns, driver changes, route adjustments, or emergency redeployment.

attributes.name: route_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the truck deviated from the planned route during execution. True if GPS tracking detected significant off-route travel, triggering operational review or customer service follow-up.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety incident occurred during this truck assignment. True if an accident, injury, near-miss, or OSHA-reportable event was logged during route execution.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the truck is scheduled to begin the route execution. Used for dispatch planning and driver coordination.

attributes.name: truck_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collection vehicle by body configuration and loading mechanism. ASL (Automated Side Loader), FEL (Front End Loader), REL (Rear End Loader), roll-off for container hauling, compactor for transfer operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASL|FEL|REL|roll_off|compactor|hook_lift|grapple|flatbed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: service_schedule
products.description: Master record defining the recurring service schedule for a customer stop — the days of week, frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, on-call), effective date range, and service windows. Captures customer account reference, stop reference, service frequency code, scheduled days of week, start date, end date, holiday handling rule, and schedule status. Sourced from Waste Logics and AMCS Platform. SSOT for when a customer is supposed to receive service — distinct from route_stop_sequence which defines the order within a route.
products.reference: Waste Logics Service Schedule / AMCS Service Frequency

attributes.name: service_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: container_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.container_type. Business justification: Service schedules specify container type for capacity planning, vehicle routing, and pricing. The canonical container type catalog governs lift compatibility and maintenance intervals. Replaces denorm

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owns this service schedule. Links to the customer account master record.

attributes.name: frequency_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.frequency_plan. Business justification: Schedules reference standardized frequency plans (weekly, bi-weekly, on-demand) for consistent service delivery. Critical for route optimization, capacity planning, customer contract fulfillment, and

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Service schedules define recurring delivery of specific offerings to customers. Essential for subscription management, automated billing, contract fulfillment tracking, and service level agreement enf

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.recycling_program. Business justification: A service schedule for recycling collection fulfills a specific recycling program. Program compliance reporting, diversion target tracking, and schedule management all require knowing which recycling

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: State and local regulations mandate minimum collection frequencies for certain waste streams (e.g., weekly MSW collection, monthly hazardous waste pickup). Linking service_schedule to the governing re

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.route. Business justification: A service_schedule defines the recurring service schedule for a customer stop and must be associated with the route that services it. service_schedule has collection_stop_id -> collection_stop (and co

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service address where collection occurs. Links to the service address master record.

attributes.name: service_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_service_commitment. Business justification: Service schedules operationalize contract service commitments — the commitment defines what is contracted (frequency, container type, waste stream); the schedule is the operational implementation. Thi

attributes.name: service_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_enrollment. Business justification: Service schedules are operationalized from service enrollments. Billing reconciliation and SLA tracking require tracing each scheduled pickup back to the enrollment that contracted it. A waste managem

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.sla_definition. Business justification: Service schedules are governed by SLA definitions specifying on-time targets, service windows, and missed-pickup credit rules. Auto-credit triggering and SLA compliance reporting require this direct l

attributes.name: sla_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA governing this service schedule. Defines performance commitments, response times, and service guarantees.

attributes.name: stop_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection stop associated with this schedule. Links to the stop master record.

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Service schedules for hazmat generators must be validated against the approved waste profile to enforce container type, service frequency, and handling requirements. Profile expiration dates must trig

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.waste_stream. Business justification: Service schedules are waste-stream-specific — a customer may have separate schedules for recycling, MSW, and organics. Diversion reporting, billing, and route assignment all depend on waste stream at

attributes.name: access_requirements
attributes.description: Special access conditions required to service this stop. Used for driver preparation and route planning.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule automatically renews at the end of its term. True if the schedule continues indefinitely unless cancelled.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the customer is billed for this scheduled service. May differ from service frequency.

attributes.name: container_quantity
attributes.description: Number of containers serviced at this stop per scheduled pickup. Used for capacity planning and billing calculations.

attributes.name: container_size
attributes.description: Capacity of the container in cubic yards or gallons, depending on container type. Used for capacity planning and billing.

attributes.name: container_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the container size. Standardizes capacity reporting across different container types.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this service schedule expires or is terminated. Nullable for open-ended schedules. Marks the end of the schedule validity period.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this service schedule becomes active and service delivery begins. Marks the beginning of the schedule validity period.

attributes.name: external_schedule_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier from the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: friday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Fridays. True if Friday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: holiday_handling_rule
attributes.description: Defines how service is adjusted when a scheduled day falls on a recognized holiday. Determines whether service is skipped, rescheduled, or delivered as normal.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service schedule record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: monday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Mondays. True if Monday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for service delivery. High and critical priorities receive preferential routing and must-complete status.

attributes.name: route_assignment_method
attributes.description: Method used to assign this schedule to collection routes. Fixed schedules are always on the same route; dynamic schedules are optimized daily.

attributes.name: saturday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Saturdays. True if Saturday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the service schedule. Human-readable code used in operations and customer communications.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service schedule. Determines whether the schedule is operational and service should be delivered.

attributes.name: service_window_end_time
attributes.description: Latest time of day when service can be performed at this stop. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Used for route optimization and customer expectations.

attributes.name: service_window_start_time
attributes.description: Earliest time of day when service can be performed at this stop. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Used for route optimization and customer expectations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system that originated this service schedule record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, access instructions, safety requirements, or customer-specific handling procedures. Displayed to drivers and dispatchers.

attributes.name: sunday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Sundays. True if Sunday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the schedule is suspended. Populated only when schedule_status is suspended. Used for customer service and reactivation workflows.

attributes.name: thursday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Thursdays. True if Thursday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: tuesday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Tuesdays. True if Tuesday is a scheduled service day.

attributes.name: wednesday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service is scheduled on Wednesdays. True if Wednesday is a scheduled service day.

products.name: route_optimization_run
products.description: Transactional record capturing each execution of the route optimization algorithm in AMCS Platform, including the optimization scenario (daily re-optimization, seasonal rebalancing, new customer onboarding), input parameters (number of stops, truck count, time windows, vehicle capacities), optimization objectives (minimize miles, minimize time, maximize compaction), output metrics (total route miles, total route hours, stops per truck), and whether the optimized plan was accepted or rejected. Sourced from AMCS Platform. Enables optimization performance tracking and scenario comparison.

attributes.name: route_optimization_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each execution of the route optimization algorithm. Primary key.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service area for which this optimization was executed.

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.waste_stream. Business justification: Route optimization runs are scoped to a specific waste stream — separate optimization runs are executed for MSW, recycling, and organics routes to ensure correct vehicle/container matching and regulat

attributes.name: acceptance_decision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the optimized route plan was accepted for deployment (accepted), rejected by operations (rejected), awaiting management review (pending_review), or partially implemented (partially_accepted).

attributes.name: acceptance_decision_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the acceptance decision was made. Nullable if decision is still pending.

attributes.name: algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version number of the route optimization algorithm used for this run, formatted as major.minor.patch (e.g., 3.2.1).

attributes.name: baseline_total_miles
attributes.description: Total route miles from the previous or baseline plan, used for comparison to measure optimization improvement. Nullable if no baseline exists.

attributes.name: configuration_profile_code
attributes.description: Reference to the optimization configuration profile (parameter set) used for this run, defining weights, constraints, and objectives.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this optimization run record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The target date for which the optimized routes were planned. This is the date the routes are intended to be executed in the field.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error or exception message if the optimization run failed or encountered issues. Nullable if run completed successfully.

attributes.name: execution_mode
attributes.description: Indicates how the optimization run was initiated: manual (user-triggered), scheduled (automated on schedule), automatic (event-driven), or api_triggered (external system integration).

attributes.name: input_driver_count
attributes.description: Total number of drivers available and included as input to the optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: input_stop_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer stops (service locations) included as input to the optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: input_truck_count
attributes.description: Total number of collection vehicles (trucks) available and included as input to the optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this optimization run record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: miles_improvement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage reduction in total route miles compared to the baseline plan. Positive values indicate improvement (fewer miles). Nullable if no baseline exists.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by operations staff regarding this optimization run, such as special considerations, manual adjustments, or business context.

attributes.name: optimization_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds for the optimization algorithm to complete execution.

attributes.name: optimization_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the optimization algorithm execution completed or terminated.

attributes.name: optimization_quality_score
attributes.description: Algorithm-generated quality score (0-100) indicating how well the optimized solution meets the defined objectives and constraints. Higher scores indicate better optimization results.

attributes.name: optimization_run_number
attributes.description: Business-friendly identifier for the optimization run, typically formatted as OPT-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS for traceability.

attributes.name: optimization_scenario_type
attributes.description: The business scenario or trigger that initiated this optimization run, such as daily re-optimization, seasonal rebalancing, new customer onboarding, emergency reroute, capacity expansion, or service area change.

attributes.name: optimization_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the optimization algorithm execution began.

attributes.name: optimization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the optimization run: queued (awaiting execution), running (in progress), completed (successfully finished), failed (encountered errors), cancelled (manually stopped), or partially_accepted (some routes accepted, others rejected).

attributes.name: output_average_hours_per_route
attributes.description: Average estimated time in hours per route in the optimized plan.

attributes.name: output_average_miles_per_route
attributes.description: Average distance in miles per route in the optimized plan.

attributes.name: output_average_stops_per_route
attributes.description: Average number of customer stops per route in the optimized plan.

attributes.name: output_route_count
attributes.description: Total number of optimized routes generated by the algorithm as output.

attributes.name: output_total_route_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated time in hours across all optimized routes, including drive time, service time, and breaks.

attributes.name: output_total_route_miles
attributes.description: Total distance in miles across all optimized routes generated by the algorithm.

attributes.name: output_unassigned_stop_count
attributes.description: Number of customer stops that could not be assigned to any route due to constraints (capacity, time windows, or other limitations).

attributes.name: primary_optimization_objective
attributes.description: The primary business objective the optimization algorithm was configured to achieve: minimize total route miles, minimize total route time, maximize compaction efficiency, balance workload across drivers, minimize operational cost, or maximize service quality.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by operations when the optimized plan was rejected or partially accepted. Nullable if plan was fully accepted or decision is pending.

attributes.name: time_window_enforcement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer-specific time window constraints were enforced during optimization (True) or relaxed (False).

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vehicle capacity constraints (weight and volume limits) were enforced during optimization (True) or relaxed (False).

products.name: district
products.description: Master reference entity defining the geographic collection districts and zones used to organize route planning and operational management. Captures district code, district name, zone code, municipality or jurisdiction, geographic boundary description, service type supported (residential, commercial, C&D), assigned operations manager, and active status. Sourced from AMCS Platform geographic configuration. Enables geographic reporting, district-level performance management, and regulatory jurisdiction alignment.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Primary key for district

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the depot or yard facility that services this district. References facility master data.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Collection districts operate under municipal solid waste collection permits issued by state/local agencies. The district-level permit governs collection frequency, waste types, and service area bounda

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the primary transfer station where collected waste from this district is consolidated before outbound haul. References facility master data.

attributes.name: area_square_miles
attributes.description: Geographic area of the district in square miles. Used for route density analysis and operational efficiency metrics.

attributes.name: collection_frequency
attributes.description: Standard collection frequency for this district. Values: daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, on_demand.

attributes.name: commercial_account_count
attributes.description: Number of commercial customer accounts served in this district. Used for route planning and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: container_type_supported
attributes.description: Types of waste containers supported in this district (e.g., '96-gallon cart, 2-yard dumpster, 8-yard compactor'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this district record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depot_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the primary depot or yard location that services this district.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the collection district used in operational systems and reporting. Typically alphanumeric, 2-10 characters.

attributes.name: district_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the collection district (e.g., 'North Metro District', 'Downtown Commercial Zone').

attributes.name: district_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the district. Values: active (currently serviced), inactive (no longer serviced), planned (future service area), suspended (temporarily not serviced).

attributes.name: diversion_rate_target
attributes.description: Target percentage of waste diverted from landfill through recycling, composting, and other programs. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Department Diversion Goals, SWANA Sustainability Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this district configuration became effective and operational.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Standard end time for collection operations in this district (HH:MM format, 24-hour clock).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this district configuration expires or is scheduled to be deactivated. Null if no expiration is planned.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel type used by collection vehicles in this district. Values: diesel, compressed_natural_gas (CNG), renewable_natural_gas (RNG), electric, hybrid.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics Fuel Standards, EPA Clean Air Act Compliance

attributes.name: geographic_boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic boundaries of the district (e.g., 'Bounded by Main St to the north, Highway 101 to the south').

attributes.name: hazmat_collection_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous waste collection is permitted in this district. True if allowed, False if not. Subject to RCRA and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: RCRA Hazardous Waste Regulations, DOT Hazmat Transportation Standards

attributes.name: household_count
attributes.description: Number of residential households served in this district. Used for route planning and service level analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this district record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this district, including special operational considerations, historical context, or configuration details.

attributes.name: organics_program_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether an organics/composting collection program is active in this district. True if active, False if not.

attributes.name: population_served
attributes.description: Estimated population count served by this collection district. Used for capacity planning and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau Population Data, SWIS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: recycling_program_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recycling collection program is active in this district. True if active, False if not.

attributes.name: route_count
attributes.description: Number of active collection routes operating within this district. Used for resource allocation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: service_days
attributes.description: Days of the week when collection service is provided in this district (e.g., 'Monday, Wednesday, Friday').

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Primary type of waste collection service supported in this district. Values: residential (single-family/multi-family), commercial (business/retail), industrial (manufacturing/warehouse), construction_demolition (C&D waste), mixed (multiple service types).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this district record originated (e.g., 'AMCS Platform', 'SAP S/4HANA').

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Standard start time for collection operations in this district (HH:MM format, 24-hour clock).

attributes.name: vehicle_type_required
attributes.description: Primary type of collection vehicle required for this district. Values: automated_side_loader (ASL), front_end_loader (FEL), rear_end_loader (REL), roll_off, mixed.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Sub-district zone code used for finer geographic segmentation within the district. Alphanumeric, 1-6 characters.

products.name: on_demand_request
products.description: Transactional record for customer-initiated on-demand or special collection requests outside the standard recurring schedule — including bulk item pickup, extra bag/sticker service, special event cleanup, and on-call commercial pickups (excludes roll-off orders which have their own lifecycle). Captures request type, customer account reference, service address, requested service date, container type if applicable, waste stream, priority level, fulfillment status (pending, scheduled, completed, cancelled), assigned route or driver, and completion timestamp. Sourced from Waste Logics customer portal and Salesforce CRM service requests.
products.reference: Waste Logics On-Demand Request / Salesforce Service Request

attributes.name: on_demand_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the on-demand collection request. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: assigned_driver_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver assigned to fulfill this on-demand request. Links to workforce management system for labor tracking and performance metrics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee Master; Locus Dispatch Driver Assignment

attributes.name: assigned_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection route to which this on-demand request has been assigned for fulfillment. Used for driver dispatch and operational tracking.

attributes.name: assigned_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collection vehicle assigned to fulfill this request. Used for fleet utilization tracking and capacity validation.

products.name: load_ticket
products.description: Inbound load ticket (tipping ticket) generated at the transfer station scale house for each vehicle delivering waste. Captures ticket number, originating route or hauler, vehicle/truck ID, driver ID and CDL number, waste stream type (MSW, C&D, recyclables, organics), waste characterization method, contamination level, gross/tare/net weight (tons), tipping fee rate applied, customer or municipal account reference, waste origin jurisdiction, time-in/time-out at scale, gate entry/exit timestamps, pre-entry inspection result, scale operator ID, acceptance/rejection decision with reason code, rejection disposition instructions, and RFID/transponder scan reference. Integrates with AMCS and SAP SD for tipping fee billing.

attributes.name: rate_per_ton

attributes.name: rate_status

attributes.name: rate_tier

attributes.name: volume_discount_threshold_tons

attributes.name: destination_facility_type

attributes.name: dispatch_notes

attributes.name: driver_notes

attributes.name: environmental_fee_amount
attributes.description: Environmental surcharge or regulatory fee assessed on the waste load for environmental compliance programs and remediation funds.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time for the vehicle to arrive at the destination facility based on route planning and traffic conditions.

attributes.name: estimated_fuel_consumption_gallons
attributes.description: Estimated fuel consumption in gallons for the outbound haul based on vehicle type, load weight, and route distance.

attributes.name: estimated_tonnage
attributes.description: Estimated weight of the consolidated waste load in tons based on transfer station scale readings or volume calculations.

attributes.name: generator_signature_captured_flag

attributes.name: haul_number

attributes.name: haul_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outbound haul assignment in the dispatch and delivery workflow.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outbound haul record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: load_rejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination facility rejected the load due to contamination, improper classification, or facility capacity constraints.

attributes.name: receiver_signature_captured_flag

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: route_distance_miles
attributes.description: Total distance in miles from transfer station origin to destination facility. Used for fuel cost allocation and route optimization.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety incident occurred during the outbound haul (accident, spill, injury, near-miss). Triggers incident reporting workflow.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time for the vehicle to depart the transfer station with the consolidated load.

attributes.name: seal_number

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: tipping_fee_amount

attributes.name: tipping_fee_rate
attributes.description: Per-ton disposal fee rate charged by the destination facility for accepting the waste load. Used for cost allocation and billing.

attributes.name: transporter_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transporter (driver) signature was captured on the manifest or BOL for chain-of-custody compliance.

Required for DOT compliance on all outbound loads and RCRA manifest requirements for special/hazardous waste streams.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this haul contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and RCRA manifest compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this manifest record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: manifest_issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manifest document was officially issued and became active for this haul.

attributes.name: manifest_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique manifest tracking number assigned to this outbound haul shipment. Required for DOT compliance and chain-of-custody documentation.

attributes.name: manifest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the haul manifest in the shipping and tracking workflow.

attributes.name: origin_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the transfer station representative who signed the manifest at origin, certifying the shipment details.

attributes.name: origin_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the origin facility representative signed the manifest.

attributes.name: rcra_manifest_required_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this haul requires a formal RCRA hazardous waste manifest under federal regulations.

attributes.name: rejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this haul was rejected at the destination facility due to contamination, incorrect classification, or other non-compliance issues.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the haul was rejected at the destination facility. Populated only when rejection_flag is true.

attributes.name: seal_numbers
attributes.description: Security seal identification numbers applied to containers or trailer doors. Multiple seals may be comma-separated. Required for chain-of-custody integrity.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions

attributes.description: Empty weight of the transport vehicle and containers without waste payload, measured in tons.

attributes.name: total_net_weight_tons

products.name: facility_capacity
products.description: Daily and period-level capacity and throughput tracking record for each transfer station. Captures capacity record ID, transfer station, record date/period, permitted daily capacity (TPD), actual inbound tonnage by waste stream, actual outbound tonnage by destination type, floor storage tonnage at end of day, capacity utilization percentage, number of inbound loads, number of outbound hauls, peak hour/day throughput, diversion rate (percentage diverted from landfill), average daily tonnage, capacity status (normal, near-capacity, over-capacity), regulatory capacity exceedance flags, and reporting submission reference. Enables proactive capacity management, regulatory compliance reporting, state solid waste reporting, and internal KPI tracking.
products.reference: TPD Throughput Record / Facility Capacity Log

attributes.name: facility_capacity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the facility capacity tracking record. Primary key for daily and period-level capacity and throughput tracking at transfer stations.

Disposal agreements define contracted daily tonnage capacity (tpd_capacity). Linking capacity records to d

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Daily capacity utilization must stay within permitted limits. Capacity records demonstrate permit compliance and support regulatory reporting of throughput against permitted daily tonnage limits.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: Transfer station daily/monthly capacity reports are mandatory regulatory submissions under state solid waste regulations. facility_capacity stores regulatory_report_reference and report_submission_dat

attributes.name: transfer_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer station for which capacity is being tracked. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: actual_inbound_tonnage
attributes.description: Total tonnage of waste received at the transfer station during the record date or period. Represents all incoming waste streams before sorting or processing.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices, State SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: actual_outbound_tonnage
attributes.description: Total tonnage of waste dispatched from the transfer station to disposal or processing facilities during the record date or period.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices, State SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: average_daily_tonnage
attributes.description: Average daily tonnage processed during the record period. For daily records, equals actual_inbound_tonnage. For period records, represents the mean daily throughput.

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the transfer station capacity. Normal indicates utilization within acceptable range, near_capacity indicates approaching permit limits, over_capacity indicates permit exceedance, under_capacity indicates significantly below normal throughput.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of permitted daily capacity utilized, calculated as (actual_inbound_tonnage / permitted_daily_capacity_tpd) * 100. Key performance indicator for capacity management.
attributes.references: Internal KPI Framework, SWANA Capacity Management Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions implemented in response to capacity exceedance or operational issues. Documents compliance response for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: RCRA Corrective Action Requirements, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity record was first created in the system. Part of the standard audit trail for all transactional records.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0.00 to 1.00) indicating the completeness and accuracy of the capacity record. Based on presence of required fields, validation checks, and data source reliability.

attributes.name: diversion_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of waste diverted from landfill disposal through recycling, composting, or waste-to-energy. Calculated as ((outbound_mrf_tonnage + outbound_wte_tonnage + outbound_organics_tonnage) / actual_inbound_tonnage) * 100. Key sustainability metric.
attributes.references: EPA Diversion Rate Calculation, State Sustainability Reporting

attributes.name: exceedance_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the permitted capacity was exceeded, if applicable. Includes operational circumstances, emergency conditions, or unplanned events that led to the exceedance.

attributes.name: exceedance_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage by which the actual inbound tonnage exceeded the permitted daily capacity. Null if no exceedance occurred. Used for regulatory violation reporting and corrective action planning.
attributes.references: RCRA Permit Compliance, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: floor_storage_tonnage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Floor Storage Tonnage End of Day
attributes.description: Tonnage of waste remaining on the transfer station floor at the end of the record date. Represents inventory not yet dispatched for disposal or processing.
attributes.references: SWANA Transfer Station Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: inbound_cd_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of construction and demolition (C&D) waste received during the record date or period. C&D includes debris from building, renovation, and demolition activities.
attributes.references: EPA C&D Waste Definition, State Solid Waste Regulations

attributes.name: inbound_load_count
attributes.description: Total count of inbound collection vehicles or loads received at the transfer station during the record date or period. Used for operational throughput analysis.

attributes.name: inbound_msw_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of municipal solid waste (MSW) received during the record date or period. MSW includes residential and commercial non-hazardous waste.
attributes.references: EPA Municipal Solid Waste Definition, RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: inbound_organics_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of organic waste (food waste, yard waste, compostables) received during the record date or period. Tracked separately for diversion rate calculation.
attributes.references: EPA Organics Management, State Composting Regulations

attributes.name: inbound_recyclable_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of recyclable materials received during the record date or period. Includes materials destined for Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) processing.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Standards, State Diversion Rate Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity record was last updated. Part of the standard audit trail for all transactional records.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: operational_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting operational conditions, equipment issues, weather impacts, or other factors affecting capacity and throughput during the record date or period.

attributes.name: outbound_haul_count
attributes.description: Total count of outbound haul trucks dispatched from the transfer station to disposal or processing facilities during the record date or period.

attributes.name: outbound_landfill_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of waste hauled to landfill disposal facilities during the record date or period. Used for diversion rate calculation.
attributes.references: EPA Landfill Reporting, RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: outbound_mrf_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of recyclable materials sent to Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) for processing during the record date or period. Contributes to diversion rate.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Standards, State Diversion Rate Reporting

attributes.name: outbound_wte_tonnage
attributes.description: Tonnage of waste sent to waste-to-energy (WTE) facilities for energy recovery during the record date or period. Contributes to diversion rate.
attributes.references: EPA Waste-to-Energy Standards, Clean Air Act

attributes.name: peak_hour_throughput_tons
attributes.description: Maximum tonnage processed during any single hour of the record date. Used to identify operational bottlenecks and peak demand periods.
attributes.references: SWANA Transfer Station Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: peak_hour_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the peak hour throughput occurred during the record date. Supports operational planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: permit_exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the actual inbound tonnage exceeded the permitted daily capacity. True indicates a regulatory compliance issue requiring immediate attention and reporting.
attributes.references: RCRA Permit Compliance, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: permitted_daily_capacity_tpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permitted Daily Capacity Tons Per Day (TPD)
attributes.description: The maximum daily throughput capacity in tons per day (TPD) as authorized by the facility's operating permit. This is the regulatory limit that cannot be exceeded without permit violation.
attributes.references: RCRA Permit Requirements, State Solid Waste Authority Regulations

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: The specific date for which this capacity record applies. Used for daily capacity tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: record_period
attributes.description: The reporting period for aggregated capacity tracking (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03). Supports both monthly and quarterly period-level reporting.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the capacity record in the reporting workflow. Draft indicates preliminary data, validated indicates quality checks passed, submitted indicates included in regulatory reporting, archived indicates historical record.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which the capacity data originated (e.g., AMCS Platform, Waste Logics, manual entry). Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity record was validated and approved for regulatory reporting. Part of the audit trail for compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Policy

domains.name: fleet
domains.description: Management of all mobile assets including collection trucks (ASL, FEL, REL), transfer vehicles, roll-off trucks, CNG/RNG-fueled units, and support vehicles. Tracks vehicle inventory, specifications, fuel types (diesel, CNG, RNG), telematics data (GPS, fuel consumption, idle time), driver behavior, DOT compliance, CDL driver assignments, vehicle registration, and utilization metrics. Integrates with Geotab Fleet Telematics and Infor EAM. Supports DOT/FMCSA regulatory compliance and fleet KPI reporting.
domains.references: DOT FMCSA Regulations / Geotab Telematics / ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: vehicle

Captures vehicle identification (VIN, unit number, license plate), make, model, year, body type, fuel type, GVWR, axle configuration, DOT registration number, acquisition date and cost, current odometer and engine hours, operational status, assigned district/division, home yard, and detailed technical specifications (engine, transmission, hydraulic system, compaction type, lift mechanism, body capacity, payload capacity, fuel tank capacity, emissions certification). This is the SSOT for vehicle identity and specifications in the fleet domain.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle type as recorded on the registration (e.g., ASL = Automated Side Loader, FEL = Front End Loader, REL = Rear End Loader, roll-off truck, transfer vehicle).

attributes.name: vehicle_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle as recorded on the registration document.

attributes.name: vin

products.name: hos_log
products.description: Hours of Service (HOS) log records for CDL drivers as mandated by FMCSA ELD (Electronic Logging Device) rules under 49 CFR Part 395. Captures log date, driver, vehicle unit, duty status (off duty, sleeper berth, driving, on-duty not driving), duty status start timestamp, duty status end timestamp, duration in status, cumulative driving hours in 8-day window, cumulative on-duty hours in 8-day window, 30-minute break compliance flag, ELD device identifier, co-driver identifier, shipping document reference, and HOS violation flag with violation type code. Supports FMCSA compliance and driver safety management.

products.name: accident_report
products.description: DOT-reportable and non-reportable vehicle accident and incident records for fleet units. Captures incident date and time, vehicle unit, driver, incident location (address, GPS coordinates), incident type (collision, rollover, backing incident, pedestrian, property damage), DOT reportability flag (fatality, injury, tow-away), number of injuries, number of fatalities, estimated property damage amount, police report number, citation issued flag, citation description, drug and alcohol post-accident test required flag, test completion status, insurance claim number, and incident investigation status. Required for FMCSA accident register (49 CFR 390.15) and CSA score management.

domains.name: maintenance
domains.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance for fleet and facility assets. Manages work orders (WO), maintenance schedules (PM cycles), repair history, parts inventory (BOM), technician assignments, downtime tracking, and maintenance costs. Ensures equipment reliability, regulatory compliance (DOT inspections), and asset lifecycle optimization. Integrates with Infor EAM for CMMS functionality and SAP PM for work order execution.
domains.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management / OSHA Equipment Safety Standards / Infor EAM

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core transactional entity representing a maintenance work order (WO) for fleet vehicles or facility assets. Captures WO type (preventive/corrective/emergency), priority, status lifecycle (open, in-progress, on-hold, closed), originating system (SAP PM or Infor EAM), estimated vs. actual labor hours, estimated vs. actual cost, downtime start/end, failure description, root cause, corrective action taken, safety clearance flags (LOTO), DOT inspection linkage, and regulatory compliance indicators. SSOT for all maintenance execution records.
products.reference: SAP PM Work Order / Infor EAM Work Order

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Total actual cost incurred for the work order upon completion, including actual labor, parts consumed, and external contractor charges in USD. Posted to the SAP FI/CO cost center. Used for EBITDA reporting, maintenance budget variance, and asset lifecycle cost analysis.
