attributes.description: Category of the asset being maintained: vehicle (fleet trucks including ASL, FEL, REL), equipment (non-vehicle machinery), facility (building or infrastructure), container (waste containers), or other. Denormalized to support assignment-level filtering without asset master join.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for technician or supervisor notes specific to this assignment, including observations, deviations from standard procedure, safety concerns, or follow-up actions required. Captured in Infor EAM mobile or SAP PM confirmation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this technician assignment record, used in Infor EAM and SAP PM for cross-system reference, labor confirmation, and audit trail. Format: 'ASGN-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN'.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the technician assignment: scheduled (planned but not started), in_progress (technician actively working), completed (labor confirmed and closed), cancelled (assignment voided), or on_hold (paused pending parts or approval).
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the technician's role on the work order: primary (lead technician responsible for execution), secondary (supporting technician), supervisor (oversight role), trainee (under supervision), or contractor (external labor). Drives crew scheduling and cost rate selection.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: certification_used
attributes.description: Specific certification or license applied by the technician for this assignment (e.g., CDL, DOT Inspector, RCRA Hazardous Waste Handler, ASE Certification). Ensures regulatory compliance and documents that qualified personnel performed the work. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CDL|DOT_INSPECTOR|RCRA_HANDLER|ASE|OSHA_30|HAZWOPER|CDL_HAZMAT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; RCRA 40 CFR; CDL Requirements

attributes.name: completion_code
attributes.description: Standardized outcome code recorded at assignment closure: completed_normal (fully executed as planned), completed_partial (partial work done, follow-up required), deferred (rescheduled), cancelled_no_fault (cancelled without technician fault), or cancelled_parts (cancelled due to parts unavailability).
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: confirmed_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the labor hours for this assignment were formally confirmed and approved in SAP PM or Infor EAM. Used for payroll cutoff processing, financial period allocation, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center code to which the labor cost for this technician assignment is allocated. Enables maintenance cost reporting by organizational unit, fleet division, or facility for EBITDA and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: craft_code
attributes.description: Trade or craft classification code identifying the technician's skill category for this assignment (e.g., MECH for mechanic, ELEC for electrician, WELD for welder, HVAC for HVAC technician). Used in Infor EAM for labor planning and rate determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MECH|ELEC|WELD|HVAC|LUBE|DIAG|BODY|TIRE|INSP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; NWRA Craft Classification Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this technician assignment record was first created in the source system (Infor EAM or SAP PM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA response time measurement. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: dot_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technician assignment involves a DOT-required vehicle inspection (True) or is a standard maintenance task (False). Ensures DOT-qualified inspectors are assigned and supports regulatory compliance documentation under 49 CFR Part 396.

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the asset was out of service (downtime) attributable to this technician assignment. Used to calculate asset availability, Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), and fleet operational readiness metrics.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 14224

attributes.name: hazmat_work_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment involves work on hazardous waste handling equipment or requires HAZMAT-certified personnel (True). Triggers PPE requirements, RCRA compliance documentation, and OSHA HAZWOPER certification verification.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120 (HAZWOPER); RCRA 40 CFR; EPA Regulations

attributes.name: labor_confirmation_number
attributes.description: SAP PM or Infor EAM labor confirmation document number generated when the technician's actual hours are posted and confirmed against the work order. Serves as the audit reference linking this assignment to the financial posting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: labor_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician's actual labor hours have been formally confirmed and posted in SAP PM or Infor EAM (True), triggering financial posting to the work order cost object. False indicates hours are still pending confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Total labor cost charged to the work order for this technician assignment, calculated from actual labor hours and the technician's applicable labor rate. Used for maintenance cost allocation, COGS reporting, and asset lifecycle cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: labor_rate
attributes.description: Hourly labor rate applied to this technician assignment for cost calculation, sourced from the technician's craft/trade rate in SAP PM or Infor EAM. May reflect standard, overtime, or contractor rate depending on assignment type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Infor EAM; GAAP

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours logged by the technician for this assignment beyond the standard shift, as tracked per FLSA and company policy. Drives overtime cost calculation and labor budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of required PPE items for this technician assignment (e.g., 'hard_hat,safety_vest,gloves,respirator'). Derived from the task hazard assessment and OSHA requirements. Supports safety compliance verification and incident prevention.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: Planned date and time the technician is expected to complete work on the assigned task. Used for shift planning, resource availability, and work order duration estimation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: scheduled_labor_hours
attributes.description: Planned number of labor hours allocated to this technician for the assigned task, as estimated during work order planning. Used for capacity planning, cost estimation, and variance analysis against actual hours.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: Planned date and time the technician is scheduled to begin work on the assigned task. Used for crew scheduling, resource capacity planning, and SLA compliance monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Work shift during which this technician assignment is scheduled or executed: day, evening, night, weekend, or on_call. Used for shift differential pay calculation, labor scheduling, and 24/7 maintenance coverage analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; FLSA

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: Proficiency level of the technician for the craft applied in this assignment: apprentice (entry-level under supervision), journeyman (qualified independent), senior (experienced), master (highest craft level), or specialist (domain-specific expert). Used for crew composition validation and training gap analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Workday HCM; NWRA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: travel_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the technician spent traveling to and from the maintenance site for this assignment. Captured separately from labor hours for accurate cost allocation, technician utilization analysis, and field service efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; FLSA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this technician assignment record was last modified in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: work_order_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the parent work order, denormalized to the assignment level to support technician dispatch sequencing and scheduling decisions: emergency (immediate response), urgent (same-day), high (next available), normal (scheduled), or low (deferred).
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: work_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parent work order type: preventive (scheduled PM cycle), corrective (reactive repair), emergency (unplanned critical failure), inspection (DOT or regulatory inspection), or project (capital improvement). Denormalized here to support assignment-level analytics without joining to the WO header.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Infor EAM; DOT 49 CFR

products.name: parts_catalog
products.description: Master catalog of all parts, components, and materials used in fleet and facility maintenance operations. Stores part number, part description, manufacturer, OEM part number, part category (engine, hydraulic, electrical, body, tire, filter, fluid), unit of measure, standard cost, reorder point, reorder quantity, lead time days, preferred supplier reference, hazardous material flag, and active/obsolete status. Serves as the BOM (Bill of Materials) reference for work order parts planning. Owned by maintenance domain; procurement domain references for purchasing.
products.reference: Infor EAM Parts Master / SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each part record in the master parts catalog. Primary key for the parts_catalog data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: disposal_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Parts containing hazardous materials (batteries, mercury switches, PCB capacitors) must link to EPA waste codes for disposal planning, waste characterization, and regulatory compliance. Essential for

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: Parts catalog entries for hazardous materials (fluids, batteries, aerosols) must carry DOT classification for 49 CFR shipping and storage compliance. Normalizes denormalized hazmat_class and un_number

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Certain parts are permit-specific (emissions control components, hazardous waste containment parts, EPA-certified equipment). Parts catalogs must track permit applicability to ensure only approved com

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Hazardous parts catalog entries (is_hazardous_material=true) must reference governing regulatory requirements (RCRA, DOT hazmat regulations) for handling, storage, and disposal. This drives compliant

attributes.name: vehicle_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle_class. Business justification: Parts catalog entries are scoped to vehicle classes (e.g., hydraulic seals only applicable to rear-loaders). Linking parts_catalog to vehicle_class enables class-specific parts lookup during work orde

attributes.name: catalog_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this part record became effective and available for use in work orders and purchasing. Supports catalog version management and historical BOM accuracy.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Validity

attributes.name: core_charge_amount
attributes.description: Refundable deposit amount charged by the supplier for a remanufactured part's core. Credited back upon return of the used core. Expressed in USD. Applicable only when is_core_returnable is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Core Charge; Infor EAM Core Return; GAAP Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Default SAP cost center code associated with the procurement and consumption of this part. Used for departmental cost allocation and maintenance budget tracking in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Cost Allocation; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this part record was first created in the parts catalog. Provides audit trail for record provenance and supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Requirements

attributes.name: dot_inspection_part
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Inspection Part Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is a safety-critical component subject to Department of Transportation (DOT) vehicle inspection requirements (True). Examples include brake components, tires, lights, and steering parts. Ensures compliance tracking for DOT roadworthiness inspections.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396 Inspection, Repair, and Maintenance; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178

attributes.name: expected_service_life_days
attributes.description: Manufacturer or engineering-specified expected useful service life of the part in calendar days under normal operating conditions. Used for PM interval planning, lifecycle cost analysis, and asset reliability modeling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA PM Maintenance Strategy; SWANA Fleet Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code to which the cost of this part is posted upon consumption in a work order. Enables accurate cost allocation to maintenance expense accounts in SAP FI/CO. Examples: parts expense, consumables, capital spares.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO General Ledger; GAAP Financial Reporting; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Compliance

attributes.name: is_core_returnable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a core (used/rebuildable) part must be returned to the supplier upon installation of a replacement (True). Common for remanufactured parts such as alternators, starters, and hydraulic pumps. Drives core charge tracking in procurement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Core Return Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Returnable Packaging; NWRA Fleet Parts Standards

attributes.name: is_hazardous_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part or material is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and disposal procedures under DOT, EPA, and OSHA regulations (e.g., certain fluids, batteries, refrigerants). True = hazardous; False = non-hazardous.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication; CERCLA

attributes.name: is_serialized
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this part are tracked by unique serial number (True) or managed as bulk/lot inventory (False). Serialized parts (e.g., engines, transmissions, compactors) require individual asset tracking in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Serialized Parts Tracking; SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: last_cost_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the standard cost for this part was last reviewed and updated. Supports annual cost roll-up processes and ensures standard costs remain aligned with market pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Standard Cost Estimate; GAAP Inventory Valuation; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this part record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Requirements

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to receipt of the part from the preferred supplier. Used for reorder point calculation and maintenance scheduling to ensure parts availability.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Lead Time; SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record; SWANA Fleet Parts Management

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer or parts manufacturer (e.g., Cummins, Parker Hannifin, Donaldson, Heil). Used for warranty tracking, sourcing decisions, and quality management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The part number assigned by the manufacturer (distinct from OEM number when the manufacturer is a third-party supplier rather than the equipment OEM). Enables direct ordering from manufacturer catalogs.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum allowable on-hand inventory quantity to prevent overstocking and excess carrying costs. Used in min-max inventory planning. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Max Stock Level

attributes.name: minimum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Safety stock level — the absolute minimum quantity that must be maintained on hand to prevent stockouts during lead time. Distinct from reorder_point which is the trigger level. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Safety Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM Safety Stock; SWANA Fleet Parts Management

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date on which this part was designated as obsolete or discontinued. After this date, the part is no longer available for new work orders or purchase orders. Null if the part is still active.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Discontinuation

attributes.name: oem_part_number
attributes.description: The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) part number as assigned by the vehicle or equipment manufacturer (e.g., Mack Trucks, Heil Environmental, McNeilus). Used for cross-referencing with manufacturer catalogs and sourcing OEM replacements.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; DOT FMCSA Equipment Standards

attributes.name: part_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the part by functional system or component group. Drives Bill of Materials (BOM) organization, work order planning, and inventory segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engine|hydraulic|electrical|body|tire|filter|fluid|brake|transmission|exhaust|pneumatic|safety|chassis|cooling|fuel|waste_body|compaction|lift_system|cab — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: part_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the part including specifications, dimensions, material composition, and application context. Supports technician identification and procurement accuracy.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short name or title of the part (e.g., 'Hydraulic Pump Assembly', 'Air Filter Element', 'Brake Caliper'). Used as the primary identity label for display in work orders, purchase orders, and inventory reports.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Internal Waste Management part number used as the primary business identifier for the part across procurement, maintenance work orders, and inventory systems. Corresponds to the Material Number in SAP MM and the Part Number in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: part_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the part in the catalog. Active parts are available for use in work orders and purchasing. Obsolete parts are no longer procured. Superseded parts have been replaced by a newer part number. Pending_approval parts are under review before activation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master Status; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: part_type
attributes.description: Classification of the part by its maintenance disposition: consumable (single-use, e.g., filters, fluids), repairable (can be rebuilt), rotable (tracked serialized item returned to stock after repair), expendable (low-cost, not tracked), or capital (high-value tracked asset component).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Master; SAP S/4HANA PM Maintenance Item Types; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: pm_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is used in scheduled Preventive Maintenance (PM) cycles (True) versus only in corrective/unplanned repairs (False). Drives PM parts kit planning and stocking strategies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA PM Maintenance Plan; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum on-hand inventory quantity threshold that triggers a replenishment purchase order. When stock falls to or below this level, procurement is initiated. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Reorder Point Planning; SWANA Fleet Parts Management

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity to order when a replenishment is triggered. Represents the economic order quantity (EOQ) or fixed lot size for the part. Expressed in the part's unit of measure.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Lot Size; SWANA Fleet Parts Management

attributes.name: sds_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this part or material. Required by OSHA Hazard Communication Standard for hazardous chemicals. Enables technicians to access handling, storage, and emergency response information.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication Standard; ISO 11014 Safety Data Sheet

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this part record originated (e.g., INFOR_EAM for Infor EAM parts master, SAP_MM for SAP S/4HANA Material Master, MANUAL for manually entered records). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA MM; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of measure for the part as maintained in the cost accounting system. Used for work order cost estimation, budget planning, and variance analysis. Expressed in USD. Corresponds to the standard price in SAP MM Material Master costing view.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Standard Cost; GAAP Inventory Valuation; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Default warehouse or parts room storage location code where this part is stocked (e.g., bin, shelf, or zone identifier). Used for inventory picking, cycle counting, and parts room organization in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warehouse Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the part used in inventory management, purchasing, and work order consumption (e.g., EA=Each, QT=Quart, GL=Gallon, LT=Liter, KG=Kilogram, SET=Set, PAIR=Pair). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|QT|GL|LT|KG|LB|FT|M|SET|BOX|CASE|ROLL|PAIR — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; Infor EAM Stock UOM; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: warranty_duration_days
attributes.description: Standard warranty period in calendar days provided by the manufacturer or supplier for this part. Used to track warranty claims and determine eligibility for no-cost replacements on failed parts.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Warranty; NWRA Fleet Parts Standards

attributes.name: weight_lbs
attributes.description: Physical weight of the part in pounds. Used for shipping cost estimation, DOT weight compliance on service vehicles, and ergonomic safety assessments for technician handling under OSHA guidelines.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Vehicle Weight Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry Safety; Infor EAM Parts Specifications

products.name: storeroom
products.description: Master record for maintenance storerooms and parts warehouses that hold spare parts inventory for fleet and facility maintenance. Captures storeroom code, storeroom name, location (facility/yard), storeroom type (central, satellite, mobile), responsible manager, physical address, storage capacity, climate-controlled flag, hazmat storage certified flag, and active status. Enables multi-location parts inventory management and storeroom replenishment planning across the fleet maintenance network.

attributes.name: storeroom_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the maintenance storeroom or parts warehouse record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Vendor-managed inventory storerooms (is_vendor_managed flag exists) are governed by VMI contracts. Waste management operators use third-party parts suppliers under formal contracts; linking storeroom

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or maintenance yard where this storeroom is physically located. Used to associate parts inventory with a specific operational site.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Location Master; SAP S/4HANA PM — Functional Location

attributes.name: parent_storeroom_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent storeroom in a hierarchical storeroom network (e.g., a satellite storeroom references its central hub storeroom). Enables multi-tier inventory replenishment and inter-storeroom transfer management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Storeroom Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Storerooms storing hazardous materials require specific permits (hazmat storage permits). hazmat_permit_number and hazmat_permit_expiry_date are denormalized permit data that should be replaced by a F

attributes.name: storage_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.storage_unit. Business justification: Maintenance storerooms certified as hazmat satellite accumulation areas must be linked to the hazmat storage_unit record for EPA accumulation time limit enforcement and unified inspection scheduling.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the storeroom physical location. Used for logistics, delivery routing, and regulatory site identification.
attributes.references: DOT Site Identification; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Facility Records

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail for the storeroom physical location (e.g., suite, building, bay number). Supplements address_line1 for precise delivery and site identification.
attributes.references: DOT Site Identification; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Facility Records

attributes.name: bin_location_count
attributes.description: Total number of discrete bin, shelf, or rack locations within the storeroom. Drives bin-level inventory tracking configuration in the CMMS and determines the granularity of parts storage management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Bin/Location Configuration; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Bin

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the storeroom is physically located. Used for geographic reporting, regional inventory analysis, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the storeroom physical location (e.g., USA, CAN). Supports multi-country operations and regulatory jurisdiction identification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storeroom master record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which physical inventory cycle counts are performed in this storeroom. Cycle counts verify on-hand quantities against system records and are required for SOX-compliant inventory accuracy controls.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Cycle Count Configuration; SAP S/4HANA MM — Physical Inventory; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the storeroom was or is scheduled to be permanently decommissioned and removed from active inventory operations. Populated when storeroom_status transitions to decommissioned.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Retirement; SAP S/4HANA PM — Functional Location Deactivation

attributes.name: eam_storeroom_ref
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this storeroom as recorded in the Infor EAM system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CMMS source of record.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the storeroom used for purchase order confirmations, parts requisition notifications, and vendor communications.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date on which the storeroom was formally established and made operational. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, depreciation scheduling, and historical inventory network analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA PM — Functional Location Creation Date

attributes.name: fire_suppression_type
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed in the storeroom. Required for OSHA and local fire code compliance, particularly for storerooms holding flammable lubricants, solvents, or compressed gas cylinders.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.159 — Automatic Sprinkler Systems; NFPA 10 — Portable Fire Extinguishers; Local Fire Code

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code used for inventory valuation and parts issuance accounting entries associated with this storeroom. Supports financial reporting and SOX-compliant inventory controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — General Ledger; GAAP ASC 330 — Inventory; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to value parts inventory held in this storeroom. Standard cost uses predetermined prices; moving average recalculates cost with each receipt; FIFO and LIFO are queue-based methods. Determines how parts cost flows to work orders and financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Valuation Method; GAAP ASC 330 — Inventory Valuation; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: is_bonded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storeroom operates as a bonded (secured, access-controlled) inventory location where parts are tracked under formal custody and issuance controls. Bonded storerooms require documented check-in/check-out procedures and are subject to periodic audits.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Bonded Storeroom Configuration; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: is_climate_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storeroom maintains controlled temperature and humidity conditions. Climate-controlled storerooms are required for storing temperature-sensitive parts such as electronic control modules, batteries, lubricants, and certain chemical supplies.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 — Flammable Liquids Storage; OEM Parts Storage Requirements

attributes.name: is_hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storeroom is certified to store hazardous materials such as solvents, lubricants, batteries, and other regulated substances. Certification requires compliance with EPA, DOT, and OSHA hazmat storage regulations.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Hazardous Waste Regulations; DOT 49 CFR — Hazardous Materials; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 — Hazard Communication

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory replenishment for this storeroom is managed by an external vendor under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement. VMI storerooms have supplier-controlled reorder triggers and consignment stock arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Consignment Stock; Infor EAM — VMI Configuration

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal storeroom audit covering inventory accuracy, hazmat compliance, storage conditions, and security controls. Supports regulatory compliance tracking and internal audit scheduling.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Workplace Safety Audits; EPA RCRA Inspection Requirements; SOX Internal Audit

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory cycle count was completed for this storeroom. Used to track compliance with cycle count schedules and identify storerooms overdue for physical verification.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Physical Inventory; SAP S/4HANA MM — Physical Inventory Document; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storeroom master record was most recently updated. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the storeroom in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables GPS-based proximity analysis for parts sourcing, mobile storeroom dispatch, and fleet maintenance routing.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Geotab Fleet Telematics Integration

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the storeroom in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used alongside latitude for spatial analysis, proximity-based parts sourcing, and logistics optimization.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Geotab Fleet Telematics Integration

attributes.name: max_inventory_value_usd
attributes.description: Authorized maximum dollar value of parts inventory that may be held in this storeroom at any time. Used for capital budgeting, insurance coverage determination, and inventory investment controls. Expressed in US dollars.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Inventory Budget; GAAP ASC 330; SOX Section 404 — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, access directions, or other contextual information about the storeroom that does not fit structured fields. Used by storeroom managers and maintenance planners.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Descriptive text specifying the days and hours during which the storeroom is staffed and open for parts issuance and receipt (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 06:00-18:00, Sat 07:00-12:00'). Used for work order planning and technician parts availability scheduling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Storeroom Availability; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the storeroom. Used by technicians, procurement staff, and fleet managers to coordinate parts availability, emergency parts requests, and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the storeroom physical location. Supports geographic analysis, delivery routing, and regulatory site reporting.

attributes.name: primary_cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which storeroom operating expenses (overhead, labor, utilities) are charged. Enables financial reporting of storeroom costs within the maintenance domain P&L.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Cost Allocation Standards

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The inventory replenishment strategy applied to this storeroom. Min/max triggers reorder when stock falls below minimum level; reorder_point uses statistical demand forecasting; kanban uses visual pull signals; vmi delegates replenishment to the vendor; manual requires human-initiated purchase orders.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Replenishment Policy; SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Type

attributes.name: sap_storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP S/4HANA MM storage location code corresponding to this storeroom. Used for purchase order goods receipt, material document posting, and inventory reconciliation between SAP and Infor EAM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location (LGORT); SAP PM — Plant Maintenance Integration

attributes.name: security_access_level
attributes.description: Physical security access control level for the storeroom. Open storerooms have no access restriction; badge_access requires electronic credential; supervised requires attendant presence; locked requires key/combination access. Drives access control configuration and audit requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 — Workplace Security; SOX Internal Controls — Asset Safeguarding

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code for the storeroom physical location. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping, DOT compliance, and regional inventory reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI INCITS 38 — US State Codes; DOT Jurisdiction Mapping

attributes.name: storage_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total physical floor area of the storeroom in square feet. Used for capacity planning, storeroom utilization analysis, and determining maximum parts inventory volume that can be physically accommodated.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Storeroom Capacity; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: storeroom_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the storeroom within the enterprise maintenance network. Used in work orders, purchase orders, and parts requisitions to reference the issuing storeroom. Aligns with Infor EAM storeroom code field.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Storeroom Code; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location

attributes.name: storeroom_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the storeroom (e.g., 'Houston Central Fleet Parts Storeroom', 'Dallas North Satellite Storeroom'). Used in reports, dashboards, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: storeroom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the storeroom record. Active storerooms are operational and available for parts issuance and receipt. Inactive storerooms are temporarily closed. Decommissioned storerooms are permanently closed and no longer used.

attributes.name: storeroom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storeroom by its operational role within the parts distribution network. Central storerooms serve as primary hubs; satellite storerooms serve regional yards; mobile storerooms are truck-mounted for field use; field_cache are small on-site bins; virtual storerooms represent consignment or vendor-managed inventory locations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Storeroom Type; SWANA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

products.name: parts_inventory
products.description: Current on-hand inventory levels for parts and materials across all maintenance storerooms. Captures part reference, storeroom reference, bin location, quantity on hand, quantity reserved (allocated to open WOs), quantity on order, minimum stock level, maximum stock level, last physical count date, last count quantity, and inventory valuation. Enables parts availability checks during WO planning, stockout prevention, and inventory carrying cost management. Distinct from parts_catalog (definition) — this is the live inventory position.
products.reference: Infor EAM Inventory / SAP MM Stock Overview

attributes.name: parts_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parts inventory record representing the on-hand stock position of a specific part at a specific storeroom and bin location. Primary key for the parts_inventory data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: primary_parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the part master record in the parts catalog. Links this inventory position to the part definition including description, specifications, and classification. Sourced from Infor EAM parts catalog.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Catalog; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: storeroom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance storeroom or warehouse location where this part inventory is physically held. Each storeroom is associated with a facility or depot serving fleet and facility maintenance operations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Storeroom Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification of the part based on annual consumption value. 'A' items represent high-value/high-usage parts requiring tight inventory control; 'B' items are moderate; 'C' items are low-value/low-usage parts. Used to prioritize cycle count frequency and inventory management effort.
attributes.references: Infor EAM ABC Analysis; SAP S/4HANA MM ABC Indicator; SWANA Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: annual_usage_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of this part issued from this storeroom over the trailing 12-month period. Used for ABC classification, reorder point calculation, safety stock sizing, and inventory carrying cost analysis. Updated periodically from goods issue history.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Consumption History; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Consumption

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, rack, or aisle location within the storeroom where the part is physically stored (e.g., 'A-12-3', 'RACK-B-SHELF-4'). Enables efficient parts picking during work order execution and physical inventory counts.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Bin Location Management; SAP S/4HANA WM Bin

attributes.name: count_variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between last_count_quantity and the system quantity_on_hand at the time of the physical count. Positive values indicate more stock found than recorded; negative values indicate shrinkage or unrecorded usage. Used to trigger inventory adjustments and investigate discrepancies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Adjustment; SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Difference; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts inventory record was first created in the source system (Infor EAM or SAP MM). Represents the date the part was first stocked at this storeroom location. Used for inventory aging analysis and audit trail.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Record Creation; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Classification of the part's operational criticality based on the impact of a stockout on fleet or facility operations. 'critical' parts (e.g., DOT-required safety components, CNG system parts) cause immediate vehicle out-of-service if unavailable. Used to prioritize reorder actions and safety stock levels.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Criticality Ranking; DOT FMCSA Vehicle Inspection Requirements; OSHA Equipment Safety Standards

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for physical cycle counting of this part at this storeroom. Typically driven by ABC classification (A=monthly, B=quarterly, C=annual) and criticality level. Used to schedule cycle count tasks and ensure inventory accuracy for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Cycle Count Schedule; SAP S/4HANA MM Cycle Count; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: DOT hazardous materials classification code for the part when is_hazardous is True (e.g., '3' for flammable liquids, '8' for corrosives, '9' for miscellaneous). Required for compliant storage, handling, and disposal documentation. Null when is_hazardous is False.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 172 Hazardous Materials Table; EPA RCRA Waste Classification

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this inventory record. 'active' indicates the part is available for use; 'quarantine' indicates the part is held pending quality inspection; 'obsolete' indicates the part is no longer used but stock remains; 'pending_disposal' indicates stock is being removed from service.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Status; SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Type

attributes.name: inventory_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the on-hand inventory for this part at this storeroom, calculated as quantity_on_hand multiplied by unit_cost. Expressed in USD. Used for balance sheet inventory asset reporting, carrying cost analysis, and financial close processes per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Valuation; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Inventory Account; GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part or material is classified as hazardous under DOT, EPA, or OSHA regulations (e.g., solvents, lubricants, refrigerants, battery acid). Triggers special handling, storage, and disposal requirements. True = hazardous material requiring regulatory compliance controls.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication

attributes.name: is_lot_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is managed by lot or batch number for traceability purposes (True). Lot-controlled parts (e.g., lubricants, chemicals, safety-critical components) require lot tracking for quality control, recall management, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Lot Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; ISO 9001 Traceability

attributes.name: is_serialized
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this part are tracked by unique serial number (True) or managed as bulk/lot quantity (False). Serialized parts (e.g., major assemblies, electronic control units) require individual tracking through installation and removal from assets.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Serial Number Tracking; SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Profile

attributes.name: last_count_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity recorded during the most recent physical inventory count for this part at this storeroom. Compared against the system quantity_on_hand to identify and reconcile inventory discrepancies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Physical Inventory Count; SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Document

attributes.name: last_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent stock issue (goods issue to a work order or cost center) was posted for this part at this storeroom. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete inventory and support inventory rationalization decisions.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Goods Issue; SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Issue Date

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was performed for this part at this storeroom. Used to assess inventory record accuracy, schedule cycle counts, and support audit compliance. Required for SOX internal controls over inventory.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Cycle Count; SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent stock receipt (goods receipt from a purchase order or transfer) was posted for this part at this storeroom. Used to assess replenishment frequency and identify slow-moving or dormant inventory.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Goods Receipt; SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt Date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inventory record, including quantity changes from receipts, issues, reservations, or manual adjustments. Used to determine data freshness and support incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to receipt of the part at the storeroom. Used to calculate reorder timing, safety stock levels, and projected availability dates for work order planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Procurement Lead Time; SAP S/4HANA MM Planned Delivery Time

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) part number as assigned by the manufacturer. Used for cross-referencing with supplier catalogs, identifying approved substitutes, and ensuring correct part specification during procurement and installation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Manufacturer Part Reference; SAP S/4HANA MM Manufacturer Part Number

attributes.name: max_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of the part that should be held in the storeroom at any time. Used to prevent overstocking, control carrying costs, and optimize storeroom space utilization. Replenishment orders are sized to bring stock up to but not exceed this level.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Max Stock Level; SAP S/4HANA MM Maximum Stock Level

attributes.name: min_stock_level
attributes.description: Minimum reorder point quantity below which a replenishment requisition or purchase order should be triggered. Used by the CMMS to generate automatic reorder alerts and prevent stockouts that could cause fleet or facility downtime.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Reorder Point; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Reorder Point

attributes.name: next_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next physical cycle count of this part at this storeroom. Calculated based on last_physical_count_date and cycle_count_frequency. Used by storeroom supervisors to plan and assign counting tasks.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Cycle Count Schedule; SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Planning

attributes.name: part_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the part type used for inventory reporting and spend analysis (e.g., 'Engine Components', 'Hydraulic System', 'Electrical', 'Body & Frame', 'Tires & Wheels', 'Filters & Fluids', 'Safety Equipment'). Aligns with the parts catalog classification hierarchy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engine_components|hydraulic_system|electrical|body_frame|tires_wheels|filters_fluids|safety_equipment|pneumatic|brake_system|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Part Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Net quantity available for new work order allocation, calculated as quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved. Represents the true available-to-promise stock for WO planning and parts availability checks. Stored as a business field to support real-time availability queries without recalculation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Available Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM Available Stock

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of the part available in the storeroom at the time of the last inventory update. Expressed in the part's unit of measure (e.g., EA, GAL, FT). This is the gross stock before reservations are subtracted.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Unrestricted Stock

attributes.name: quantity_on_order
attributes.description: Total quantity of the part currently on open Purchase Orders (POs) that have been issued to suppliers but not yet received into the storeroom. Used for replenishment planning and projected stock availability calculations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Purchase Order Integration; SAP S/4HANA MM Open PO Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity of the part currently allocated or reserved against open Work Orders (WOs) that have not yet been issued/picked. Reduces the effective available quantity for new WO planning. Sourced from Infor EAM or SAP PM reservation records.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Parts Reservation; SAP S/4HANA PM Reservation

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard order quantity used when a replenishment purchase order is generated for this part at this storeroom. Typically set to the economic order quantity (EOQ) or supplier minimum order quantity to optimize procurement costs.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Reorder Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM Lot Size

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity maintained above the minimum stock level to protect against demand variability and supplier lead time uncertainty. Particularly important for critical fleet parts (e.g., DOT-required components) where stockouts cause vehicle out-of-service events.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Safety Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM Safety Stock; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Best Practices

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days this part can be stored before it expires or degrades and must be disposed of (e.g., lubricants, adhesives, rubber seals, safety equipment with expiry dates). Null for parts with no shelf life restriction. Used to manage FIFO rotation and prevent use of expired materials.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Shelf Life Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life; OSHA Material Safety Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this inventory record was sourced (e.g., 'infor_eam' for CMMS-managed storerooms, 'sap_s4hana' for SAP MM-managed locations, 'manual' for manually entered records). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA MM; Databricks Data Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or average cost per unit of the part used for inventory valuation. Expressed in USD. Used to calculate total inventory value, work order material costs, and COGS reporting. May reflect moving average cost or standard cost depending on valuation method.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Part Cost; SAP S/4HANA MM Valuation Price; GAAP Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure in which the part quantity is tracked (e.g., EA=Each, GAL=Gallon, LB=Pound, FT=Feet). All quantity fields (on_hand, reserved, on_order, min, max) are expressed in this unit. Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|GAL|QT|LB|FT|IN|M|L|KG|BOX|SET|PKG|ROLL|DRUM — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM UOM; SAP S/4HANA MM Base Unit of Measure; ISO 80000

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to value this part's inventory (e.g., moving_average, standard_cost, FIFO, LIFO). Determines how unit_cost is calculated when stock is received at varying prices. Must align with the company's GAAP/IFRS inventory accounting policy.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories; SAP S/4HANA MM Valuation Class

attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14224 Data Management

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Standard method by which this failure mode is typically detected. Informs PM schedule design and sensor/telematics alert configuration. Sensor alerts integrate with Geotab telematics; diagnostic codes align with OBD-II/J1939 fault code systems for fleet assets. attributes.name: dot_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this failure mode, when identified on a commercial motor vehicle, constitutes a DOT-reportable defect requiring out-of-service designation or driver vehicle inspection report (DVIR) notation. Drives compliance workflows in fleet maintenance and DOT inspection management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this failure mode code is valid for use on work orders and maintenance records. Supports catalog versioning and ensures that historical work orders retain the failure classification that was active at the time of the repair.

attributes.name: epa_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this failure mode may result in an EPA-reportable environmental incident (e.g., hydraulic fluid spill, leachate containment breach, LFG emission exceedance). When true, triggers environmental incident notification workflows in Enviance EHS and CERCLA/RCRA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: estimated_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Standard estimated number of hours an asset is expected to be out of service when this failure mode occurs, including diagnosis, repair, and return-to-service time. Used for fleet availability modeling, route coverage planning, and KPI reporting on asset utilization.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Downtime Tracking; AMCS Fleet Availability Reporting; ISO 14224

attributes.name: estimated_parts_cost
attributes.description: Standard estimated cost of parts and materials required to repair this failure mode, expressed in US dollars. Used for work order cost estimation, maintenance budget planning, and repair-vs-replace decision support. Sourced from SAP MM BOM pricing and Infor EAM parts catalog.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Pricing; Infor EAM Parts Catalog; GAAP Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this failure mode code is no longer valid for assignment to new work orders. Null for codes with no planned expiration. Supports catalog lifecycle management and ensures deprecated codes are not used in active maintenance workflows.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Catalog Effectivity; SAP PM Catalog Profile Validity

attributes.name: failure_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping failure modes by the nature of the failure mechanism. Drives routing of work orders to the appropriate technician skill set and supports trend analysis by failure type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical|electrical|hydraulic|structural|operator_induced|pneumatic|software — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure Category; ISO 14224 Section 8; FMEA Methodology

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the failure mode within the enterprise catalog. Used as the externally-known business identifier on work orders, repair records, and FMEA documentation. Sourced from Infor EAM failure code configuration.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure Code Catalog; SAP PM Catalog Profile; ISO 14224

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature of the failure, observable symptoms, and conditions under which it typically occurs. Provides technicians and engineers with sufficient context to identify and classify the failure accurately in the field.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; ISO 14224; FMEA Methodology (SAE J1739)

attributes.name: failure_mode_group
attributes.description: Logical grouping of related failure modes for reporting and analysis purposes (e.g., 'Powertrain Failures', 'Body and Compactor Failures', 'Hydraulic System Failures', 'Containment Failures'). Supports roll-up reporting in maintenance dashboards and FMEA analysis by system group.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Failure Group Configuration; SAP PM Catalog Group; ISO 14224 Failure Classification

attributes.name: failure_mode_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the failure mode record in the enterprise catalog. Active records are available for selection on work orders and PM schedules. Inactive or deprecated records are retained for historical reporting but cannot be assigned to new work orders.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Catalog Management; SAP PM Catalog Profile Lifecycle

attributes.name: failure_name
attributes.description: Short, human-readable name for the failure mode (e.g., 'Hydraulic Hose Burst', 'Brake Pad Wear', 'Electrical Short Circuit'). Used as the identity label in work order dropdowns, dashboards, and maintenance reports.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Catalog; VMRS Code Council

attributes.name: fmea_detectability_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Detectability Score
attributes.description: FMEA detectability rating on a 1-10 scale representing the ability of current inspection and monitoring controls to detect the failure before it causes asset breakdown. Score of 10 indicates the failure is virtually undetectable. Component of the RPN calculation.

attributes.name: fmea_occurrence_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Occurrence Score
attributes.description: FMEA occurrence rating on a 1-10 scale representing the likelihood of this failure mode occurring within a given operating period. Score of 10 indicates near-certain occurrence. Derived from historical work order frequency data and OEM reliability data. Component of the RPN calculation.
attributes.references: FMEA Methodology (SAE J1739); ISO 14224; Infor EAM Failure History

attributes.name: fmea_rpn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Risk Priority Number (RPN)
attributes.description: Composite risk score calculated as the product of Severity, Occurrence, and Detectability ratings (each 1-10) per FMEA methodology. Range 1-1000. Higher RPN values indicate higher priority for preventive maintenance investment and engineering redesign. Maintained by reliability engineering and reviewed during PM optimization cycles.
attributes.references: FMEA Methodology (SAE J1739); ISO 14224; Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) Standards

attributes.name: fmea_severity_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Severity Score
attributes.description: FMEA severity rating on a 1-10 scale representing the seriousness of the failure effect on asset function, safety, or regulatory compliance. Score of 10 indicates catastrophic safety or environmental impact. Component of the RPN calculation.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether repair of this failure mode involves handling, containment, or disposal of hazardous materials (e.g., hydraulic fluid, refrigerants, battery acid, leachate). When true, triggers hazardous waste handling procedures and DOT/EPA hazmat compliance workflows.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 171-180 (Hazardous Materials Regulations); EPA RCRA 40 CFR Part 262; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (HazCom)

attributes.name: industry_standard_code
attributes.description: External industry standard code that maps this failure mode to a recognized classification system beyond VMRS (e.g., ISO 14224 failure mechanism code, SWANA equipment failure taxonomy, or OEM-specific fault code). Enables cross-system benchmarking and regulatory reporting alignment.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance Data; SWANA Technical Standards; SAE J1939

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this failure mode record was most recently updated. Tracks catalog maintenance activity and supports change management auditing for regulated maintenance programs. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14224 Data Management

attributes.name: loto_required_flag

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures
attributes.description: Average operating hours between occurrences of this failure mode across the asset population, expressed in hours. attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair

attributes.name: obd_fault_code

attributes.name: pm_trigger_flag

attributes.name: ppe_requirements

attributes.name: recommended_corrective_action

attributes.name: recurrence_risk

attributes.references: RCM (Reliability-Centered Maintenance) Standards; ISO 14224; Infor EAM Failure History Analytics

attributes.name: review_date

attributes.references: ISO 14224 Data Quality; RCM Review Cycle Standards; Infor EAM Catalog Management

attributes.name: reviewed_by

attributes.references: ISO 14224 Data Quality Management; SOX Internal Controls; Infor EAM Catalog Approval Workflow

attributes.name: safety_risk_flag

attributes.name: severity_level

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Maintenance planning requires defining which asset classes require specific maintenance types (PM schedules, DOT inspections, EPA compliance checks). The text field 'asset_class_applicability' should

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Maintenance types (DOT inspection, EPA-required equipment check, OSHA-mandated inspection) are defined by specific regulatory requirements. regulatory_authority is a denormalized field that should be

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether work orders of this maintenance type require supervisory or management approval before execution (True) or can be executed without prior approval (False). Drives approval workflow routing in SAP PM and Infor EAM for cost control and compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; Infor EAM; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Internal Controls

attributes.name: approval_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Minimum estimated cost in US dollars above which a work order of this maintenance type requires management approval. Supports tiered authorization controls for maintenance spend in compliance with SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Internal Audit Controls

attributes.name: avg_labor_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard average labor cost for a maintenance activity of this type, expressed in US dollars. Derived from technician labor rates and estimated duration. Used for work order cost estimation, maintenance budget planning, and COGS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; Infor EAM; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: avg_parts_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard average cost of parts and materials consumed for a maintenance activity of this type, expressed in US dollars. Used for maintenance budget planning, work order cost estimation, and BOM cost benchmarking in SAP MM and Infor EAM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Infor EAM; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: cost_category_code
attributes.description: Maps this maintenance type to a cost accounting category in SAP FI/CO for GL posting and COGS allocation (e.g., PREV_MAINT, CORR_MAINT, EMER_MAINT, DOT_INSP, WARRANTY). Enables financial reporting by maintenance type and supports EBITDA analysis for fleet operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this maintenance type record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change management tracking per SOX and internal data governance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: default_priority_code
attributes.description: Default work order priority assigned when a work order is created under this maintenance type. Drives scheduling urgency, technician dispatch sequencing, and SLA compliance tracking. Can be overridden at the individual work order level.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: dot_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance type constitutes or includes a DOT-mandated vehicle inspection (True) or not (False). When True, triggers DOT inspection form completion, driver vehicle inspection report (DVIR) requirements, and out-of-service defect tracking per 49 CFR Part 396.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396; FMCSA Regulations; SAP EHS Module

attributes.name: eam_type_code
attributes.description: Native maintenance type code as defined in Infor EAM, used for system integration and data lineage tracing. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the Infor EAM CMMS source system.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle and Maintenance Scheduling

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this maintenance type classification becomes valid and available for use in work order and PM schedule creation. Supports versioning and phased rollout of new maintenance type definitions aligned with regulatory or operational changes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; ISO 55001; DOT Regulatory Updates

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard estimated labor hours required to complete a maintenance activity of this type. Used for technician scheduling, shift planning, and asset downtime forecasting. Serves as the default value populated on new work orders of this type in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; NWRA Fleet Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this maintenance type classification is no longer valid for new work order or PM schedule creation. Null indicates no expiration. Supports retirement of obsolete maintenance types while preserving historical records.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; ISO 55001; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: external_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether maintenance activities of this type are typically performed by an external vendor or contractor (True) rather than internal technicians (False). When True, triggers purchase order (PO) creation workflow in SAP MM for external service procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SAP PM Module; Infor EAM; DOT Contractor Compliance

attributes.name: failure_mode_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure mode and root cause analysis is required for work orders of this maintenance type (True) or not (False). When True, technicians must document failure codes, cause codes, and remediation actions in Infor EAM for reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; ISO 55001 Asset Management; RCM Standards

attributes.name: ghg_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether maintenance activities of this type generate reportable GHG emissions data (True) or not (False). Applicable for maintenance involving CNG/RNG fuel systems, LFG equipment, or WTE facility assets where EPA GHG reporting under the Clean Air Act is required.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act; EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98; ISO 14001; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger account code to which maintenance costs of this type are posted. Ensures accurate financial reporting, cost center allocation, and compliance with GAAP/IFRS standards for maintenance expense recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: loto_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) energy isolation procedures are required for maintenance activities of this type (True) or not (False). Mandatory safety control per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 for hazardous energy control during maintenance on fleet and facility equipment.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147; SAP EHS Module; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: max_allowable_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours an asset is permitted to remain out of service for maintenance of this type before escalation is triggered. Used to enforce SLA compliance for fleet availability and to drive escalation workflows in Infor EAM and AMCS dispatch.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; AMCS Platform; NWRA Fleet Availability Standards; SLA Management

attributes.name: meter_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the recurrence_interval_meter field, defining the measurement basis for meter-triggered PM schedules (e.g., miles for vehicle odometer, hours for engine runtime, cycles for lift/compaction cycles, tons for throughput-based equipment).
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP PM Module; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: planning_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days required to plan and prepare for a maintenance activity of this type before execution. Used by maintenance planners to schedule parts procurement, technician availability, and asset downtime windows. Sourced from Infor EAM PM cycle configuration.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP PM Module; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: pm_trigger_basis
attributes.description: Defines the basis on which PM schedules of this maintenance type are triggered: time-based (fixed calendar intervals), meter-based (mileage, engine hours, cycles), condition-based (sensor thresholds), event-based (after specific operational events), or calendar-based (fixed dates). Drives PM cycle configuration in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP PM Module; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory PPE items required for maintenance activities of this type (e.g., safety_glasses, gloves, hard_hat, hi_vis_vest, respirator). Populated on work orders to ensure technician safety compliance per OSHA PPE standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132; SAP EHS Module; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: recurrence_interval_days
attributes.description: Default calendar-based recurrence interval in days for PM schedules of this maintenance type. Used when pm_trigger_basis is 'time' or 'calendar'. Drives automatic PM work order generation in Infor EAM and SAP PM scheduling cycles.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP PM Module; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: recurrence_interval_meter
attributes.description: Default meter-based recurrence interval for PM schedules of this maintenance type (e.g., miles, engine hours, lift cycles). Used when pm_trigger_basis is 'meter'. The unit of measure is defined by meter_unit. Drives meter-based PM work order generation in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; SAP PM Module; DOT 49 CFR Part 396

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether maintenance activities of this type must be reported to a regulatory authority (True) or not (False). Triggers mandatory documentation workflows in Enviance EHS and SAP EHS for DOT inspections, EPA compliance events, and OSHA-required maintenance records.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 396; EPA Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; RCRA; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: required_certification_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific technician certification required to perform maintenance of this type (e.g., CDL_CLASS_A, ASE_MASTER, DOT_INSPECTOR, HAZMAT_HANDLER). Enforced during work order technician assignment in Infor EAM and Workday HCM. Applicable when requires_certified_technician is True.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; OSHA; ASE Certification Standards; Workday HCM

attributes.name: requires_asset_shutdown
attributes.description: Indicates whether maintenance of this type requires the asset (vehicle, equipment, or facility) to be taken out of service (True) or can be performed while the asset remains operational (False).
