attributes.references: ASTM D7611 Plastics Resin Identification Coding System; EPA Recycling Reporting

attributes.name: sort_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRF sorting line or processing stream assigned to this commodity (e.g., 'FIBER-1', 'PLASTIC-2', 'METAL-OCC'). Used by AMCS Platform for route-to-sort-line assignment and MRF equipment configuration. Supports throughput (TPD) reporting by sort line.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform MRF Operations Module; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: standard_bale_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Target or standard weight in pounds for a single bale of this commodity as produced by MRF baling equipment. Used for bale production planning, outbound load configuration, and weight-based pricing reconciliation with end-market buyers.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; NWRA Baling Standards; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: storage_requirement
attributes.description: Storage condition requirement for this commodity at the MRF prior to outbound shipment (e.g., indoor for paper to prevent moisture, hazmat_storage for hazardous commodities, outdoor for metals). Drives MRF facility layout planning and OSHA/EPA storage compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Storage Standards; EPA RCRA Storage Requirements; ISO 45001

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification within the material category providing finer segmentation (e.g., 'corrugated' within paper, 'PET bottles' within plastics, 'ferrous' within metals). Used for detailed MRF throughput reporting and commodity-specific market pricing.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: tclp_testing_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Testing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) testing is required for this commodity prior to disposal or sale. Applicable to commodities that may exhibit hazardous characteristics under RCRA. Triggers laboratory testing workflow in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261.24 TCLP; EPA Hazardous Waste Testing Methods; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure used for weighing, pricing, and reporting this commodity (e.g., ton for paper/metals, lb for small-volume materials, bale for pre-baled commodities). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure and Oracle Revenue Management pricing unit. Serves as the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE classification for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; NIST Weights and Measures; Oracle Revenue Management

products.name: commodity_grade
products.description: Reference table defining quality grade specifications for each commodity type processed at MRF facilities. Captures grade code, commodity reference, grade name (e.g., Grade A, Premium, Standard, Off-Grade), maximum allowable contamination percentage, moisture content threshold, minimum bale density (lbs/cubic ft), prohibited materials list, ISRI specification reference, and grade-specific market premium or discount factor. Used for quality control acceptance/rejection decisions and commodity sales pricing.

attributes.name: commodity_grade_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commodity grade specification record in the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) quality reference table. [REFERENCE_LOOKUP role — this is a reference/specification table defining grade standards; per canonical-attrs-enforced rule, REFERENCE_LOOKUP is exempt from per-role minimums. _canonical_skip_reason: commodity_grade is a reference lookup table defining quality grade specifications for MRF commodities; it has its own identity and lifecycle but functions as a standards reference, not a transactional or master-party entity.]
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.commodity. Business justification: commodity_grade defines quality specifications for a specific commodity type. Currently commodity_type and commodity_subtype are stored as denormalized strings on commodity_grade. Adding commodity_id

attributes.name: superseded_by_grade_commodity_grade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity_grade_id of the newer grade specification that replaces this record when a grade is deprecated or revised. Null if this is the current active version. Supports grade version lineage tracking and ensures operational systems transition to updated specifications.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Versioning; ISO 14001 Document Control

attributes.name: applicable_mrf_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or operational division for which this grade specification applies (e.g., 'Northeast', 'Southeast', 'National'). Some grade specifications may vary by region due to local buyer requirements or state recycling regulations. Null or 'National' indicates the grade applies enterprise-wide.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Department Recycling Regulations; SWANA Regional Operations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commodity grade specification was formally approved by the authorized quality manager or operations director. Required for quality management system documentation and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; SWANA MRF Quality Management; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the MRF quality manager or operations director who approved this grade specification for operational use. Required for quality management system compliance and audit trail. Sourced from Workday HCM employee records.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; SWANA MRF Quality Management

attributes.name: bale_dimension_spec
attributes.description: Required or target bale dimensions (length x width x height in inches) for this commodity grade as specified by buyers or ISRI standards (e.g., '60x30x48'). Ensures compatibility with buyer receiving equipment and maximizes trailer load efficiency. Used in baler setup configuration.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA Baling Operations Standards

attributes.name: buyer_acceptance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether material classified under this grade requires explicit buyer acceptance confirmation before outbound shipment. True for specialty or off-grade materials where buyers must pre-approve loads. False for standard grades with standing purchase agreements. Drives outbound logistics workflow in AMCS.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Outbound Operations; Commodity Sales Contract Management

attributes.name: co2e_avoided_per_ton
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Avoided per Ton
attributes.description: Estimated metric tons of CO2e greenhouse gas emissions avoided per ton of commodity recovered and sold at this grade, compared to virgin material production. Used for GHG emissions reporting, sustainability disclosures, and circular economy impact quantification. Sourced from EPA WARM (Waste Reduction Model) emission factors.
attributes.references: EPA WARM Model; GHG Protocol Scope 3 Reporting; ISO 14064 GHG Quantification; Clean Air Act

attributes.name: color_specification
attributes.description: Color or color mix specification required for this commodity grade (e.g., 'clear only', 'clear and green', 'mixed colors acceptable', 'brown only'). Primarily applicable to glass and PET plastic grades where color separation directly impacts end-market value and processing requirements at buyer facilities.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; Glass Packaging Institute Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity grade specification record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance documentation requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Document Control; GAAP Record Keeping

attributes.name: diversion_rate_credit
attributes.description: Indicates whether material sold under this commodity grade qualifies for diversion rate credit in EPA and state recycling program reporting. True for grades that represent genuine material recovery; False for off-grade or contaminated material routed to landfill or WTE. Impacts sustainability KPI reporting and circular economy goal tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Diversion Rate Reporting; State Environmental Quality Department Recycling Regulations; ISO 14001

attributes.name: domestic_export_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity grade is eligible for domestic sale only, export sale only, or both. Export eligibility is subject to Basel Convention restrictions on hazardous waste exports and country-specific import regulations. Drives market routing decisions in commodity sales management.
attributes.references: Basel Convention on Hazardous Waste; EPA Export Regulations; DOT International Shipping Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this commodity grade specification becomes effective and applicable for quality control acceptance/rejection decisions and commodity pricing. Enables versioned grade specifications to align with market condition changes or updated ISRI standards.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular (versioning); SAP MM Validity Periods

attributes.name: end_market_type
attributes.description: Type of end-market or buyer facility that typically purchases this commodity grade (e.g., 'paper mill', 'plastic reprocessor', 'aluminum smelter', 'glass beneficiator', 'steel mill', 'export broker'). Informs market development strategy and outbound logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paper_mill|plastic_reprocessor|aluminum_smelter|glass_beneficiator|steel_mill|export_broker|compost_facility|wte_facility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SWANA Commodity Markets Report; EPA Recycling Markets Development

attributes.name: epa_commodity_code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned commodity classification code used for federal recycling diversion rate reporting and Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) submissions. Enables accurate tracking of material recovery volumes by commodity type for regulatory compliance and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Advancing Sustainable Materials Management; EPA SWIS Reporting Requirements; Clean Air Act

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this commodity grade specification is no longer valid and must be superseded by a new version. Null indicates the grade specification is open-ended with no planned expiration. Supports versioned grade management when ISRI standards or buyer contract requirements change.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular (versioning); SAP MM Validity Periods

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the commodity grade specification (e.g., OCC-A, PET-1, ALU-P). Used as the externally-known business identifier in SAP MM material master, AMCS commodity tracking, and buyer purchase orders. Aligns with ISRI commodity grade coding conventions.
attributes.references: Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries (ISRI) Scrap Specifications Circular; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: grade_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the commodity grade specification (e.g., 'Grade A Old Corrugated Containers', 'Premium Clear PET', 'Standard Mixed Paper', 'Off-Grade Aluminum'). Used in quality control reports, buyer contracts, and MRF operational dashboards.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA MRF Best Practices

attributes.name: grade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commodity grade specification. Active grades are in use for quality control and pricing. Inactive grades are suspended from use. Deprecated grades have been superseded by updated specifications. Under Review grades are pending revision approval. Controls whether the grade is available for selection in MRF quality control workflows.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Status Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: grade_tier
attributes.description: Quality tier classification of the grade specification indicating relative market value and purity level. Premium and Grade A command market premiums; Standard meets baseline buyer requirements; Off-Grade triggers price discounts; Rejected material is non-saleable and requires alternative disposition. Drives pricing factor application in Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity grade involves or may contain hazardous materials subject to RCRA, DOT, or EPA hazardous waste regulations. True triggers mandatory hazardous waste handling protocols, manifest documentation requirements, and TSDF routing. Integrates with Enviance EHS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C Hazardous Waste Regulations; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; EPA CERCLA

attributes.name: isri_spec_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries (ISRI) Specification Reference
attributes.description: Official ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular grade designation code that this internal grade maps to (e.g., 'ISRI-11' for OCC, 'ISRI-600' for Aluminum Cans). Enables standardized communication with commodity buyers, brokers, and end-markets. Required for export commodity sales documentation.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular (current edition); EPA Recycling Markets

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity grade specification record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale specifications, trigger review workflows, and maintain data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Document Control

attributes.name: market_price_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative premium or discount factor applied to the base commodity market price for this grade (e.g., 1.15 = 15% premium for Premium grade; 0.85 = 15% discount for Off-Grade; 1.00 = no adjustment for Standard). Used in Oracle Revenue Management to calculate commodity sale prices and MRF revenue projections.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Pricing Rules; SWANA Commodity Market Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: max_bale_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum allowable bale weight in pounds for this commodity grade. Ensures compliance with DOT weight regulations for transport and safe handling limits for forklift and loading equipment. Bales exceeding this limit require splitting before outbound shipment.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 393 Vehicle Weight Regulations; OSHA Material Handling Standards

attributes.name: max_contamination_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of non-target or prohibited materials allowable in a bale or load for this grade to be accepted by buyers (e.g., 2.00 for Grade A OCC = max 2% contamination). Exceeding this threshold triggers grade downgrade or rejection. Used in MRF quality control acceptance/rejection decisions and contamination tracking.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA MRF Contamination Standards; EPA Recycling Program Guidelines

attributes.name: max_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content percentage for this commodity grade. Excess moisture reduces commodity value, increases transport weight, and can cause material degradation. Measured at bale production or outbound load inspection. Critical for paper and fiber grades where moisture directly impacts pulp mill acceptance.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; TAPPI Moisture Testing Standards; SWANA MRF Best Practices

attributes.name: max_particle_size_inches
attributes.description: Maximum allowable individual particle or item size in inches for material classified under this grade. Oversized items can damage processing equipment at end-market facilities and may trigger load rejection. Particularly relevant for glass, metal, and plastic grades.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA MRF Equipment Specifications

attributes.name: min_bale_density_lbs_per_cuft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Bale Density (lbs per cubic ft)
attributes.description: Minimum required bale density in pounds per cubic foot for this commodity grade. Ensures structural integrity during transport and storage, and maximizes trailer payload efficiency. Bales failing density requirements may be rejected by buyers or require re-baling. Monitored via baler equipment sensors integrated with AMCS.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA Baling Operations Standards

attributes.name: min_purity_pct
attributes.description: Minimum required percentage of the target commodity material in a bale or load for this grade classification (e.g., 98.00 for Premium Aluminum = minimum 98% pure aluminum content). Complements the contamination threshold by specifying the positive purity floor rather than the negative contamination ceiling.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; SWANA MRF Quality Standards

attributes.name: min_sample_size_lbs
attributes.description: Minimum weight in pounds of material sample required for quality control testing under this grade specification. Ensures statistical validity of contamination and purity measurements. Applies when sort_purity_test_method is grab_sample or full_sort.
attributes.references: ASTM D5231 Standard Test Method; SWANA MRF Quality Control Procedures

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, buyer-specific requirements, special handling instructions, or clarifications related to this commodity grade specification. May include references to specific buyer contracts, seasonal market conditions, or equipment-specific processing notes.

attributes.name: prohibited_materials
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of materials explicitly prohibited from inclusion in this commodity grade (e.g., 'food waste, hazardous materials, medical waste, batteries, Styrofoam, plastic bags'). Any presence of prohibited materials may result in load rejection, buyer chargebacks, or regulatory violations. Referenced during MRF sorting quality audits and inbound load inspections.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; RCRA Hazardous Waste Regulations; EPA Recycling Contamination Guidelines

attributes.name: rejection_disposition
attributes.description: Default disposition action for material that fails to meet this grade specification. Landfill routes rejected material to disposal; Reprocess returns material to the MRF sorting line; Downgrade reclassifies to a lower grade; Return to Sender sends contaminated loads back to the collection route origin; WTE (Waste-to-Energy) routes to energy recovery. Drives operational workflow in AMCS.
attributes.references: EPA Solid Waste Disposal Regulations; SWANA MRF Operations; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: requires_lab_testing
attributes.description: Indicates whether material classified under this grade requires laboratory analysis (e.g., TCLP — Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure testing, moisture analysis, or purity assay) before sale or shipment. True for grades with strict purity or regulatory requirements. Triggers lab sample workflow in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: EPA TCLP Testing Requirements (40 CFR Part 261); RCRA; Enviance EHS

attributes.name: sort_purity_test_method
attributes.description: Quality control testing method used to verify that a bale or load meets this grade specification. Visual Sort is a manual inspector review; Grab Sample is a representative sample extraction; Full Sort is complete material separation and weighing; Lab Analysis is laboratory chemical or physical testing; Automated Sensor uses optical or NIR sorting equipment data.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Quality Control Procedures; ASTM D5231 Standard Test Method for Composition of Unprocessed MSW

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this commodity grade specification record. Incremented each time the grade specification is revised (e.g., contamination threshold updated, ISRI reference changed). Enables audit trail of specification changes and ensures quality control decisions reference the correct version.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Management; SWANA MRF Quality Management Systems; ISO 14001 Document Control

products.name: sort_session
products.description: Transactional record of a discrete sorting production session on a MRF sort line. Captures session start and end timestamps, sort line reference, shift reference, supervisor ID, total input tonnage processed, throughput rate (TPH), downtime minutes, downtime reason codes, number of sort station operators, material stream composition at input, and session status (active, completed, aborted). Supports operational throughput (TPD) reporting and labor productivity analysis.

attributes.name: sort_session_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a discrete sorting production session on a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) sort line. Primary key for this transactional record.

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: Compliance inspections often observe active sort sessions to verify operational compliance with permit conditions (throughput rates, contamination handling, safety protocols). Links inspection observa

attributes.name: downtime_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Links sort session downtime events to the maintenance work order that resolved the equipment failure. Critical for downtime root cause analysis, throughput loss calculation, and maintenance response t

attributes.name: ehs_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ehs_incident. Business justification: sort_session has safety_incident_flag indicating an EHS incident occurred during the session. A direct FK to ehs_incident enables OSHA recordkeeping, root cause analysis, and regulatory reporting by l

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) where this sort session took place. Supports multi-facility throughput reporting and EPA recycling reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.mrf_facility. Business justification: A sort session occurs on a sort line within a specific MRF facility. sort_session already has facility_id → asset.facility (cross-domain) and sort_line_id → sort_line, but lacks the direct in-domain l

attributes.name: sort_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific MRF sort line on which this session was conducted. Links to the sort line master resource in the asset management domain.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Sort sessions with hazardous_material_flag=true require RCRA waste code classification for regulatory disposal routing and RCRA biennial reporting. Environmental Services compliance officers expect so

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.waste_stream. Business justification: Sort sessions process specific waste streams. material_stream_type is a plain-text denormalization of service.waste_stream. This FK enables throughput and recovery rate reporting by waste stream for o

attributes.name: abort_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for premature session termination when session_status is 'aborted'. Captures operational context not covered by downtime_reason_code. Null for completed or active sessions.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM — Work Order Management

attributes.name: bale_count
attributes.description: Total number of commodity bales produced during this sort session across all material types. Used for outbound commodity inventory management in SAP MM and baler productivity tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM — Commodity Inventory; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: contamination_input_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the inbound material stream classified as contamination (non-recyclable materials, food waste, hazardous items) at session start. High contamination rates impact commodity quality grades and residue tonnage. Key metric for EPA recycling diversion rate reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: contamination_rate_pct
attributes.description: Measured contamination rate percentage of the recovered commodity output after sorting, as determined by quality control sampling. Distinct from inbound contamination percentage; reflects sort line effectiveness. Used for commodity buyer compliance and quality control reporting.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sort session record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance — Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: diversion_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total input tonnage successfully diverted from landfill disposal through recovery of recyclable commodities during this session. Calculated as (recovered_tonnage / input_tonnage) * 100. Core EPA recycling reporting metric and circular economy KPI.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; RCRA Subtitle D; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: downtime_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes of non-productive downtime recorded during this sort session due to equipment failure, material jams, safety stops, or scheduled breaks. Used for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) analysis and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: downtime_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code categorizing the primary cause of downtime during this sort session. Used for root cause analysis, maintenance scheduling, and operational improvement initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|material_jam|safety_stop|scheduled_maintenance|operator_shortage|power_outage|quality_hold|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Maintenance Scheduling; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sort session officially ended (completed or aborted). Null if the session is still active or paused. Used to calculate session duration and throughput rates.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform — Sort Line Operations; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: equipment_fault_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mechanical or electrical equipment fault was recorded during this sort session. When True, triggers a Work Order (WO) in Infor EAM for corrective maintenance. Supports equipment reliability and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: glass_input_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the inbound material stream composed of glass commodities at session start. Used for commodity recovery planning and glass processing equipment configuration.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous or prohibited materials (e.g., sharps, household hazardous waste, RCRA-regulated items) were detected in the inbound material stream during this session. When True, triggers hazardous waste handling protocols per RCRA and EPA requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C — Hazardous Waste; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: input_tonnage
attributes.description: Total weight in short tons of inbound material received and processed during this sort session. Core metric for Tons Per Day (TPD) throughput reporting and EPA recycling diversion rate calculations.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: metal_input_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the inbound material stream composed of metal commodities (aluminum, steel, ferrous, non-ferrous) at session start. Used for commodity recovery planning and eddy current separator configuration.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supervisor or operator notes capturing operational observations, material quality issues, equipment anomalies, or other contextual information not captured in structured fields. Used for operational review and continuous improvement.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; AMCS Platform — Sort Line Operations

attributes.name: operator_count
attributes.description: Number of sort station operators assigned and actively working during this sort session. Used for labor productivity analysis (tons per operator per hour) and staffing optimization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Workforce Planning; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: paper_input_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the inbound material stream composed of paper and fiber commodities (OCC, ONP, mixed paper) at session start. Used for commodity recovery planning and sort line configuration.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: plastic_input_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the inbound material stream composed of plastic commodities (PET, HDPE, mixed plastics) at session start. Used for commodity recovery planning and sort line configuration.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: qc_sample_count
attributes.description: Number of quality control samples taken during this sort session to assess commodity purity and contamination levels. Supports statistical validity of contamination rate measurements and MRF quality assurance programs.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Overall quality grade assigned to the commodity output of this sort session based on contamination levels and commodity purity. Drives commodity pricing and market acceptance. 'off_spec' indicates material outside buyer specifications; 'rejected' indicates material refused by commodity buyer.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; EPA Recycling Reporting

attributes.name: recovered_tonnage
attributes.description: Total weight in short tons of all recovered recyclable commodities (paper, plastics, metals, glass) produced during this sort session. Used for diversion rate calculation and commodity inventory reconciliation in SAP MM.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; RCRA Subtitle D; SAP MM — Commodity Inventory

attributes.name: residue_tonnage
attributes.description: Total weight in short tons of non-recoverable residue (contamination and non-recyclable material) sent to landfill disposal after sorting. Used to calculate the diversion rate and residue rate for EPA reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; RCRA Subtitle D; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety incident (injury, near-miss, or OSHA recordable event) occurred during this sort session. When True, triggers linkage to an incident record in Enviance EHS. Supports OSHA 300 log reporting and safety performance tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 — Recordkeeping; Enviance EHS — Incident Management; ISO 45001

attributes.name: session_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the sort session occurred. Used for daily Tons Per Day (TPD) aggregation, EPA recycling reporting, and operational scheduling alignment.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: session_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from session start to session end, including both active processing time and downtime periods. Used for labor cost allocation and shift utilization analysis.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Workday HCM — Labor Reporting

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the sort session, used in operational reporting, shift logs, and AMCS platform references. Format: SS-YYYY-MM-DD-NNNN.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform — Sort Line Operations; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sort session. 'active' indicates the session is in progress; 'completed' indicates normal closure; 'aborted' indicates premature termination due to equipment failure, safety event, or operational decision; 'paused' indicates a temporary halt; 'pending' indicates scheduled but not yet started.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform — Sort Line Operations; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sort session by operational purpose. 'standard' is a normal production run; 'trial' is a test run for new material streams; 'calibration' is a quality calibration run; 'training' is a supervised training session for new operators.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work shift during which this sort session occurred. Used for labor cost allocation, productivity benchmarking across shifts, and workforce scheduling analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Workforce Planning; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: sort_line_speed_fpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sort Line Belt Speed (Feet Per Minute)
attributes.description: Operational belt conveyor speed in feet per minute (FPM) at which the sort line was configured for this session. Affects throughput rate and operator sorting effectiveness. Used for equipment performance analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Lifecycle; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this sort session record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. 'AMCS' indicates AMCS Platform; 'SAP' indicates SAP S/4HANA; 'MANUAL' indicates manual data entry.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance — Data Lineage

attributes.name: source_system_session_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this sort session record in the originating operational system (e.g., AMCS session ID, SAP production order number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Waste Management Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance — Data Lineage

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sort session officially commenced, representing the principal real-world business event time. Used for throughput rate calculations, shift alignment, and operational KPI reporting.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform — Sort Line Operations; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: throughput_rate_tph
attributes.description: Processing throughput rate measured in tons per hour (TPH) for this sort session. Calculated as input tonnage divided by active processing time. Key operational KPI for sort line efficiency and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sort session record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data reconciliation, and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance — Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

products.name: contamination_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing material quality analysis events during MRF operations — including contamination detection and full material composition audits. Captures event timestamp, inbound load or sort session reference, analysis type (contamination check, full composition audit, NIR scan), material breakdown by category (fiber, plastics, metals, glass, organics, contaminants) as weight percentages, contamination level and type classification, detection method, disposition action, inspector/analyst ID, photographic evidence, and source attribution for generator feedback. Supports contamination trending, diversion rate accuracy, EPA material-specific reporting, and customer education programs.

attributes.name: contamination_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contamination event record. Primary key for the contamination event entity.

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: Contamination events involving DOT-regulated hazardous materials (compressed gas cylinders, flammables, corrosives in recycling stream) require DOT hazmat classification for emergency response procedu

attributes.name: ehs_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ehs_incident. Business justification: Contamination events involving hazardous materials, worker exposure, or environmental release are EHS incidents requiring OSHA recordkeeping and EPA reporting. Links material stream contamination to s

attributes.name: generator_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generator Epa Id Registration Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: EPA-reportable contamination events at MRFs require documented generator EPA ID for regulatory reporting under RCRA. When hazardous materials are detected in recyclable streams, generator identificati

attributes.name: inbound_load_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound material load being analyzed. Links to the specific delivery or collection batch that entered the MRF.

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the MRF facility where the contamination event was detected.

attributes.name: regulatory_corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_corrective_action. Business justification: Contamination events triggering violation notices require documented regulatory corrective actions. This link enables environmental compliance staff to track which corrective action was mandated by ea

attributes.name: route_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.route_execution. Business justification: Contamination root-cause analysis requires tracing a contamination event to the specific route execution that delivered the offending load. Driver accountability reports, SLA breach investigations, an

attributes.name: sort_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sorting session during which the contamination event was identified. Used when analysis occurs during active sorting operations.

attributes.name: source_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collection route from which the contaminated material originated. Enables geographic contamination trending.

attributes.name: special_waste_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to landfill.special_waste_approval. Business justification: Contamination events identifying hazardous or special waste in recyclable streams trigger a landfill special_waste_approval request. Regulators and environmental managers require this link to trace co

attributes.name: stop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collection.collection_stop. Business justification: Contamination events must be traced to the specific customer/address (collection stop) for customer notification, repeat-offender tracking, and recycling education programs. Waste Management's contami

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: Severe contamination events involving hazardous materials or prohibited waste trigger regulatory violation notices from EPA or state agencies. Links contamination incidents to enforcement actions, pen

attributes.name: waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Contamination events with epa_reportable=true involving hazardous materials (HHW, e-waste) must be classified under RCRA waste codes for EPA regulatory reporting and proper disposal routing. Complianc

attributes.name: waste_generator_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the waste generator (customer account) that produced the contaminated material. Used for customer education and feedback programs.

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.waste_stream. Business justification: Contamination events are classified by the waste stream in which contamination was detected. This link enables contamination rate reporting by stream type, drives customer education program targeting,

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Type of material quality analysis performed. Contamination check focuses on non-recyclable content; full composition audit provides complete material breakdown; NIR scan uses near-infrared technology for automated detection.

attributes.name: commodity_value_loss_usd
attributes.description: Estimated revenue loss due to reduced commodity quality or rejected material, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: contaminants_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of non-recyclable contaminants (trash, hazardous materials, textiles, electronics) in the sample by weight. Primary metric for contamination rate tracking.

attributes.name: contamination_level
attributes.description: Categorical classification of contamination severity based on percentage thresholds. Acceptable: <5%, Moderate: 5-10%, High: 10-20%, Severe: 20-30%, Rejected: >30%.

attributes.name: contamination_type
attributes.description: Primary category of contaminant material detected. Tanglers refer to items like hoses, cords, and plastic bags that jam sorting equipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trash|organics|hazardous|electronics|textiles|construction_debris|medical_waste|batteries|propane_tanks|tanglers — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contamination event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source generator was notified about the contamination event for education and corrective action purposes.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method or equipment used to detect the contamination. Indicates whether detection was manual, automated, or triggered by external feedback.

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Action taken on the contaminated load or material. Determines whether material proceeds through MRF processing or is diverted.

attributes.name: diversion_impact_tons
attributes.description: Estimated tonnage impact on facility diversion rate due to this contamination event. Negative value indicates material diverted to landfill instead of recycling.

attributes.name: epa_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contamination event must be included in EPA recycling and diversion rate reporting.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contamination event was detected and recorded. Represents the actual moment of detection during MRF operations.

attributes.name: fiber_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of fiber materials (paper, cardboard, newsprint) in the sample by weight. Key commodity category for MRF revenue and EPA recycling reporting.

attributes.name: glass_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of glass materials (clear, green, brown) in the sample by weight. Tracked separately due to processing challenges and market constraints.

attributes.name: metals_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of metal materials (aluminum, steel, tin) in the sample by weight. High-value commodity category for MRF operations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contamination event record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the contamination event, specific contaminants observed, or operational impacts.

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when customer notification was sent regarding the contamination event.

attributes.name: organics_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of organic materials (food waste, yard waste, compostables) in the sample by weight. Considered contamination in single-stream recycling.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to photographic documentation of the contamination event. Used for customer education, training, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: plastics_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of plastic materials (PET, HDPE, PP, film) in the sample by weight. Includes all resin types recovered at the MRF.

attributes.name: processing_cost_impact_usd
attributes.description: Estimated additional processing cost incurred due to contamination, including labor, equipment downtime, and disposal fees, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: sample_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of the material sample analyzed, measured in pounds. Used to calculate contamination rates and material composition percentages.

products.name: bale
products.description: Master record for each commodity bale produced at a MRF facility, including production details and quality inspection history. Captures bale identity (barcode/RFID), commodity type, grade assignment, production timestamp, sort line and baler reference, physical measurements (weight, dimensions, density), operator ID, storage location, and bale lifecycle status (in-storage, allocated, shipped, rejected). Includes quality inspection records: inspection type (production QC, pre-shipment, buyer-requested), measured contamination and moisture percentages, pass/fail result, rejection reasons, and re-inspection flags. SSOT for bale identity, traceability from production through shipment, and quality certification.
products.reference: MRF Bale Record / RFID Bale Tag

attributes.name: bale_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each commodity bale produced at a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF). Primary key for the bale master record. MASTER_RESOURCE role — serves as the globally unique surrogate key for bale identity, traceability, and lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Program Guidelines

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity buyer or end-market customer who purchased or is contracted to receive this bale. Links bale to buyer account for sales order management, buyer-specific quality specification enforcement, and market channel analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account Management; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: commodity_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.commodity_grade. Business justification: Each bale is assigned a quality grade at production or inspection. bale currently stores grade as a denormalized string. Adding commodity_grade_id FK links the bale to the authoritative grade specific

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.commodity. Business justification: A bale is produced from a specific commodity type (paper, plastic, metal, glass). bale currently stores commodity_type and commodity_subtype as denormalized strings. Adding commodity_id FK normalizes

attributes.name: commodity_sale_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound commodity sales order to which this bale has been allocated or shipped. Null when bale is in-storage or unallocated. Links bale to revenue recognition in SAP SD and Oracle Revenue Management.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales and Distribution; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility where this bale was produced. Links bale production to the originating facility for throughput reporting, diversion rate calculations, and EPA recycling reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Program Guidelines; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: inbound_load_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound material receiving load or manifest from which the commodity in this bale originated. Enables full traceability from inbound collection route through MRF processing to outbound commodity sale. Supports diversion rate calculations and material flow analytics.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Traceability Requirements; AMCS Platform Route Management; SWANA MRF Standards

attributes.name: mrf_equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the baler machine that produced this bale. Supports equipment performance monitoring, preventive maintenance scheduling, and bale quality correlation with specific baler units via Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; SWANA MRF Equipment Standards

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.mrf_facility. Business justification: A bale is produced at a specific MRF facility. bale already has facility_id → asset.facility (cross-domain) but lacks the in-domain mrf_facility_id link. This FK enables MRF-level bale inventory repor

attributes.name: sort_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sorting line within the MRF where the commodity was processed and separated prior to baling. Used for equipment performance tracking and throughput analysis by sort line.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: sort_session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.sort_session. Business justification: A bale is produced during a specific sort session. bale already has sort_line_id but lacks the sort_session_id that identifies the production session. This FK enables traceability from bale back to th

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated storage bay, pad, or warehouse location within the MRF where this bale is currently stored. Supports inventory management, FIFO rotation, and outbound logistics planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM Inventory Management; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Contaminated bales exceeding commodity grade specifications and containing hazardous constituents require waste profiling before disposal or specialized treatment. Real business process: rejected bale

attributes.name: allocated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bale was allocated to a specific sales order or outbound shipment. Marks the transition from in_storage to allocated lifecycle status. Used for inventory turnover analysis and order fulfillment lead time tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales and Distribution; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Human-readable barcode label affixed to the bale for physical identification and scanning during storage, quality inspection, and outbound shipment. Printed at time of production and scanned at each lifecycle checkpoint.
attributes.references: GS1 Barcode Standards; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number assigned to the outbound shipment carrying this bale. The BOL is the primary freight transport document required by DOT regulations. Null until bale is loaded for shipment. Enables shipment tracking and dispute resolution with commodity buyers.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Freight Documentation; UCC Article 7 Bills of Lading; SAP SD Transportation

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique quality certification document number issued for this bale upon passing inspection, confirming it meets the specified commodity grade and buyer quality requirements. Required for certain commodity buyers and export shipments. Null if no formal certification was issued.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; Export Commodity Certification Requirements

attributes.name: contamination_pct
attributes.description: Measured percentage of non-target or non-recyclable material (contaminants) present in the bale, expressed as a percentage of total bale weight. Determined during quality inspection. Exceeding buyer-specified contamination thresholds results in grade downgrade, price deduction, or rejection. Key MRF quality KPI.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Quality Guidelines; ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; Buyer Contract Specifications

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bale record was first created in the system, typically at the moment of bale production completion. Serves as the audit trail creation timestamp for data lineage, Silver layer ingestion tracking, and SOX compliance recordkeeping.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Records

attributes.name: days_in_storage
attributes.description: Number of days this bale has been in MRF storage since production. Tracked to manage inventory aging, prioritize FIFO shipment sequencing, and identify slow-moving commodity inventory that may be subject to quality degradation or market price risk. Updated daily.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; SAP MM Inventory Aging

attributes.name: density_kg_per_m3
attributes.description: Calculated density of the bale expressed as kilograms per cubic meter, derived from weight and physical dimensions. Indicates baler compression performance and material compaction ratio. Low density may signal baler maintenance needs or loose material feed. Used for baler performance KPI tracking.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Equipment Performance Standards; Infor EAM Asset Performance

attributes.name: estimated_value_usd
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of this bale in USD, calculated as weight in tons multiplied by the applicable commodity market price per ton. Used for MRF commodity inventory valuation, revenue forecasting, and financial reporting in SAP FI/CO. Not a final invoiced amount — actual sale price is recorded on the sales order.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Financial Reporting; Oracle Revenue Management; GAAP Inventory Valuation Standards

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height dimension of the bale in centimeters as measured at production. Combined with length and width for volume calculation, stacking safety assessment, and storage bay capacity planning.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Storage Safety

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent quality inspection for this bale. Pass indicates the bale meets all applicable grade and buyer specifications; fail results in rejection or rework; conditional pass indicates the bale is accepted with noted deviations that are within buyer tolerance.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Quality Assurance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Buyer Contract Specifications

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the most recent quality inspection was performed on this bale. Used for inspection age tracking, pre-shipment inspection validity windows, and audit trail for quality certification documentation.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Quality Assurance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of quality inspection performed on this bale. Production QC is conducted at time of baling; pre-shipment inspection occurs before loading; buyer-requested inspection is initiated by the commodity buyer; re-inspection follows a prior rejection or dispute. Determines inspection protocol and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Quality Assurance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Buyer Contract Specifications

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the bale in centimeters as measured at production. Used with width and height to calculate bale volume, verify baler performance, and plan trailer loading configurations for outbound commodity shipments.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; DOT Freight Dimension Requirements

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the bale within its lifecycle from production through disposition. In_storage: produced and available in MRF inventory; allocated: assigned to a sales order or shipment; shipped: loaded and departed facility; rejected: failed quality inspection and removed from saleable inventory; on_hold: pending re-inspection or buyer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; SAP MM Inventory Management

attributes.name: market_price_per_ton
attributes.description: Prevailing commodity market price per ton in USD at the time this bale was produced or allocated to a sales order. Captured for commodity inventory valuation, revenue forecasting, and market price trend analysis. Reflects spot market or contracted price depending on buyer agreement type.
attributes.references: ISRI Commodity Pricing Index; SAP MM Material Valuation; Oracle Revenue Management

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Measured moisture content of the bale expressed as a percentage of total bale weight. Excess moisture reduces net commodity value, increases transport weight without material value, and can cause mold or degradation in paper bales. Monitored against buyer moisture tolerance thresholds.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications Circular; Buyer Contract Specifications; SWANA MRF Quality Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, quality observations, or special handling instructions associated with this bale. Used by MRF operators and quality inspectors to document non-standard conditions not captured in structured fields (e.g., visible damage, unusual contamination type, buyer special instructions).

attributes.name: production_shift
attributes.description: MRF operating shift during which this bale was produced. Used for shift-level productivity analysis, quality trend analysis by shift, and workforce scheduling optimization. Correlates bale quality and throughput metrics to specific shift teams.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; Workday HCM Workforce Scheduling

attributes.name: production_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bale was ejected from the baler and production was completed. The principal business event timestamp for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Used for throughput calculations (Tons Per Day), shift productivity reporting, and bale age tracking for FIFO inventory management.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; EPA Recycling Throughput Reporting

attributes.name: reinspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bale requires a follow-up quality inspection, typically after remediation of a failed inspection, buyer dispute, or conditional pass with noted concerns. True triggers a re-inspection workflow in the MRF quality management process.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Quality Assurance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for bale rejection when inspection_result is fail or lifecycle_status is rejected. Common reasons include excessive contamination, moisture above threshold, broken wires, incorrect commodity mix, or bale integrity failure. Required for root cause analysis and MRF process improvement. Null when bale passes inspection.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Quality Assurance Standards; EPA Recycling Program Guidelines

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier embedded in or attached to the bale for automated tracking through MRF storage, loading dock, and outbound logistics. Enables real-time inventory visibility without manual scanning. Null if facility does not use RFID.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards (EPC Gen2); AMCS Platform Container Tracking

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bale was loaded onto an outbound transport vehicle and departed the MRF facility. Marks the transition to shipped lifecycle status. Used for inventory reconciliation, Bill of Lading (BOL) documentation, and commodity revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: SAP SD Shipping and Transportation; DOT Freight Documentation; GAAP Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bale record was most recently modified. Tracks lifecycle status changes, quality inspection updates, allocation events, and shipment confirmations. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture; ISO 14001 Environmental Records

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight of the bale in kilograms as measured by the baler scale or floor scale at time of production. The principal quantitative measurement for this resource. Used for Tons Per Day (TPD) throughput calculations, commodity inventory valuation, sales order fulfillment, and EPA recycling tonnage reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Recycling Tonnage Reporting; NIST Handbook 44 Weighing Standards; SWANA MRF Operations Standards

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width dimension of the bale in centimeters as measured at production. Combined with length and height for volume calculation, storage space planning, and trailer load optimization.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; DOT Freight Dimension Requirements

attributes.name: wire_count
attributes.description: Number of wire ties or strapping bands securing the bale. Standard bale configurations use 4, 5, or 6 wires depending on commodity type and baler model. Deviations from standard wire count may indicate bale integrity risk during transport and are flagged during quality inspection.
attributes.references: SWANA MRF Operations Standards; ISRI Bale Specification Guidelines

products.name: commodity_inventory
products.description: Operational inventory snapshot of recovered commodity bales held in MRF storage at any point in time. Captures facility reference, commodity reference, commodity grade, total bales on hand, total weight on hand (tons), storage location summary, oldest bale production date, average bale age (days), allocated quantity (committed to pending sales orders), available quantity, and last physical count date. Integrates with SAP MM material inventory for commodity stock management and financial valuation.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Stock / MRF Commodity Inventory

attributes.name: commodity_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity inventory snapshot record.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recovered commodity type (paper, plastics, metals, glass).

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility where the commodity inventory is held.

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.mrf_facility. Business justification: Commodity inventory is held at a specific MRF facility. commodity_inventory already has facility_id → asset.facility (cross-domain) and commodity_id → commodity (in-domain), but lacks the in-domain mr

attributes.name: allocated_bales
attributes.description: Number of bales committed to pending sales orders or customer allocations.

attributes.name: allocated_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight in tons of commodity inventory allocated to pending sales orders.

attributes.name: available_bales
attributes.description: Number of bales available for sale, calculated as total bales on hand minus allocated bales.

attributes.name: available_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight in tons of commodity inventory available for sale, calculated as total weight minus allocated weight.

attributes.name: average_bale_age_days
attributes.description: Average age in days of all bales in inventory, calculated from production date to snapshot date.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Representative batch or lot number for traceability of the commodity inventory, particularly for quality tracking.

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade classification of the recovered commodity bales based on contamination levels and material purity standards.
attributes.references: Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries (ISRI) Specifications

attributes.name: contamination_rate_percent
attributes.description: Average contamination rate percentage across all bales in inventory, indicating non-recyclable material content.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory snapshot record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the commodity inventory indicating availability for sale or operational restrictions.

attributes.name: inventory_turnover_days
attributes.description: Average number of days commodity inventory remains in storage before being sold, calculated over a rolling period.

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total financial valuation of the commodity inventory on hand based on current market pricing or standard cost.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Material Valuation, GAAP Inventory Accounting Standards

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed for this commodity at this facility.

attributes.name: last_quality_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality inspection or certification performed on this commodity inventory.

attributes.name: market_price_per_ton
attributes.description: Current market price per ton for this commodity grade, used for inventory valuation and sales pricing.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material master number for the commodity, used for integration with SAP MM inventory and financial systems.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity in tons for this commodity type at this facility.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the commodity inventory, including special handling instructions or quality observations.

attributes.name: oldest_bale_production_date
attributes.description: Production date of the oldest bale currently in inventory, used to track inventory aging and FIFO management.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the MRF facility for integration with SAP MM and FI/CO modules.

attributes.name: price_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the current market price per ton used for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: quality_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of quality certification or inspection for the commodity inventory against ISRI or customer specifications.

attributes.name: reorder_point_tons
attributes.description: Minimum inventory threshold in tons that triggers production planning or sales acceleration actions.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: Business date for which this inventory snapshot was captured, representing the inventory position as of end of day.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this inventory snapshot was captured from the source system.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total MRF storage capacity utilized by this commodity inventory.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Primary storage location or zone within the MRF where the commodity bales are stored.

attributes.name: total_bales_on_hand
attributes.description: Total count of commodity bales currently in MRF storage at the snapshot date.

attributes.name: total_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight of commodity inventory on hand measured in tons.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure used for commodity inventory tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure Master

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory snapshot record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for inventory valuation amount.

products.name: commodity_buyer
products.description: Master record for commodity buyers and end-market purchasers of recovered materials sold from MRF operations. Captures buyer company name, buyer type (domestic mill, export broker, reprocessor, direct end-user), primary contact name, contact phone, contact email, billing address, shipping address, preferred commodities list, buyer credit status, payment terms, preferred delivery method (FOB MRF, delivered), active/inactive status, and SAP vendor/customer account reference. SSOT for commodity buyer identity within the recycling domain.

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity buyer record. Primary key for the commodity buyer entity within the recycling domain.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buyer is currently active and eligible for commodity sales. True means active and available for transactions, False means inactive and excluded from sales processes.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the buyer's billing address including street number and street name. Used for invoicing and accounts receivable processing.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the buyer's billing address for suite, floor, or building information. Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for the buyer's billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the buyer's billing address.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the buyer's billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for the buyer's billing address. Uses standard postal abbreviations.

attributes.name: buyer_established_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this commodity buyer was first established. Used for buyer tenure analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the commodity buyer organization that purchases recovered materials from MRF operations.

attributes.name: buyer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commodity buyer based on their role in the recovered materials supply chain. Domestic mills process materials domestically, export brokers facilitate international sales, reprocessors transform materials into new feedstock, direct end-users consume materials in manufacturing, aggregators consolidate materials from multiple sources, and traders buy and resell commodities.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the buyer contact. Used for purchase orders, invoices, shipping notifications, and quality documentation.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the buyer contact. Used for order coordination, quality issues, and logistics communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity buyer record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance allowed for this buyer in USD. Used for credit risk management and sales order approval workflows.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit approval status of the buyer. Approved buyers can receive shipments on credit terms, suspended buyers require prepayment or letter of credit, declined buyers are not eligible for sales.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent commodity sale transaction with this buyer. Used to identify dormant buyer relationships and trigger reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_tons
attributes.description: Minimum shipment size in tons that the buyer will accept per order. Used for load planning and sales order validation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity buyer record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional buyer-specific information such as special handling requirements, preferred contact times, facility access instructions, or historical relationship context.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the number of days and conditions for payment (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, COD, Letter of Credit). Aligns with SAP FI payment terms master data.

attributes.name: preferred_commodities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of recovered material commodity types the buyer prefers to purchase (e.g., OCC, mixed paper, PET, HDPE, aluminum, ferrous metals, glass). Supports sales planning and material allocation decisions.

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_method
attributes.description: Buyer's preferred logistics arrangement. FOB MRF (Free On Board at Materials Recovery Facility) means buyer arranges transport, delivered means seller delivers to buyer facility, buyer pickup means buyer collects from MRF, third-party carrier means mutually agreed logistics provider.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the buyer organization responsible for commodity procurement and contract management.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buyer requires quality certification documentation (e.g., contamination reports, bale composition analysis) with each shipment. True means certification is mandatory, False means standard documentation suffices.
attributes.references: ISRI Quality Standards / Buyer Contract Terms

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: SAP SD customer master record number linking this commodity buyer to the enterprise sales and accounts receivable system. Primary reference for commodity sales orders and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: sap_vendor_number
attributes.description: SAP MM vendor master record number linking this commodity buyer to the enterprise procurement and accounts payable system. Used for purchase order and invoice reconciliation when buyer also supplies services or materials.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the buyer's shipping or delivery address. Used for logistics planning and Bill of Lading (BOL) documentation.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the buyer's shipping address for dock, gate, or facility-specific routing information.

attributes.name: shipping_city
attributes.description: City name for the buyer's shipping or receiving facility.

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the buyer's shipping destination. Critical for export compliance and international logistics.

attributes.name: shipping_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the buyer's shipping facility.

attributes.name: shipping_state_province
