attributes.description: State or province code for the buyer's shipping address.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Buyer organization's tax identification number (EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, or equivalent). Required for tax reporting and compliance with revenue recognition standards.

products.name: market_price
products.description: Reference record capturing current and historical commodity market prices used for MRF commodity sales valuation and revenue forecasting. Captures commodity reference, price effective date, price expiration date, price source (OBM — Official Board Markets, RISI, internal contract, spot market), price per ton (USD), price region (national, regional, local), currency code, and price type (spot, contract, index-linked). Supports commodity revenue management and diversion rate financial reporting.

attributes.name: market_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the market price record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the buyer organization in the customer master data. Links to Salesforce CRM or SAP SD customer accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM, SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: commodity_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.commodity_grade. Business justification: Market prices are grade-specific — OCC (Old Corrugated Cardboard) Grade A commands a different price than Grade B. market_price currently stores commodity_grade as a denormalized string. Adding commod

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recovered commodity (paper, plastics, metals, glass) for which this price applies. Links to the commodity master data managed in SAP MM.

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific MRF facility where this pricing applies. Some facilities may have different pricing based on location, processing capabilities, or local market conditions.
attributes.references: AMCS Platform Facility Master, SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: contamination_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base price to account for contamination levels in recovered materials. Values less than 1.0 indicate price reductions for contaminated loads. Critical for MRF quality control and revenue management.
attributes.references: ISRI Scrap Specifications, MRF Quality Standards

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the sales contract or pricing agreement governing this market price. Links to contract management system for terms and conditions.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this market price record. Supports audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market price record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency pricing for international commodity sales.

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: Incoterms delivery terms defining when risk and cost transfer from seller to buyer. FOB (Free On Board) means buyer arranges transport, delivered means seller delivers to buyer location, ex-works means buyer picks up at MRF, CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), CFR (Cost and Freight).

attributes.name: market_condition
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the current market condition for this commodity. Strong indicates high demand and rising prices, weak indicates oversupply and falling prices, volatile indicates rapid price fluctuations, stable indicates consistent pricing.
attributes.references: RISI Market Intelligence, OBM Market Commentary

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_tons
attributes.description: Minimum tonnage required for this price to apply. Buyers often require minimum loads for transportation efficiency. Measured in tons.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this market price record. Supports audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market price record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about this market price (e.g., special conditions, market commentary, quality requirements, negotiation details).

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date until payment is due. Standard terms are Net 30, Net 60, or Net 90 days. Impacts cash flow and accounts receivable management.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management, SAP FI AR

attributes.name: price_adjustment_frequency
attributes.description: How often this market price is reviewed and updated. Daily for spot markets, weekly or monthly for published indices, quarterly or annual for long-term contracts, as-published for index-linked pricing.

attributes.name: price_ceiling_per_ton_usd
attributes.description: Maximum price per ton in contract agreements. Protects buyer from extreme market spikes. Nullable if no ceiling is negotiated.

attributes.name: price_change_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in price compared to the previous pricing period. Positive values indicate price increases, negative values indicate decreases. Used for trend analysis and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: price_change_reason
attributes.description: Business explanation for significant price changes (e.g., increased demand from China, mill shutdowns, contamination issues, seasonal demand, transportation cost increases). Supports market intelligence and strategic planning.
attributes.references: RISI Market Intelligence, NWRA Market Reports

attributes.name: price_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this market price becomes effective and applicable for commodity sales transactions. Start of the pricing validity period.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management, SAP SD Pricing Procedure

attributes.name: price_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this market price expires and is no longer applicable. Nullable for open-ended pricing agreements. End of the pricing validity period.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management, SAP SD Pricing Procedure

attributes.name: price_floor_per_ton_usd
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed price per ton in contract agreements. Protects seller from extreme market downturns. Nullable if no floor is negotiated.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the market index this price is linked to (e.g., OBM #11 Mixed Paper, RISI North American Boxboard Index). Used for index-linked pricing agreements.

attributes.name: price_per_ton_usd
attributes.description: Market price per ton of the commodity in US Dollars. Core pricing metric for MRF commodity sales valuation and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management, GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: price_published_date
attributes.description: Date when this market price was published or announced by the pricing source (OBM, RISI, etc.). May differ from effective date for forward-looking pricing.
attributes.references: Official Board Markets (OBM), RISI Publication Dates

attributes.name: price_region
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the market price. National for US-wide pricing, regional for multi-state areas (northeast, southeast, midwest, southwest, west), or local for specific market areas. Commodity prices vary significantly by region due to transportation costs and local demand. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national|northeast|southeast|midwest|southwest|west|regional|local — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: price_region_code
attributes.description: Abbreviated code for the pricing region (e.g., NE for Northeast, MW for Midwest, SW for Southwest). Used for reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: Source of the market price data. OBM (Official Board Markets) for paper pricing, RISI for pulp and paper market intelligence, internal contract for negotiated customer agreements, spot market for current trading prices, broker quote, exchange index, or customer contract. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OBM|RISI|internal_contract|spot_market|broker_quote|exchange_index|customer_contract — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Official Board Markets (OBM), RISI Market Analytics

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this market price record. Active for currently applicable prices, expired for past prices, pending for future prices not yet effective, superseded for prices replaced by newer records, cancelled for withdrawn pricing.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management, SAP SD Pricing Status

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing mechanism. Spot for immediate market prices, contract for long-term agreement prices, index-linked for prices tied to a market index, negotiated for custom pricing, published for industry-published rates, average for calculated averages.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management, SAP SD Pricing Condition Type

attributes.name: transportation_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transportation costs are included in the price per ton. True if price includes delivery (delivered pricing), False if price is FOB (Free On Board) at MRF location.

products.name: commodity_sale
products.description: Transactional record of commodity sale transactions from a MRF to commodity buyers, including line-item detail for multi-commodity or multi-grade orders. Captures sale order number, sale date, facility reference, buyer reference, shipment method, sale status, payment terms, BOL number, and SAP SD reference. Line items capture commodity type, grade, bale count, net weight (tons), unit price (USD/ton), line total value, and bale ID references. Supports single-commodity and multi-commodity sale orders with full commodity-level revenue tracking, pricing reconciliation against market indices, and integration with billing domain for invoicing.

attributes.name: commodity_sale_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity sale transaction. Primary key for the commodity sale record.

attributes.name: buyer_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master commodity sales contract or agreement governing this transaction. Links to contract terms and pricing schedules.

attributes.name: commodity_buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity buyer organization purchasing the recovered materials. Links to customer or vendor master data.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.commodity. Business justification: A commodity sale transaction is for a specific commodity type. commodity_sale currently has no commodity_id, requiring an indirect path through recycling_buyer_contract to determine the commodity. Add

attributes.name: market_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recycling.market_price. Business justification: A commodity sale is priced using a specific market price record. commodity_sale currently has market_index_reference as a string but no direct FK to market_price. Adding market_price_id FK enables dir

attributes.name: mrf_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRF facility where the commodity was processed and from which the sale originated.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: Export sales of recyclable commodities require EPA export notifications and international shipment declarations under RCRA and Basel Convention. Links commodity sales to regulatory export reporting wo

attributes.name: adjustment_amount_usd
attributes.description: Any price adjustments, discounts, or surcharges applied to the sale in USD. Can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number documenting the shipment of commodity materials. Legal document for transportation and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: contamination_rate_percent
attributes.description: Overall contamination rate percentage for the commodity materials in this sale. Affects pricing and buyer acceptance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the commodity sale record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the sale transaction. Typically USD for domestic US operations.

attributes.name: destination_address

products.name: program_facility_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational Contract/Assignment between a recycling_program and an mrf_facility. It captures the specific terms and operational parameters governing how a given recycling program's inbound recyclable loads are processed at a specific MRF facility. Each record links one recycling_program to one mrf_facility and carries attributes — processing priority, tonnage allocation, diversion target, and tipping fee rate — that exist only in the context of this specific program-facility pairing and cannot be correctly stored on either the program or the facility alone.. Existence Justification: In Waste Management's recycling operations, a single recycling program (e.g., a regional municipal curbside program) can be processed across multiple MRF facilities — particularly for large regional programs that span service areas served by different MRFs. Conversely, each MRF facility processes inbound recyclables from multiple distinct recycling programs simultaneously (municipal, commercial, drop-off, special events). The business actively manages these program-facility assignments with operational attributes such as processing priority, tonnage allocation, and diversion targets that are specific to each program-facility pairing, not to either entity alone.

attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the facility location (e.g., USA). Supports multi-country enterprise reporting and regulatory framework determination.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County in which the landfill facility is located. Critical for determining applicable local solid waste authority jurisdiction, host community agreement obligations, and county-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authorities; SWANA Regional Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the landfill site master record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Record Management

attributes.name: ghg_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is subject to mandatory greenhouse gas (GHG) reporting under EPA 40 CFR Part 98 (Subpart HH for MSW landfills). Facilities exceeding the 25,000 metric ton CO2e threshold must report annually. Drives GHG data collection workflows in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98 Subpart HH); Clean Air Act (CAA); ISO 14001

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is subject to groundwater monitoring requirements under RCRA Subtitle D or state permit conditions. Drives scheduling of monitoring well sampling events and Enviance EHS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart E); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: host_community_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the host community agreement (HCA) between the facility operator and the local municipality. HCAs govern tipping fee sharing, traffic mitigation, odor controls, and community benefit obligations. Links to contract management records in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Local Solid Waste Authorities; SWANA Host Community Agreement Guidelines

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the landfill facility centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for geospatial analysis, route optimization, emergency response, and environmental monitoring zone mapping.
attributes.references: GPS/WGS84 Standard; EPA Facility Geolocation Requirements

attributes.name: lea_name
attributes.description: Name of the Local Enforcement Agency (LEA) responsible for routine inspection and enforcement at the facility. In California and other states, LEAs are county-level agencies delegated enforcement authority by the state. Required for compliance contact management and inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments; CalRecycle LEA Program; SWANA LEA Standards

attributes.name: leachate_management_type
attributes.description: Type of leachate collection and management system installed at the facility. Leachate is the liquid that drains through the waste mass and must be managed to prevent groundwater contamination. Drives operational costs, permit conditions, and Clean Water Act (CWA) compliance obligations.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); Clean Water Act (CWA) NPDES Permit Requirements

attributes.name: lfg_collection_system
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active landfill gas (LFG) collection and control system is installed at the facility. LFG systems capture methane for waste-to-energy (WTE) or renewable natural gas (RNG) conversion, and are required under EPA New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) for qualifying facilities. Drives Clean Air Act compliance and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA) NSPS Subpart WWW/XXX; EPA LFG Energy Program; ISO 14001

attributes.name: lfg_utilization_type
attributes.description: Method by which captured landfill gas (LFG) is utilized or destroyed. 'flare_only' indicates gas is combusted without energy recovery; 'electricity_generation' indicates WTE power generation; 'RNG' indicates renewable natural gas pipeline injection; 'direct_use' indicates direct thermal use; 'none' indicates no LFG system. Drives GHG emissions reporting and sustainability metrics.
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA) NSPS; EPA LFG Energy Program; GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: liner_system_type
attributes.description: Type of engineered liner system installed at the base of the landfill to prevent leachate migration into groundwater. Determines applicable regulatory standards, leachate collection design, and groundwater monitoring requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_composite|double_composite|clay|geomembrane|no_liner|other — promote to reference product if additional liner subtypes are needed]
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart D); EPA Liner System Design Guidance

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the landfill facility centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for geospatial analysis, route optimization, emergency response, and environmental monitoring zone mapping.
attributes.references: GPS/WGS84 Standard; EPA Facility Geolocation Requirements

attributes.name: monitoring_well_count
attributes.description: Total number of groundwater monitoring wells installed at the facility perimeter and downgradient locations as required by the facility permit. Used for compliance scheduling, sampling cost estimation, and permit condition verification.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart E); State Groundwater Monitoring Permit Conditions

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landfill facility first began accepting waste. Used for site age calculations, post-closure care timeline planning, and historical capacity consumption analysis.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the landfill site. 'active' indicates waste is actively being received; 'closed' indicates waste acceptance has ceased; 'post_closure' indicates the site is in the regulatory post-closure care period; 'permitted' indicates permit obtained but operations not yet commenced; 'construction' indicates liner/cell construction in progress; 'suspended' indicates operations temporarily halted.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Reporting

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current RCRA Subtitle D or state solid waste operating permit expires. Triggers permit renewal workflow in Enviance EHS. Facilities operating beyond this date without renewal are in violation of RCRA and state regulations.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: permit_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current operating permit was issued by the regulatory authority. Used to calculate permit duration, track renewal cycles, and support compliance audit documentation.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: permitted_acreage
attributes.description: Total land area in acres authorized under the current operating permit for waste disposal activities. Drives capacity planning, cell development scheduling, and permit boundary compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Solid Waste Permit

attributes.name: permitted_daily_receipt_tons
attributes.description: Maximum tonnage per day (TPD) the facility is permitted to receive under its current operating permit. Operational throughput must not exceed this limit without permit modification. Used for daily tonnage monitoring and permit compliance alerts in Enviance EHS.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Solid Waste Operating Permit

attributes.name: post_closure_end_date
attributes.description: Projected or actual date on which the mandatory post-closure care period ends (minimum 30 years after closure under RCRA Subtitle D). Used for long-range financial liability estimation and closure cost accrual under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258 Subpart G); IFRS/GAAP Asset Retirement Obligation (ARO) Accounting; SOX

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP code for the landfill facility address. Used for geographic analysis, regulatory jurisdiction mapping, and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: rcra_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Subtitle D Permit Number
attributes.description: State-issued RCRA Subtitle D operating permit number authorizing the facility to receive and dispose of municipal solid waste (MSW) or other permitted waste streams. Required for regulatory compliance and annual permit renewal tracking.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the primary state or local regulatory agency with permitting and enforcement authority over the facility (e.g., 'California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery', 'Texas Commission on Environmental Quality'). Determines applicable state-specific regulatory requirements beyond federal RCRA Subtitle D baseline.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments; RCRA Authorized State Programs

attributes.name: remaining_airspace_cy
attributes.description: Current remaining permitted airspace in cubic yards, calculated from the most recent engineering survey. Critical KPI for capacity planning, site life estimation, and financial asset valuation under IFRS/GAAP. Updated following each annual or semi-annual airspace survey.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); IFRS/GAAP Asset Valuation; SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP S/4HANA plant code assigned to this landfill facility. Used for financial cost center assignment, materials management (MM), plant maintenance (PM), and EHS module integration. Enables cross-domain financial and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Configuration; Internal ERP Integration Standards

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the landfill site across enterprise systems including SAP S/4HANA, Enviance EHS, and Infor EAM. Used as the cross-system business key.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard; SAP S/4HANA Plant Code Convention

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official operating name of the landfill facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in all internal and external communications.
attributes.references: EPA SWIS Facility Registration; RCRA Subtitle D

attributes.name: standard_tipping_fee
attributes.description: Standard gate rate charged per short ton for waste disposal at the facility (tipping fee). This is the base rate before contractual discounts or surcharges. Confidential commercial pricing data used in Oracle Revenue Management rate configuration and financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management Rate Configuration; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation where the landfill facility is located. Determines applicable state environmental quality department regulations, state permit requirements, and state-specific RCRA program authority.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments; RCRA Authorized State Programs

attributes.name: swis_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) Registration Number
attributes.description: State Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) registration number assigned by the state environmental agency. Used for EPA SWIS reporting submissions and state-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA SWIS Reporting Requirements; State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the landfill facility location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Required for accurate timestamp interpretation of operational events, regulatory reporting deadlines, and scheduling across multi-site enterprise operations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: total_design_capacity_cy
attributes.description: Total permitted airspace capacity of the landfill in cubic yards as approved in the facility design engineering report. Represents the maximum volume of waste and cover material the site is engineered and permitted to contain. Used for long-range capacity planning and permit compliance.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Annual Reporting

attributes.name: total_design_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Total permitted disposal capacity of the landfill in short tons as approved in the facility design engineering report. Complements cubic yard capacity for tonnage-based regulatory reporting and financial capacity valuation.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); EPA SWIS Annual Reporting; IFRS/GAAP Asset Valuation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the landfill site master record. Used for change detection, data synchronization across integrated systems, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Record Management

attributes.name: waste_streams_accepted
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of waste stream types the facility is permitted to accept (e.g., 'MSW, C&D, industrial non-hazardous, special waste'). Drives waste acceptance screening, manifest verification, and permit compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSW|C&D|industrial_non_hazardous|special_waste|ash|sludge|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle D (40 CFR Part 258); State Solid Waste Permit Waste Acceptance Criteria

products.name: cell
products.description: Master record for each discrete waste placement cell within a landfill site. Tracks cell identifier (CID), cell phase (active, filled, closed), design volume (cubic yards), permitted waste types (MSW, C&D, special waste), liner system specifications (single, double, composite), leachate collection system tie-in, cell opening date, projected fill date, actual closure date, base elevation, top elevation, and cell geometry coordinates. Supports airspace consumption tracking and cell sequencing for capacity planning. Sourced from AMCS Platform and Enviance EHS.

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the landfill cell. Primary key for the cell master record.
attributes.references: SWANA Best Practices for Landfill Operations

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.capital_project. Business justification: Each landfill cell is constructed as a discrete capital project with design, permitting, and construction phases. Capital project completion triggers cell activation and asset capitalization. Construc

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Cells are sub-components of facility structures for asset hierarchy, cost center allocation, capital project tracking, and consolidated environmental reporting. New attribute establishes proper facili

attributes.name: landfill_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent landfill site where this cell is located. Links to the landfill facility master record.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Facility Identification

attributes.name: actual_fill_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the cell reached design capacity and was closed to further waste placement.

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Horizontal footprint area of the cell in acres, measured at the base liner surface.

attributes.name: average_daily_tonnage
attributes.description: Average tons per day (TPD) received in this cell during active operations, used for capacity planning and operational forecasting.

attributes.name: base_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Elevation of the cell base (liner surface) in feet above mean sea level, used for airspace calculations and grading plans.

attributes.name: cell_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the cell used in operational and planning documents.

attributes.name: cell_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cell, typically alphanumeric code used in operational communications and regulatory reporting (e.g., CELL-A1, PHASE2-C3).

attributes.name: cell_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the cell in its lifecycle: planned (designed but not built), under_construction (being prepared), active (receiving waste), filled (at capacity but not closed), closed (operations ceased, interim cover applied), capped (final cover system installed).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Closure Requirements

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when formal closure activities (final grading, interim cover installation) were completed and the cell transitioned from active to closed status.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Closure Requirements (40 CFR 258.60)

attributes.name: compaction_ratio_target
attributes.description: Target volume reduction ratio for waste compaction operations in this cell, typically expressed as ratio of loose volume to compacted volume (e.g., 4.0 means 4:1 reduction).
attributes.references: Operational Best Practices for Waste Compaction

attributes.name: construction_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when cell construction was completed and the cell was certified ready for waste placement.

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physical construction of the cell (excavation, liner installation) commenced.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cell record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Current elevation of the active waste surface in feet above mean sea level, updated from periodic topographic surveys.

attributes.name: daily_cover_material_type
attributes.description: Type of material used for daily cover application to control odors, vectors, and litter: soil (traditional 6-inch soil cover), alternative_daily_cover (ADC such as compost, shredded green waste), tarps (reusable geomembrane tarps), foam (spray-applied foam), auto_daily_cover (automated tarp systems).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Daily Cover Requirements (40 CFR 258.21)

attributes.name: design_capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Total permitted airspace volume for waste placement in cubic yards, as specified in the engineering design and regulatory permit.
attributes.references: Landfill Design Plans and Permit Documents

attributes.name: design_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Total permitted waste tonnage capacity, calculated from design volume and assumed compaction density.
attributes.references: Landfill Design Plans and Permit Documents

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for environmental monitoring activities (groundwater sampling, gas monitoring, leachate testing) as specified in the permit.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Monitoring Requirements (40 CFR 258.50-258.55)

attributes.name: final_cap_installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the final cover system (cap) was installed over the closed cell, marking the beginning of post-closure care period.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Closure Requirements (40 CFR 258.60)

attributes.name: gas_collection_start_date
attributes.description: Date when active gas collection operations commenced in this cell, required for EPA NSPS/EG compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS/EG Landfill Gas Collection Requirements (40 CFR Part 60 Subpart XXX)

attributes.name: gas_collection_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active landfill gas collection system (vertical wells and/or horizontal collectors) has been installed in this cell.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS/EG Landfill Gas Collection Requirements (40 CFR Part 60 Subpart XXX)

attributes.name: geometry_coordinates
attributes.description: Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the cell boundary polygon coordinates for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_wells
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of groundwater monitoring well identifiers assigned to this cell for environmental compliance monitoring per RCRA Subtitle D requirements.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Groundwater Monitoring (40 CFR 258.40)

attributes.name: liner_system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engineered liner system installed at the base of the cell to prevent leachate migration: single_composite (one geomembrane + clay layer), double_composite (two geomembrane layers with leak detection), single_geomembrane, clay_only (compacted clay liner), enhanced_composite (advanced multi-layer system).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Liner Design Standards (40 CFR 258.40)

attributes.name: liner_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Total thickness of the liner system in inches, including all geomembrane and clay layers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or historical context relevant to this cell.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the cell was opened for active waste placement operations.

attributes.name: permitted_waste_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of waste types authorized for disposal in this cell per regulatory permit (e.g., MSW, C&D, special waste, industrial non-hazardous). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSW|C&D|special_waste|industrial_non_hazardous|asbestos|contaminated_soil|sludge|ash — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Permit Conditions

attributes.name: phase_number
attributes.description: Development phase identifier indicating the sequential construction phase of the landfill expansion plan.

attributes.name: post_closure_care_end_date
attributes.description: Projected or actual date when the 30-year post-closure care period (monitoring, maintenance, gas management) will end or ended.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Subtitle D Post-Closure Care (40 CFR 258.61)

attributes.name: projected_fill_date
attributes.description: Forecasted date when the cell is expected to reach design capacity based on current waste placement rates and airspace consumption trends.

attributes.name: remaining_capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: Current available airspace for waste placement in cubic yards, updated based on survey measurements and waste placement records.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name of the licensed professional engineer responsible for design certification and ongoing compliance oversight for this cell.

attributes.name: tipping_fee_per_ton
attributes.description: Standard disposal charge per ton of waste placed in this cell, used for revenue tracking and cost allocation. May vary by waste type and customer contract.

attributes.name: top_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Permitted final elevation of the cell top surface in feet above mean sea level, defining the maximum fill height.
attributes.references: Landfill Design Plans and Permit Documents

attributes.name: total_tonnage_received
attributes.description: Cumulative tonnage of waste placed in this cell since opening, tracked for capacity management and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cell record was last modified in the system.

products.name: tonnage_receipt
products.description: Transactional record of each waste load received at the landfill scale house. Captures ticket number, inbound vehicle ID, hauler/carrier identity, waste origin (route, transfer station, or direct customer), waste type classification (MSW, C&D, special waste, sludge), gross weight, tare weight, net tonnage, moisture content estimate, load rejection flag, rejection reason, assigned disposal cell, tipping fee rate applied, tipping fee amount charged, scale operator ID, and receipt timestamp. Primary source for TPD (Tons Per Day) reporting and tipping fee revenue recognition. Sourced from Oracle Revenue Management and AMCS Platform.
products.reference: Scale House Ticket / Tipping Fee Transaction

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_enrollment. This supports invoice reconciliation and ensures the co

attributes.name: contamination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether prohibited or contaminating materials were detected in the waste load during inspection.

attributes.name: contamination_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes describing any contamination, prohibited materials, or acceptance criteria violations observed during load inspection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tonnage receipt record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for tipping fee amounts. Defaults to USD for US operations.

attributes.name: gross_weight_tons
attributes.description: Total weight of the loaded vehicle in tons as measured on the inbound scale, including vehicle tare weight and waste payload.

attributes.description: Timestamp when the loaded vehicle was weighed on the inbound scale.

attributes.name: load_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of visual or detailed inspection performed on the waste load at the scale house to verify compliance with acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: load_rejected_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the waste load was rejected and not accepted for disposal at the landfill.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tonnage receipt record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: Estimated moisture content of the waste load as a percentage. Used for waste characterization and compaction ratio calculations.

attributes.name: net_tonnage
attributes.description: Calculated net weight of waste material in tons (gross weight minus tare weight). Primary measure for TPD (Tons Per Day) reporting and tipping fee calculation.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: outbound_scale_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the empty vehicle was weighed on the outbound scale after waste disposal.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which tipping fees for this load will be collected (account billing, immediate payment, etc.).

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waste load was received and weighed at the landfill scale house. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: special_handling_code

attributes.name: waste_origin_type

products.name: airspace_consumption

attributes.description: Material composition of the well casing. High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) is most common for corrosion resistance; PVC, steel, and fiberglass are alternatives based on site conditions and design specifications.

attributes.name: construction_contractor

attributes.name: construction_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost of well installation including materials, labor, and equipment in US dollars. Used for capital expenditure tracking, asset valuation, and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this well record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: design_extraction_rate_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Extraction Rate (Standard Cubic Feet per Minute)
attributes.description: Designed gas extraction capacity of the well measured in standard cubic feet per minute (SCFM) at standard temperature and pressure. Used for system capacity planning and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: design_vacuum_inches_h2o
attributes.description: Target vacuum pressure at the wellhead measured in inches of water column. Optimal vacuum range is typically 2-6 inches H2O to maximize gas extraction while minimizing air intrusion.
attributes.references: SWANA LFG System Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: elevation_feet
attributes.description: Ground surface elevation at the well location measured in feet above mean sea level. Used for hydraulic gradient calculations and leachate management.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the LFG extraction well was installed and commissioned. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, warranty management, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent field inspection of the well. EPA NSPS Subpart WWW requires quarterly monitoring of wellhead parameters (flow, vacuum, temperature, methane concentration).
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this well record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the well location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, field navigation, and spatial analysis of gas collection network.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the well location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, field navigation, and spatial analysis of gas collection network.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next regulatory or preventive maintenance inspection. Supports compliance calendar management and field crew scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or historical context about the well. May include construction anomalies, performance issues, or site-specific considerations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the LFG extraction well. Active wells are currently extracting gas; idle wells are installed but not in service; maintenance wells are temporarily offline; abandoned wells are permanently closed; planned wells are approved but not yet installed.
attributes.references: EPA NSPS Subpart WWW Operational Standards

attributes.name: rng_production_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether gas from this well is routed to the RNG production facility. True if well contributes to RNG production; false if gas is flared or used for waste-to-energy only. Supports RNG revenue allocation and environmental credit tracking.

attributes.name: screen_interval_bottom_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the bottom of the perforated screen section. Defines the lower boundary of the gas collection zone.

attributes.name: screen_interval_top_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the top of the perforated screen section. Defines the upper boundary of the gas collection zone.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction warranty expires. Typically 1-2 years from installation date. Used for warranty claim management and defect tracking.

attributes.name: well_depth_feet
attributes.description: Total depth of the extraction well measured in feet from ground surface to bottom of well screen. Critical for gas collection efficiency and design capacity calculations.

attributes.name: well_diameter_inches
attributes.description: Internal diameter of the well casing measured in inches. Affects gas flow capacity and extraction efficiency.

attributes.name: well_identifier
attributes.description: Business identifier or tag number for the LFG extraction well. Used for field operations, maintenance work orders, and regulatory reporting. May follow site-specific naming conventions (e.g., SITE-CELL-WELL-###).
attributes.references: SWANA Landfill Gas Management Best Practices

attributes.name: well_type
attributes.description: Classification of the extraction well design. Vertical wells are drilled vertically into waste mass; horizontal wells are installed horizontally in trenches; trench wells are perforated pipes in gravel-filled trenches.
attributes.references: SWANA LFG Collection System Design Standards

attributes.name: wellhead_equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of wellhead control and monitoring equipment. Standard wellheads have manual valves; adjustable wellheads allow field tuning; automated wellheads have remote control capability; monitoring-only wellheads are for observation wells.

Anchors all groundwater sampling events and is required for RCRA Subtitle D detection monitoring programs. Sourced from Enviance EHS.

The monitoring_program_type plain text is den

attributes.name: aquifer_zone
attributes.description: Name or designation of the aquifer zone or hydrogeologic unit being monitored by this well (e.g., Upper Alluvial, Bedrock, Perched Water Table).

attributes.description: Inside diameter of the well casing in inches. Determines sampling equipment compatibility and well capacity.

attributes.name: casing_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the well casing. PVC is most common for environmental monitoring; stainless steel used for volatile organic compound (VOC) sampling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this monitoring well record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the monitoring well was permanently decommissioned and sealed per regulatory requirements. Null for active wells.

attributes.name: decommission_reason
attributes.description: Business or regulatory reason for decommissioning the well (e.g., landfill closure, well damage, redundant monitoring point, permit modification).

attributes.name: elevation_feet_msl
attributes.description: Elevation of the well top-of-casing or ground surface reference point in feet above mean sea level. Critical for calculating hydraulic gradients and groundwater flow direction.

attributes.name: epa_swis_well_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA Solid Waste Information System (SWIS) Well ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by EPA SWIS for this monitoring well. Used in federal reporting and data exchange with EPA.

attributes.name: filter_pack_material

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sampling results from this well must be included in regulatory reports to EPA or state agencies. True for compliance wells; false for supplemental monitoring points.

attributes.name: sampling_frequency
attributes.description: Regulatory or operational frequency at which groundwater samples are collected from this well. Quarterly is typical for RCRA detection monitoring.

attributes.name: screen_interval_bottom_feet

attributes.name: screen_interval_top_feet
attributes.description: Depth in feet from ground surface to the top of the screened interval where groundwater enters the well. Defines the monitored zone upper boundary.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: seal_material
attributes.description: Material used to seal the annular space between the borehole wall and well casing. Prevents surface water infiltration and cross-contamination between aquifer zones.

attributes.name: state_well_permit_number

attributes.name: static_water_level_feet
attributes.description: Most recent measured depth to groundwater from the top of casing, in feet. Used to calculate groundwater elevation and flow direction. Updated after each sampling event.

attributes.name: total_depth_feet
attributes.description: Total depth of the monitoring well from ground surface to bottom, measured in feet. Determines the aquifer zone being monitored.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: well_construction_method
attributes.description: Drilling and installation method used to construct the monitoring well. Hollow stem auger is most common for shallow environmental wells.
attributes.references: ASTM D5092 Standard Practice for Well Installation

attributes.name: well_designation
attributes.description: Business identifier for the monitoring well, typically assigned per site naming convention (e.g., MW-01, GW-UG-03). Used in regulatory reports and field operations.

attributes.name: well_development_date
attributes.description: Date when well development (removal of drilling fluids and fines) was completed and the well was ready for sampling. Typically occurs shortly after installation.
attributes.references: ASTM D5521 Standard Guide for Well Development

attributes.name: well_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, field observations, maintenance history, or special sampling instructions for this well.

attributes.name: well_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the monitoring well in its lifecycle. Active wells are sampled per schedule; inactive wells are not currently monitored.

attributes.name: well_type
attributes.description: Classification of the well based on its position relative to the landfill and regulatory purpose. Upgradient wells establish baseline conditions; downgradient wells detect contamination migration.

attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262.10, Federal Facility Compliance Act

attributes.name: generator_category
attributes.description: EPA classification of generator based on monthly waste generation volume. LQG (Large Quantity Generator): ≥1,000 kg/month; SQG (Small Quantity Generator): 100-1,000 kg/month; VSQG (Very Small Quantity Generator): <100 kg/month; CESQG (Conditionally Exempt Small Quantity Generator): legacy term for VSQG.

attributes.name: generator_legal_name
attributes.description: The official legal name of the hazardous waste generating entity as registered with EPA and state authorities.

attributes.name: generator_status
attributes.description: Current operational and regulatory status of the hazardous waste generator registration.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: initial_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the generator first notified EPA of hazardous waste generation activities and received EPA ID number.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_months
attributes.description: Expected frequency of regulatory inspections by EPA or state authorities, in months. Varies by generator category and compliance history.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: last_biennial_report_year
attributes.description: The reporting year of the most recently submitted biennial hazardous waste report (e.g., 2022 for the 2021-2022 reporting period).

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection by EPA, state, or local enforcement agency.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: last_notification_update_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent update to the generator's EPA notification information. Generators must notify EPA of changes within 30 days.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the generator site in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the generator site in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: mailing_address
attributes.description: Mailing address for correspondence and regulatory notifications if different from site address.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code identifying the primary business activity of the generator. Used for regulatory reporting and waste generation profiling.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau NAICS, RCRA Biennial Report Requirements

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact for electronic manifest notifications and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person responsible for hazardous waste management at the generator site.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the generator contact. Used for operational coordination and emergency response.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary contact person (e.g., Environmental Manager, EHS Coordinator).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this generator record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this generator record originated (e.g., Enviance EHS, SAP EHS, EPA RCRAInfo).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this generator record was last modified.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code for the generator's primary business activity. Legacy classification system still used in some regulatory contexts.
attributes.references: OSHA SIC Manual, EPA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: site_city
attributes.description: City where the hazardous waste generation site is located.

attributes.name: site_county
attributes.description: County where the generator site is located. Required for local enforcement agency (LEA) coordination.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments, Local Enforcement Agency Requirements

attributes.name: site_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the generator site location. Used for jurisdictional compliance determination.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: site_street_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the hazardous waste generation site. Required for manifest preparation and emergency response.

attributes.name: site_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the generator site. Supports 5-digit or 9-digit (ZIP+4) format.

attributes.name: state_generator_code
attributes.description: State-specific generator identification number if different from EPA ID. Some states maintain parallel registration systems.
attributes.references: State Environmental Quality Departments, State RCRA Authorization Programs

attributes.name: waste_minimization_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the generator has a documented waste minimization plan in place. Required for LQGs under some state programs.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262.41, State Hazardous Waste Reduction Programs

products.name: waste_profile
products.description: Waste characterization profile defining the physical and chemical properties of a specific hazardous waste stream. Captures waste code(s) (EPA D/F/K/P/U codes), TCLP test results, physical state, pH, ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity, toxicity characteristics, DOT hazard class, UN/NA number, proper shipping name, and approval status. Each profile is approved before waste is accepted for treatment or disposal. Sourced from SAP EHS and Enviance EHS.

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the waste characterization profile. Primary key for the waste profile entity.

attributes.name: approved_tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved TSDF (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility) Facility ID
attributes.description: Reference to the Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility authorized to accept this waste profile. Links to facility master data.

attributes.name: billing_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_rate_schedule. Business justification: Waste profile characteristics (hazard class, treatment method, physical state) directly determine the applicable billing rate schedule for hazmat services. Billing teams use waste profile data to sele

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Waste profiles are approved for customer accounts under master service agreements defining permitted waste streams, pricing basis, approved TSDFs. Profile approval validates contract scope, permitted

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: Waste profile has un_na_number (string) but no FK to dot_hazmat_classification reference table. Adding FK provides standardized DOT classification lookup including proper shipping name, hazard class,

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_generator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or facility that generates this waste stream. Links to the waste generator profile in the customer domain.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.offering. Business justification: Waste profiles document approved waste characterizations for specific service offerings. Service order fulfillment and pricing validation require linking profiles to catalog offerings. Real business p

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Waste profiles must comply with facility permit conditions. Approved waste streams are constrained by permit scope (waste codes, treatment methods). Required for permit compliance verification and TSD

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Waste profile approvals are governed by specific RCRA regulatory requirements (LDR treatment standards, land disposal restrictions). Linking enables compliance officers to verify that approved treatme

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_waste_stream. Business justification: Waste profiles characterize specific waste streams. Links regulatory/technical characterization to service catalog waste stream classification. Real business process: proper service routing, pricing d

attributes.name: annual_quantity_estimate_tons
attributes.description: Estimated annual quantity of waste expected to be generated under this profile, measured in tons. Used for capacity planning and permit compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the waste profile. Waste cannot be accepted for treatment or disposal until profile is approved.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waste profile was approved for acceptance.

attributes.name: constituents_of_concern
attributes.description: List of specific chemical constituents or contaminants present in the waste that drive its hazardous classification (e.g., 'Lead, Chromium, Toluene').
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 Appendix VIII - Hazardous Constituents

attributes.name: container_type_approved
attributes.description: Approved container types for this waste stream (e.g., '55-gallon steel drum', 'Bulk tanker', 'Fiber drum', 'Supersack'). Multiple types may be listed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waste profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: Department of Transportation hazard classification for transportation purposes (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 6.1 Toxic, Class 8 Corrosive, Class 9 Miscellaneous).

attributes.name: emergency_response_procedure
attributes.description: Summary of emergency response procedures in case of spill, release, or exposure incident involving this waste material.

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Used to determine ignitability characteristic (D001: flash point <60°C).

attributes.name: is_corrosive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the characteristic of corrosivity per EPA D002 criteria (aqueous with pH ≤2 or ≥12.5, or liquid that corrodes steel at rate >6.35mm per year at 55°C).

attributes.name: is_ignitable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the characteristic of ignitability per EPA D001 criteria (liquid with flash point <60°C, non-liquid capable of spontaneous combustion, ignitable compressed gas, or oxidizer).

attributes.name: is_reactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the characteristic of reactivity per EPA D003 criteria (unstable, reacts violently with water, generates toxic gases, contains cyanide or sulfide, or capable of detonation).

attributes.name: is_toxic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste exhibits the toxicity characteristic per TCLP testing, with contaminant concentrations exceeding regulatory thresholds (D004-D043).

attributes.name: land_disposal_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste is subject to Land Disposal Restrictions requiring treatment to meet specific standards before landfill disposal.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this waste profile. Profiles should be reviewed annually or when waste characteristics change.

attributes.name: ldr_treatment_standards
attributes.description: Specific treatment standards that must be met before land disposal, including concentration limits for hazardous constituents or required treatment technologies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waste profile record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this waste profile.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating degree of danger: I (great danger), II (medium danger), III (minor danger). Used for transportation classification.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Measured pH level of the waste material. Critical for determining corrosivity characteristic (D002: pH ≤2 or ≥12.5).

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical form of the waste material at ambient temperature and pressure.

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Personal protective equipment required when handling this waste (e.g., 'Level B, respirator, chemical-resistant gloves, face shield').

attributes.name: process_generating_waste
attributes.description: Description of the industrial or commercial process that generates this waste stream (e.g., 'Metal degreasing operation', 'Paint booth cleaning').

attributes.name: profile_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste profile becomes effective and waste shipments under this profile may be accepted.

attributes.name: profile_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste profile expires and must be renewed or re-approved. Typically profiles are valid for 1-3 years depending on facility requirements.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the waste stream or material being profiled (e.g., 'Industrial Solvent Waste', 'Lead-Contaminated Soil').

attributes.name: profile_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the waste profile, used for external reference and tracking. Typically formatted as WP- followed by numeric sequence.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: DOT-approved proper shipping name for the hazardous material as it must appear on shipping papers and manifests (e.g., 'Waste Flammable Liquid, N.O.S.').

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special handling, storage, or safety requirements for this waste stream (e.g., 'Keep refrigerated', 'Incompatible with oxidizers', 'Requires secondary containment').

attributes.name: tclp_results_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: TCLP (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure) Results Summary
attributes.description: Summary of TCLP test results listing detected contaminants and their concentrations in mg/L. Used to determine D-code assignments for toxic characteristics.

attributes.name: tclp_test_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: TCLP (Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure) Test Date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure laboratory test was performed to determine if waste exhibits toxicity characteristic.

attributes.name: treatment_method_required
attributes.description: Approved treatment or disposal method for this waste stream (e.g., 'Incineration', 'Stabilization', 'Landfill Disposal', 'Fuel Blending').

attributes.name: un_na_number
attributes.description: Four-digit United Nations or North America identification number assigned to the hazardous material for transportation purposes (e.g., UN1203, NA1993).

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the waste material including source process, composition, contaminants, and any special handling considerations.

products.name: manifest
products.description: Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest (EPA Form 8700-22) tracking cradle-to-grave movement of hazardous waste from generator to TSDF. Captures manifest number, generator EPA ID, transporter EPA ID(s), designated TSDF EPA ID, waste descriptions, container types and counts, total quantity, DOT shipping information, emergency response phone, special handling instructions, and all required signatures (generator, transporter, TSDF). Supports e-Manifest (EPA RCRAInfo) integration.

attributes.name: manifest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste manifest record. Primary key.

attributes.name: area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.area. Business justification: Manifests must be associated with a service area for state-level regulatory jurisdiction reporting, area-level manifest volume tracking, and franchise compliance audits. Manifest has generator_city/st

attributes.name: disposal_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.disposal_agreement. Business justification: Each manifest documents waste delivered to a TSDF under a specific disposal agreement. Direct link enables reconciliation of manifested tonnage against contracted disposal capacity, supports RCRA bien

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: Manifest has dot_id_number (string) but no FK to dot_hazmat_classification reference table. Adding FK provides standardized DOT classification lookup. Keep dot_shipping_name, dot_hazard_class, dot_pac

attributes.name: generator_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Manifests document shipments under generator's permit authority. Required for regulatory traceability, compliance audits, and verifying generator operated within permit conditions during shipment peri

attributes.name: hauling_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.hauling_agreement. Business justification: A manifest is executed under a specific hauling agreement that defines the contracted transporter, DOT compliance requirements, and manifest obligations. Direct link enables manifest-level billing rec

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Manifests document hazardous waste shipments that generate billable charges. Regulatory audits require linking manifest tracking numbers to invoices. Essential for compliance verification, dispute res

attributes.name: manifest_alternate_facility_epa_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Alternate Facility Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID of an alternate TSDF facility designated by the generator if the primary TSDF cannot accept the waste.

attributes.name: manifest_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transporter 1 Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID of the first transporter in the chain of custody. Required for all hazardous waste shipments.

attributes.name: manifest_generator_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generator Epa Id Registration Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: Manifest tracks generator EPA ID as a string. This should be normalized to FK to epa_id_registration. Labeled FK (generator_epa_id_registration_id) distinguishes this from other EPA ID references on m

attributes.name: manifest_transporter_2_epa_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transporter 2 Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID of the second transporter if multiple transporters are involved in the shipment chain.

attributes.name: manifest_tsdf_epa_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID of the designated TSDF facility that will receive and process the hazardous waste.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Manifest has epa_waste_codes (string, comma-separated) but no FK to waste_code reference table. Adding FK for primary waste code provides standardized waste code lookup. Keep epa_waste_codes string fo

attributes.name: transporter_1_transporter_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.transporter_registration. Business justification: The manifest captures transporter_1_name as a string but has no FK to transporter_registration for the primary transporter. The EPA manifest form requires the first transporter's EPA ID and name. Norm

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: Manifest violations (discrepancies, late exception reports, improper signatures) trigger violation notices per 40 CFR 262. Required for enforcement tracking and linking manifest non-compliance to regu

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers (drums, boxes, tanks, etc.) included in this manifest shipment.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: EPA container type code. Common codes: DM=Metal Drum, DF=Fiber Drum, BA=Burlap/Canvas Bag, DT=Dump Truck, CY=Cylinder, TP=Portable Tank, TT=Cargo Tank, TC=Tank Car, CF=Fiber Box, CM=Metal Box.
