attributes.references: EPA Form 8700-22 Box 11; 40 CFR Part 262 Appendix

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any discrepancies noted by the TSDF, including quantity variances, container damage, or waste type mismatches.

attributes.name: discrepancy_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the TSDF identified any discrepancies between the manifest and the actual shipment received (quantity, type, condition).

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class or division number (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 6.1 for toxic substances, 8 for corrosives) per 49 CFR Part 173.

attributes.name: dot_id_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN or NA identification number assigned to the hazardous material for transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline).

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating degree of danger: I=Great Danger, II=Medium Danger, III=Minor Danger.

attributes.name: dot_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: DOT-required proper shipping name from the Hazardous Materials Table (49 CFR 172.101) describing the waste for transportation purposes.

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Hazardous Waste Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) identifying the specific waste characteristics or sources. Example: D001,F005,D008.

attributes.name: generator_city
attributes.description: City where the generator facility is located.

attributes.name: generator_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative at the generator facility responsible for the manifest.

attributes.name: generator_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the generator facility contact person.

attributes.name: generator_emergency_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency response phone number for incidents involving this waste shipment (e.g., CHEMTREC, facility emergency line).

attributes.name: generator_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the hazardous waste generator facility originating the waste shipment.

attributes.name: generator_signature_date
attributes.description: Date the generator authorized representative signed the manifest certifying the waste information is accurate.

attributes.name: generator_site_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the generator facility where the hazardous waste was produced.

attributes.name: generator_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the generator facility location.

attributes.name: generator_zip_code
attributes.description: US postal ZIP code for the generator facility (5-digit or ZIP+4 format).

attributes.name: import_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this manifest documents an international import of hazardous waste into the United States.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart H; EPA Form 8700-22 Box 16

attributes.name: import_port_of_entry
attributes.description: US port of entry location for international hazardous waste imports.

attributes.name: manifest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manifest document. Tracks progression from draft through final disposition at TSDF. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_transit|received_by_tsdf|completed|corrected|rejected|voided — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: manifest_type
attributes.description: Format type of the manifest submission: paper (traditional hard copy), electronic (e-Manifest via RCRAInfo), or hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for total waste quantity. EPA codes: K=Kilograms, P=Pounds, T=Tons (2000 lbs), G=Gallons, L=Liters, M=Metric Tons, N=Cubic Meters, Y=Cubic Yards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: K|P|T|G|L|M|N|Y — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Form 8700-22 Box 12; 40 CFR Part 262 Appendix

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Receipt Date at Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF)
attributes.description: Date the TSDF facility received and accepted the hazardous waste shipment. Used to calculate transit time and verify timely delivery.

attributes.name: rejection_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the TSDF rejected all or part of the waste shipment.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the TSDF rejected the waste shipment (e.g., waste not matching manifest, facility permit restrictions, safety concerns).

attributes.name: residue_indication
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the containers being shipped contain only residue (less than 3% by weight remaining after emptying).

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Date the hazardous waste shipment left the generator facility. Critical for regulatory compliance timelines and chain-of-custody tracking.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional handling, storage, or safety instructions for transporters and TSDF personnel. May include temperature requirements, incompatibility warnings, or PPE requirements.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste on this manifest across all waste streams and containers.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: EPA-issued 12-character unique tracking number for the Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest (9 digits + 3 letter suffix). Required for cradle-to-grave tracking under RCRA Subtitle C.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart B; EPA Form 8700-22

attributes.name: transporter_2_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the second transporter company if applicable.

attributes.name: transporter_signature_date
attributes.description: Date the transporter signed the manifest acknowledging receipt of the waste shipment from the generator.

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Date
attributes.description: Date the TSDF authorized representative signed the manifest certifying receipt of the waste shipment.

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hazardous waste contents, composition, and physical state. Required to supplement EPA waste codes.

products.name: manifest_line
products.description: Individual waste stream line item on a hazardous waste manifest. Captures line number, waste description, EPA waste codes, DOT hazard class, UN/NA number, container type (drum, tote, tank), container count, unit of measure, total quantity (lbs/gallons), physical state, and special handling notes. Each manifest may carry multiple waste streams requiring separate line entries per DOT HMR and RCRA requirements.
products.reference: Manifest Line Item / DOT HMR Shipping Description

attributes.name: manifest_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manifest line item. Primary key for the manifest line entity.

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: Manifest line has un_na_number (string) but no FK to dot_hazmat_classification reference table. Adding FK provides standardized DOT classification lookup. Keep dot_proper_shipping_name, dot_hazard_cla

attributes.name: manifest_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent hazardous waste manifest document. Links this line item to the overall manifest header.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Manifest line has epa_waste_codes (string, comma-separated) but no FK to waste_code reference table. Adding FK for primary waste code provides standardized waste code lookup. Keep epa_waste_codes stri

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved waste profile document. Waste profiles contain detailed characterization data including TCLP test results, flash point, pH, and other analytical data.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers of this waste stream on the manifest line. Each container must be of the same type and size.

attributes.name: container_size
attributes.description: Capacity or size of each individual container in the unit of measure specified. For drums, typically 55 gallons; for totes, typically 275-330 gallons.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of container used to package the hazardous waste. Common types include 55-gallon drums, intermediate bulk containers (totes), portable tanks, compressed gas cylinders, bags, and boxes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest line record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: discrepancy_comments
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of any discrepancy between the manifest description and the waste received. Required when discrepancy_indication is not none.

attributes.name: discrepancy_indication
attributes.description: Type of discrepancy identified by the receiving facility, if any. Discrepancies must be reported to EPA and the generator within 15 days.

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard classification for transportation purposes. Identifies the primary hazard category (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 6.1 Toxic, Class 8 Corrosive, Class 9 Miscellaneous).

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating the degree of danger. Group I represents high danger, Group II medium danger, and Group III low danger.

attributes.name: dot_proper_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: Official DOT proper shipping name from the Hazardous Materials Table. Must be used on shipping papers and placards.

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes assigned to this waste stream. Includes F-list (process wastes), K-list (industry-specific), P-list and U-list (discarded commercial chemicals), and D-list (characteristic wastes) codes.

attributes.name: flash_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Flash point temperature in degrees Fahrenheit. Wastes with flash point below 140°F are characteristic hazardous wastes (D001) and DOT Class 3 flammable liquids.

attributes.name: generator_comments
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes from the waste generator regarding this waste stream. May include process information, generation date, or other relevant details.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the manifest document. Determines the ordering of waste streams on the manifest form.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current status of this manifest line item in the cradle-to-grave tracking workflow. Tracks progression from draft through final disposition.

attributes.name: management_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the intended treatment, storage, or disposal method for this waste stream at the designated TSDF facility.

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waste is designated as a marine pollutant under DOT regulations. Requires special marking and documentation for water transportation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manifest line record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: pcb_concentration_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of PCBs in parts per million if the waste contains PCBs. Wastes with PCB concentrations of 50 ppm or greater are subject to TSCA PCB regulations.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement of the waste. Wastes with pH ≤2 or ≥12.5 are characteristic corrosive hazardous wastes (D002).

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical state or form of the hazardous waste. Determines handling, storage, and treatment requirements.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the waste was received at the designated TSDF facility. Establishes the start of the facility's custody period.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received by the designated facility in the specified unit of measure. May differ from total_quantity if discrepancies exist.

attributes.name: reportable_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream meets or exceeds the CERCLA reportable quantity threshold. If true, the letters RQ must appear on the manifest and shipping papers.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional handling, storage, or transportation instructions for this waste stream. May include temperature controls, incompatibility warnings, PPE requirements, or emergency response procedures.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of waste for this line item in the specified unit of measure. Calculated as container count multiplied by container size, or measured directly.

attributes.name: un_na_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN or NA identification number assigned to the hazardous material for transportation. UN numbers are internationally recognized; NA numbers are North America-specific.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the waste quantity. Common units include gallons, liters, pounds, kilograms, tons, and cubic yards.

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the hazardous waste stream. Includes physical characteristics, chemical composition, and source process information as required by DOT HMR and RCRA.

attributes.name: waste_minimization_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the waste minimization efforts applied to this waste stream. Required for biennial reporting under RCRA.

products.name: hazmat_container
products.description: Master record for individual hazardous waste containers (drums, totes, IBCs, lab packs, roll-offs) tracked by CID/RFID. Captures container type, capacity, material of construction, UN performance rating, current waste profile assignment, fill level, tare weight, gross weight, accumulation start date, storage location (satellite, 90-day, permitted storage), container condition, and chain-of-custody status. Integrates with AMCS container tracking and SAP EHS.

attributes.name: hazmat_container_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste container. Primary key for tracking individual drums, totes, IBCs, lab packs, and roll-offs throughout their lifecycle from generation through disposal.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations 40 CFR Part 262

attributes.name: asset_container_id

attributes.name: container_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.container_type. Business justification: Hazmat containers must conform to approved container type specifications from service catalog. Enables container inventory management, service delivery validation, and regulatory compliance with appro

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Adding FK provides standardized DOT classification lookup including proper shipping name, hazard cla

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.manifest_line. Business justification: Containers are listed on specific manifest line items. One container appears on one manifest line. This links the container to the specific line item on the manifest, replacing the INT manifest_line_n

attributes.name: primary_hazmat_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transporter Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID number of the licensed hazardous waste transporter currently responsible for this container during shipment. Required for manifest documentation.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Hazmat container has epa_waste_codes (string, comma-separated) but no FK to waste_code reference table. Adding FK for primary waste code provides standardized waste code lookup. Keep epa_waste_codes s

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.rfid_tag. Business justification: RFID tags on hazmat containers are registered in the enterprise asset RFID system for chain-of-custody tracking and regulatory compliance. Linking hazmat_container to asset.rfid_tag enables real-time

attributes.name: service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.hazmat_service_order. Business justification: Containers are collected via hazmat service orders. This links the container to the service order that picked it up from the generator site. One container is collected in one service order event. This

attributes.name: storage_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical facility or site where the container is currently stored. Links to facility EPA ID number and permit information.
attributes.references: RCRA Facility Identification; EPA ID Number Requirements

attributes.name: storage_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.storage_unit. Business justification: hazmat_container has storage_location_code (STRING) and storage_location_type (STRING) as denormalized storage location fields. Adding storage_unit_id normalizes the container's current storage locati

attributes.name: tertiary_hazmat_tsdf_epa_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: EPA ID number of the permitted TSDF facility designated to receive and dispose of this container. Must be listed on the hazardous waste manifest.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264/265; TSDF Permit Requirements

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: RCRA enforcement cites specific containers for violations (improper labeling, exceeded accumulation time, container condition failures). Direct FK from hazmat_container to violation_notice enables con

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the waste profile that characterizes the hazardous waste currently stored in this container. Links to waste codes, TCLP results, and handling requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261; Waste Characterization Requirements

attributes.name: waste_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_shipment. Business justification: hazmat_container tracks individual containers through their lifecycle. A container is loaded onto a specific waste_shipment for transport. Currently hazmat_container links to manifest and manifest_lin

attributes.name: accumulation_deadline_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the container must be shipped off-site to avoid RCRA violations. Calculated based on generator status and accumulation start date.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262.34; Generator Accumulation Time Limits

attributes.name: accumulation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when hazardous waste was first placed into this container. Triggers regulatory accumulation time limits (90-day rule for large quantity generators, 180/270-day for small quantity generators).
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 262.34; Generator Accumulation Time Limits

attributes.name: capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum rated capacity of the container in U.S. gallons. Used to calculate fill levels, determine accumulation limits, and plan transportation logistics.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; Container Specifications

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_status
attributes.description: Current custody status in the cradle-to-grave tracking chain. Indicates which party currently has physical possession and legal responsibility for the container.
attributes.references: RCRA Manifest Chain of Custody; DOT HMR Transportation Requirements

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical integrity and condition of the container. Critical for safety, regulatory compliance, and determining if container requires overpacking or replacement.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR 265.171; Container Condition Requirements; DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173.24

attributes.name: container_status
attributes.description: Current state of the container in its lifecycle from deployment through final disposal. Drives regulatory compliance timelines (e.g., 90-day accumulation limits) and operational workflows.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical container form factor used to store and transport the hazardous waste. Determines handling procedures and equipment requirements.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 178; UN Packaging Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the waste in this container was finally treated and disposed of at the TSDF. Completes the cradle-to-grave tracking lifecycle.
attributes.references: RCRA Manifest Requirements; EPA e-Manifest System

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Planned or actual method of treatment and disposal for the waste in this container. Determined by waste characteristics, EPA waste codes, and TSDF capabilities.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264/265; Treatment and Disposal Standards

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class or division number (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 8 for corrosives) that classifies the primary hazard of the material for transportation purposes.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; Hazard Class Definitions

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group (I, II, or III) indicating the degree of danger: I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Determines packaging requirements.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; Packing Group Criteria

attributes.name: dot_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: DOT-required proper shipping name for the hazardous material in this container as listed in 49 CFR 172.101 Hazardous Materials Table. Required for transportation documentation.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172.101; Hazardous Materials Table

attributes.name: dot_un_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) United Nations (UN) Number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number assigned to the hazardous material for international transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Required on shipping papers and labels.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172.101; UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes assigned to the waste in this container (e.g., D001, F003). Determines regulatory requirements and disposal methods.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261 Subpart D; EPA Hazardous Waste Code Lists

attributes.name: fill_level_percent
attributes.description: Current fill level of the container as a percentage of total capacity. Used to determine when container is full and ready for pickup, and to comply with DOT fill requirements.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173.24; Container Fill Requirements

attributes.name: gross_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of the container including waste contents in pounds. Critical for transportation compliance, vehicle load planning, and TSDF acceptance.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; RCRA Manifest Requirements

attributes.name: identification_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the container, typically a barcode or RFID tag number used for scanning and tracking in the field. May be printed on container label.
attributes.references: RCRA Container Labeling Requirements; DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172

attributes.name: label_affixed_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazardous waste label was affixed to the container. RCRA requires containers to be labeled upon start of accumulation with waste identity and accumulation start date.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent container inspection for leaks, corrosion, and structural integrity. RCRA requires weekly inspections of containers in accumulation areas.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this container record. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: material_of_construction
attributes.description: Primary material used in container construction. Must be compatible with waste characteristics to prevent corrosion, leakage, or chemical reaction.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173.24; EPA Container Compatibility Requirements

attributes.name: net_waste_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Calculated weight of waste contents only (gross weight minus tare weight) in pounds. Used for billing, regulatory reporting, and disposal facility acceptance.
attributes.references: RCRA Manifest Requirements; TSDF Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required container inspection. Ensures compliance with weekly inspection requirements for hazardous waste containers.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated this container record. Typically SAP EHS for container master data or AMCS for container tracking events.

attributes.name: tare_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Empty weight of the container in pounds, excluding waste contents. Used to calculate net waste weight for billing, manifest documentation, and transportation compliance.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 173; Weighing Requirements

attributes.name: un_performance_rating
attributes.description: UN packaging specification code indicating the container has been tested and certified for transporting hazardous materials. Format example: UN1A2/X150/S for a steel drum.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods; DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 178

products.name: tsdf_facility
products.description: Master record for Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facilities (TSDFs) authorized to receive hazardous waste. Captures EPA ID number, facility name, address, RCRA permit number and expiration, permitted waste codes, treatment/storage/disposal methods (TSDF type codes), emergency coordinator, insurance certificate status, financial assurance mechanism, and approval status for use as a designated facility on manifests. Sourced from Enviance EHS vendor/facility registry.

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Facility ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the TSDF facility record. Primary key for the TSDF facility master data.

attributes.name: epa_id_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: TSDF facilities are EPA-registered entities. The epa_id_number string duplicates epa_id_registration data. Adding FK normalizes this relationship and provides a second inbound link to epa_id_registrat

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: TSDF facilities are asset facilities with specialized hazmat permits. Links TSDF regulatory view to facility asset master for depreciation, insurance, maintenance coordination, and capital project tra

attributes.name: monitoring_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.monitoring_program. Business justification: TSDFs are required under RCRA to maintain groundwater monitoring programs and other environmental monitoring as permit conditions. Direct FK from tsdf_facility to monitoring_program enables TSDF-speci

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: TSDFs operate under RCRA Part B permits (40 CFR 264/265). Permit defines permitted waste codes, treatment/storage/disposal capacity, and operational conditions. Core regulatory relationship for facili

attributes.name: regulated_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulated_facility. Linking tsdf_facility to regulated_facility enables unified com

attributes.name: accepts_bulk_waste
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the facility is equipped and permitted to accept bulk hazardous waste shipments (tanker trucks, rail cars).

attributes.name: accepts_containerized_waste
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the facility accepts containerized hazardous waste (drums, totes, boxes).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the TSDF facility location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TSDF facility record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disposal_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum permitted disposal capacity for hazardous waste at the facility measured in tons. Applicable for landfill and land disposal units.

attributes.name: emergency_coordinator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated emergency coordinator responsible for coordinating emergency response activities at the TSDF facility as required by RCRA.

attributes.name: emergency_coordinator_title
attributes.description: Job title or position of the designated emergency coordinator at the TSDF facility.

attributes.name: emergency_phone_number
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency contact phone number for the TSDF facility as required by RCRA contingency plans. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the TSDF facility indicating whether it is authorized to receive and process hazardous waste.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the TSDF facility based on permitted operations: treatment, storage, disposal, or combinations thereof. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: treatment_only|storage_only|disposal_only|treatment_storage|treatment_disposal|storage_disposal|treatment_storage_disposal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: financial_assurance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of financial assurance maintained by the facility for closure and post-closure care. Business-sensitive financial data.

attributes.name: financial_assurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current financial assurance instrument. Must be renewed before expiration to maintain compliance.

attributes.name: financial_assurance_mechanism
attributes.description: Type of financial assurance mechanism the facility has established to ensure funds are available for closure and post-closure care as required by RCRA.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection conducted by EPA or authorized state agency at the TSDF facility.

attributes.name: last_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent regulatory inspection indicating compliance status and any violations found.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TSDF facility record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for the facility's liability insurance coverage for sudden and non-sudden accidental occurrences as required by RCRA.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the facility's current liability insurance policy. Must maintain continuous coverage per RCRA requirements.

attributes.name: manifest_approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status indicating whether the facility is authorized to be designated as a receiving facility on hazardous waste manifests. Determines if waste can be shipped to this TSDF.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes field for capturing additional information about the TSDF facility including special handling requirements, access restrictions, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the TSDF facility indicating when waste shipments can be received and processed.

attributes.name: permitted_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) that the facility is permitted to accept under its RCRA permit. Determines which waste streams can be sent to this TSDF.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage capacity for hazardous waste at the facility measured in tons. Regulatory limit specified in the RCRA permit.

attributes.name: treatment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of treatment method codes (e.g., incineration, stabilization, neutralization, thermal desorption) that the facility is authorized to perform under its RCRA permit.

attributes.name: vendor_rating
attributes.description: Internal vendor performance rating assigned to the TSDF facility based on compliance history, service quality, and reliability. Used for vendor selection decisions.

products.name: waste_shipment
products.description: Operational record of a hazardous waste pickup and transport event from a generator site to a TSDF or transfer facility. Captures shipment date, originating generator site, destination TSDF, assigned transporter, vehicle and driver details, manifest number reference, BOL number, total weight (lbs), container count, DOT placard requirements, route restrictions, actual departure and arrival timestamps, and shipment status (scheduled, in-transit, delivered, exception). Integrates with Locus Dispatch and Geotab telematics.

attributes.description: EPA-issued 12-character identification number for the destination TSDF facility. Required for all permitted TSDFs under RCRA.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.storage_unit. Business justification: waste_shipment records a hazardous waste pickup event from a generator site. The waste is picked up from a specific storage unit (satellite accumulation area, 90-day accumulation area, etc.). Adding s

attributes.name: tertiary_waste_transporter_epa_epa_id_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transporter Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ID Number
attributes.description: EPA-issued 12-character identification number for the transporter. Required for all hazardous waste transporters under RCRA.

attributes.name: transporter_registration_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hazardous waste transporter company assigned to execute this shipment. Links to the transporter entity responsible for safe transport.

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Destination Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination TSDF or transfer facility where the hazardous waste shipment is being transported for treatment, storage, or disposal.

attributes.name: vehicle_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle_assignment. Business justification: HOS compliance auditing and dispatch reconciliation require knowing which specific vehicle assignment (shift/dispatch event) executed a hazmat shipment. Enables cross-referencing HOS logs, fuel transa

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific vehicle (truck, trailer) used to transport this hazardous waste shipment. Links to fleet management system.

attributes.name: waste_profile_id

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle arrived at the destination TSDF facility. Used for chain-of-custody tracking and billing.

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle departed the generator site with the loaded hazardous waste. Captured via Geotab telematics or driver mobile app.

attributes.name: actual_transit_hours
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in hours from departure to arrival. Calculated from actual_departure_time and actual_arrival_time for performance tracking.

attributes.name: billing_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Weight in pounds used for billing purposes. May differ from total_weight_lbs if minimum billing weight or rounding rules apply.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Unique Bill of Lading document number issued for this hazardous waste shipment. Required for DOT HMR compliance during transportation.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether chain-of-custody documentation has been verified and all required signatures obtained from generator, transporter, and TSDF.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of hazardous waste containers (drums, totes, boxes) included in this shipment. Used for manifest line item reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the system user who created this shipment record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dot_placard_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of DOT placard codes required for this shipment (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive). Determines vehicle marking requirements.

attributes.name: dot_placard_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether DOT hazmat placards are required on the vehicle for this shipment based on waste classification and quantity thresholds.

attributes.name: driver_cdl_number
attributes.description: Commercial Driver License number of the driver transporting the hazardous waste. Must include hazmat endorsement for RCRA waste transport.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency response phone number required on shipping papers for hazardous waste transport. Must be monitored continuously during shipment.

attributes.name: emergency_response_guide_number
attributes.description: Three-digit ERG guide number from the DOT Emergency Response Guidebook. Used by first responders in case of spill or accident during transport.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_hours
attributes.description: Estimated travel time in hours from generator site to destination TSDF. Used for route planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Description of any exception or discrepancy encountered during shipment (e.g., rejected load, quantity mismatch, container damage, route deviation).

attributes.name: exception_reported_date
attributes.description: Date when a shipment exception or discrepancy was formally reported to the generator and regulatory authorities. Required within 30 days under RCRA.

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time GPS tracking via Geotab telematics is active for this shipment. Enables live monitoring and geofencing alerts.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the system user who last modified this shipment record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: route_deviation_detected
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the vehicle deviated from the planned or approved hazmat route during transport. Triggers compliance review.

attributes.name: route_restrictions
attributes.description: Special routing restrictions or requirements for this hazardous waste shipment (e.g., avoid tunnels, no residential areas, designated hazmat routes only).

attributes.name: scheduled_pickup_time
attributes.description: Planned date and time for pickup of hazardous waste from the generator site. Used for route optimization and customer communication.

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the hazardous waste shipment was scheduled or executed. Used for manifest dating and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: shipment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, driver observations, or special circumstances related to this shipment.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hazardous waste shipment. Tracks progression from scheduling through final delivery and manifest closure.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional handling, loading, or transport instructions specific to this shipment (e.g., keep upright, segregate from oxidizers, HAZWOPER-trained personnel only).

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment requires temperature-controlled transport due to waste characteristics (e.g., reactive materials, biological hazards).

attributes.name: total_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of hazardous waste in this shipment measured in pounds. Aggregated from all containers included in the shipment.

attributes.name: vehicle_unit_number
attributes.description: Fleet unit number or license plate identifier of the vehicle used for this shipment. Used for tracking and compliance reporting.

products.name: chain_of_custody
products.description: Immutable chain-of-custody record documenting every transfer of possession for hazardous waste containers from generation through final disposal. Captures transfer event type (generator handoff, transporter receipt, TSDF acceptance, treatment completion, disposal confirmation), transferring party EPA ID, receiving party EPA ID, transfer timestamp, container IDs transferred, witness/signature information, and discrepancy notes. Supports RCRA cradle-to-grave accountability and CERCLA liability documentation.

attributes.name: waste_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_shipment. Business justification: Chain of custody records document transfers during waste shipments. Multiple custody transfer events occur per shipment (generator to transporter, transporter to TSDF, etc.). This links each custody t

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the DOT bill of lading document accompanying this hazardous waste shipment. Links chain of custody to transportation documentation.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Number of hazardous waste containers included in this custody transfer event. Used to verify manifest accuracy and detect discrepancies.

attributes.name: discrepancy_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a discrepancy was noted during this custody transfer (e.g., container count mismatch, quantity variance, damage observed).

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes describing any discrepancy observed during the custody transfer. Required for RCRA exception reporting and CERCLA liability documentation.

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discrepancy noted during custody transfer, if any. Used for exception handling and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class or division number for the material (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 6.1 for toxic substances, 8 for corrosives).

attributes.name: dot_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Proper Shipping Name
attributes.description: DOT proper shipping name for the hazardous material as required by Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR). Used for transportation compliance.

attributes.name: emergency_response_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency response phone number for incidents involving this hazardous waste shipment. Required by DOT HMR.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating the degree of danger: I (great danger), II (medium danger), III (minor danger).

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total quantity of hazardous waste transferred (e.g., kilograms, pounds, gallons, liters).

attributes.name: receiving_party_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual representative who physically accepted custody on behalf of the receiving party.

attributes.name: receiving_party_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the organization or facility accepting custody of the hazardous waste container.

attributes.name: receiving_party_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or signature identifier of the receiving party representative acknowledging acceptance of custody. May be electronic signature hash or physical signature reference.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this chain of custody record. Supports audit and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this chain of custody record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste transferred in this custody event, measured in the unit specified by quantity_unit.

attributes.name: transfer_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the chain of custody transfer event. Defines the nature of the custody change in the cradle-to-grave lifecycle.

attributes.name: transfer_location_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the location where the custody transfer occurred. Required for DOT and EPA compliance documentation.

attributes.name: transfer_location_city
attributes.description: City where the custody transfer occurred.

attributes.name: transfer_location_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the custody transfer location. Supports GPS-based verification and geospatial compliance analysis.

attributes.name: transfer_location_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the custody transfer location. Supports GPS-based verification and geospatial compliance analysis.

attributes.name: transfer_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the physical location where the custody transfer occurred (e.g., generator facility, transporter depot, TSDF receiving dock).

attributes.name: transfer_location_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the location where the custody transfer occurred.

attributes.name: transfer_location_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the custody transfer occurred. Used for state-level regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: transfer_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this transfer event within the container's complete chain of custody. Starts at 1 for generator handoff and increments with each subsequent transfer.

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when physical custody of the hazardous waste container was transferred from the relinquishing party to the receiving party. Critical for CERCLA liability determination.

attributes.name: transferring_party_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual representative who physically relinquished custody on behalf of the transferring party.

attributes.name: transferring_party_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the organization or facility relinquishing custody of the hazardous waste container.

attributes.name: transferring_party_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or signature identifier of the transferring party representative acknowledging relinquishment of custody. May be electronic signature hash or physical signature reference.

attributes.name: un_identification_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number assigned to the hazardous material for international transportation. Format: UN followed by 4 digits.

attributes.name: waste_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Waste Code
attributes.description: EPA hazardous waste code(s) for the material being transferred. Format: letter (D/F/K/P/U) followed by 3 digits. Multiple codes may be comma-separated.

attributes.name: witness_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or signature identifier of the witness, if present. Provides additional verification for critical transfers.

products.name: treatment_record
products.description: Record of hazardous waste treatment operations performed at a TSDF or permitted on-site treatment unit. Captures treatment date, treatment unit ID, treatment technology code (incineration, neutralization, stabilization, fuel blending, solvent recovery), input waste stream and quantity, treatment parameters (temperature, pH, residence time), output residual characterization, emission control data, operator certification, and regulatory unit code per RCRA land disposal restrictions (LDR). Sourced from SAP EHS treatment logs.
products.reference: RCRA Treatment Record / LDR Treatment Certification

attributes.name: treatment_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste treatment record. Primary key for tracking individual treatment operations performed at Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facilities (TSDF) or permitted on-site treatment units under Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Subtitle C regulations.
attributes.references: RCRA Subtitle C; EPA TSDF Regulations 40 CFR Part 264/265

attributes.name: billing_rate_schedule_id

attributes.name: hazmat_container_id

attributes.references: RCRA Part B Permit; 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart O-X

attributes.business_glossary_term: Transporter Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Identification Number
attributes.description: The EPA identification number of the transporter who delivered the waste to the treatment facility. Part of the manifest chain-of-custody documentation.

attributes.name: treatment_facility_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.tsdf_facility. Business justification: treatment_record has treatment_facility_id (→ asset.facility) and treatment_facility_epa_id_registration_id, but no direct FK to tsdf_facility. The treatment facility IS a TSDF (Treatment, Storage, an

attributes.name: waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Treatment operations are performed on waste streams characterized by waste profiles. One treatment batch processes waste matching one profile. This links the treatment record to the waste characteriza

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The Department of Transportation (DOT) Bill of Lading number associated with the shipment of hazardous waste to the treatment facility. Links treatment record to transportation compliance documentation.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172 Hazardous Materials Table and Communications Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this treatment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disposal_method_code
attributes.description: EPA code indicating the intended final disposal or management method for the treated residual. Values: LANDF=Landfill, INJCT=Underground Injection, SURFI=Surface Impoundment, WSTPL=Waste Pile, RCYCL=Recycling, ENRGY=Energy Recovery, OTHRD=Other Disposal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LANDF|INJCT|SURFI|WSTPL|RCYCL|ENRGY|OTHRD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart K-N Disposal Standards

attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this treatment operation was performed as part of an emergency response action under CERCLA (Superfund) or RCRA Corrective Action. True=Emergency response treatment, False=Routine permitted treatment.
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 104; 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart D Contingency Plan

attributes.name: emission_control_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the air pollution control equipment used during thermal treatment operations (e.g., scrubbers, baghouses, electrostatic precipitators). Required for Clean Air Act (CAA) compliance and RCRA air emission standards.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart AA/BB/CC Air Emission Standards

attributes.name: input_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the input waste quantity. Values: KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, GAL=Gallons, L=Liters, TON=US Tons, MT=Metric Tonnes. Must align with manifest and facility reporting units.

attributes.name: input_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) assigned to the input waste stream. Determines applicable treatment standards and Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR).
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: input_waste_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of hazardous waste fed into the treatment unit for this operation, measured in the unit specified by input_quantity_unit. Critical for mass balance calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.73 Operating Record; 40 CFR Part 268.7 LDR Recordkeeping

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this treatment record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: ldr_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treated waste meets EPA Land Disposal Restrictions treatment standards and is eligible for land disposal. Values: COMPLIANT=Meets LDR standards, NON_COMPLIANT=Requires additional treatment, EXEMPT=Waste category exempt from LDR, PENDING_ANALYSIS=Awaiting analytical results.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional observations, deviations from standard procedures, equipment malfunctions, or other relevant information about the treatment operation. Supports operational troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: operator_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification number of the trained and certified operator who performed or supervised the treatment operation. RCRA requires personnel training and certification for hazardous waste treatment operations.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.16 Personnel Training; HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: output_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the output residual quantity. Values: KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, GAL=Gallons, L=Liters, TON=US Tons, MT=Metric Tonnes.

attributes.name: output_residual_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of treated residual material or byproduct remaining after treatment, measured in the unit specified by output_quantity_unit. Used for mass balance verification and subsequent disposal or recycling decisions.

attributes.name: output_waste_characterization
attributes.description: Description of the physical and chemical characteristics of the treated residual, including any remaining hazardous waste codes. Determines whether the residual meets Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR) treatment standards or requires further treatment.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 268.7 Waste Analysis and Recordkeeping; 40 CFR Part 261.3

attributes.name: pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Operating pressure in pounds per square inch (PSI) during treatment. Relevant for pressurized treatment technologies such as wet air oxidation or supercritical water oxidation.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality assurance review for this treatment record. Values: APPROVED=Record verified and approved by QA, REJECTED=Record failed QA review, PENDING_REVIEW=Awaiting QA review, NOT_REQUIRED=QA review not required for this operation.

attributes.name: regulatory_unit_code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned code identifying the specific treatment unit under the facility's RCRA Part B permit. Each unit has unique permit conditions, operating parameters, and waste acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: RCRA Part B Permit; 40 CFR Part 264.13

attributes.name: residence_time_minutes
attributes.description: The duration in minutes that the waste remained in the treatment unit. Critical for ensuring adequate contact time for chemical reactions, thermal destruction, or physical separation processes per permit specifications.
attributes.references: RCRA Part B Permit Operating Conditions; 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart O

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this treatment record originated. Values: SAP_EHS=SAP Environment Health and Safety module, ENVIANCE=Enviance EHS platform, MANUAL_ENTRY=Manually entered by operator, SCADA=Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system, LIMS=Laboratory Information Management System.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: stack_emission_test_result
attributes.description: Result of stack emission testing performed during or after the treatment operation to verify compliance with air quality standards. Values: PASS=Emissions within permitted limits, FAIL=Emissions exceed limits, NOT_TESTED=No test performed for this operation.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 60 Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources; Clean Air Act

attributes.name: tclp_test_performed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Test Performed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) test was performed on the treated residual to verify that hazardous characteristics have been successfully treated. True=TCLP performed, False=TCLP not performed.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261.24 Toxicity Characteristic; EPA Method 1311

attributes.name: tclp_test_result
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Test Result
attributes.description: Result of the TCLP test if performed. Values: PASS=Treated waste no longer exhibits toxicity characteristic, FAIL=Waste still exhibits toxicity characteristic, NOT_APPLICABLE=TCLP not required for this waste, PENDING=Test results not yet available.

attributes.name: treatment_batch_number
attributes.description: Internal batch identifier for grouping multiple treatment records that were processed together or as part of a continuous treatment campaign. Enables batch-level quality control and traceability.

attributes.name: treatment_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The total cost in US dollars incurred for this treatment operation, including labor, energy, consumables, and equipment depreciation. Used for cost accounting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP Cost Accounting Standards; SAP CO Module

attributes.name: treatment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the hazardous waste treatment operation was performed. Critical for regulatory reporting timelines and Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR) compliance tracking.

attributes.name: treatment_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: The calculated treatment efficiency expressed as a percentage, representing the degree of contaminant removal or destruction achieved. For incinerators, this is the Destruction and Removal Efficiency (DRE) which must meet or exceed 99.99% for most hazardous wastes.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.343 Performance Standards for Incinerators

attributes.name: treatment_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the treatment process was completed. Used to calculate total treatment duration and verify process completion per permit requirements.

attributes.name: treatment_ph_level
attributes.description: The pH level maintained during chemical treatment processes such as neutralization or chemical oxidation. Must be within permitted operating ranges to ensure effective treatment and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 264.17 General Requirements for Ignitable, Reactive, or Incompatible Wastes

attributes.name: treatment_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the treatment process began. Used to calculate residence time and verify compliance with treatment technology specifications.

attributes.name: treatment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the treatment operation. Values: COMPLETED=Treatment successfully finished, IN_PROGRESS=Treatment underway, FAILED=Treatment did not meet specifications, ABORTED=Treatment stopped before completion, PENDING_VERIFICATION=Awaiting analytical confirmation of treatment effectiveness.

attributes.name: treatment_technology_code
attributes.description: EPA-defined code representing the treatment technology applied. Values: INCIN=Incineration, NEUTR=Neutralization, STBLZ=Stabilization, FBLEN=Fuel Blending, SOLVR=Solvent Recovery, CARBN=Carbon Adsorption, WETOX=Wet Air Oxidation, CHOXD=Chemical Oxidation, CMBST=Combustion, DEACT=Deactivation, MACRO=Macroencapsulation, RORGS=Recovery of Organics, RMETL=Recovery of Metals, WTRRX=Water Reaction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INCIN|NEUTR|STBLZ|FBLEN|SOLVR|CARBN|WETOX|CHOXD|CMBST|DEACT|MACRO|RORGS|RMETL|WTRRX — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 268.42 Treatment Standards; EPA RCRA Waste Codes

attributes.name: treatment_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Operating temperature of the treatment process in degrees Celsius. Critical parameter for thermal treatment technologies (incineration, combustion) to ensure destruction and removal efficiency (DRE) requirements are met.

products.name: disposal_record
products.description: Final disposal confirmation record documenting the ultimate fate of hazardous waste at a permitted TSDF. Captures disposal date, TSDF facility ID, disposal method (landfill cell, deep well injection, incineration ash disposal), disposal unit ID, waste quantity disposed (lbs/tons), manifest number, certificate of disposal number, land disposal restriction (LDR) compliance certification, and TSDF signature. Closes the cradle-to-grave tracking loop required by RCRA Subtitle C.
products.reference: Certificate of Disposal / RCRA LDR Disposal Certification

The applicable tipping fee schedule must be traceable from the disposal record for billin

Direct link is required for disposal cost

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.hazmat_container. Business justification: disposal_record documents the final disposal of hazardous waste. Linking to hazmat_container.hazmat_container_id completes the cradle-to-grave tracking chain at the container level — from generation t

attributes.description: EPA-issued 12-character identification number for the TSDF facility performing the disposal. Required for all permitted hazardous waste treatment, storage, and disposal facilities.

attributes.name: primary_waste_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_code. Business justification: Disposal record has waste_code_primary (string) but no FK to waste_code reference table. Adding FK provides standardized waste code lookup. Keep waste_code_primary string as it may differ from manifes

attributes.description: EPA ID number of the transporter who delivered the waste to the TSDF. Documents the transportation link in the chain of custody.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 263; DOT HMR Transportation Requirements

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Identifier of the permitted TSDF facility where the hazardous waste was ultimately disposed. References the facility authorized under RCRA Subtitle C for final disposal operations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA TSDF Permit Requirements

attributes.name: tsdf_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Disposal operations governed by TSDF permit conditions (40 CFR 264 Subpart N). Permit defines disposal unit capacity, waste codes, and LDR compliance requirements. Core regulatory relationship for dis

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. attributes.name: waste_profile_id

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Transportation document number accompanying the hazardous waste shipment. Links disposal record to DOT shipping documentation for compliance verification.
attributes.references: DOT HMR 49 CFR Part 172; Bill of Lading Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_of_disposal_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued by the TSDF confirming final disposal of the hazardous waste. Provides legal documentation that waste has been properly disposed per RCRA requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; TSDF Certificate of Disposal Standards

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Number of containers (drums, totes, boxes) disposed as part of this disposal record. Tracks physical container units received and processed by the TSDF.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264 Subpart I; DOT HMR Container Requirements

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any discrepancies found between manifest documentation and actual waste received. Documents variances for regulatory reporting and resolution.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.72; EPA Discrepancy Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: discrepancy_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any discrepancies were identified between the manifest and actual waste received (quantity, type, condition). Triggers discrepancy reporting requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.72; EPA Discrepancy Reporting

attributes.name: disposal_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the disposal process was fully completed and the record was finalized. Marks the official closure of the cradle-to-grave tracking cycle.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Manifest Closure Requirements

attributes.name: disposal_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost charged by the TSDF for disposal of this waste shipment. Includes tipping fees, treatment costs, and any surcharges. Used for billing and cost tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards; TSDF Fee Schedules

attributes.name: disposal_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the disposal cost amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations for international waste disposal.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP Multi-Currency Standards

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazardous waste was physically disposed at the TSDF facility. Represents the final step in the cradle-to-grave tracking process and closes the manifest lifecycle.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Manifest Completion Requirements

attributes.name: disposal_method_code
attributes.description: EPA-standardized code identifying the disposal method used (e.g., D80 for landfill, D81 for underground injection, D82 for incineration ash disposal). Defines the ultimate fate of the hazardous waste.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Waste Management Codes

attributes.name: disposal_method_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the disposal method employed at the TSDF, including specific technology, process, or unit operation used for final waste disposition.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; TSDF Operating Procedures

attributes.name: disposal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the disposal record in the TSDF workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through disposal to final certification and manifest closure.

attributes.name: emergency_response_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether emergency response procedures were activated during receipt or disposal of this waste. Triggers incident reporting and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120; RCRA Contingency Plan Requirements

attributes.name: ldr_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the TSDF certified LDR compliance for the disposed waste. Documents when treatment standards were verified prior to land disposal.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 268; EPA LDR Certification Requirements

attributes.name: ldr_compliance_certified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the TSDF has certified that the waste meets Land Disposal Restriction treatment standards prior to disposal. Required for restricted hazardous wastes under RCRA.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 268; EPA Land Disposal Restrictions

attributes.name: ldr_treatment_method
attributes.description: Description of the treatment method applied to meet LDR standards before disposal (e.g., stabilization, neutralization, thermal treatment). Required for restricted waste codes.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 268; EPA LDR Treatment Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or observations related to the disposal event. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this disposal record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this disposal record was last modified. Tracks changes and updates throughout the disposal workflow and certification process.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory reports related to this disposal were submitted to EPA or state environmental agencies. Documents compliance with reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.75; State Environmental Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether required regulatory reports (e.g., biennial report, exception report) have been submitted for this disposal event. Tracks compliance reporting obligations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.75; EPA Biennial Report Requirements

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejection of the waste shipment by the TSDF, if applicable. Documents why waste was not accepted for disposal (e.g., failed waste profile, prohibited material, damaged containers).
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264.13; TSDF Waste Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created or manages this disposal record (e.g., Enviance EHS, SAP EHS, TSDF proprietary system). Supports data lineage and integration tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; System Integration Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special handling, processing, or disposal instructions required for this waste stream. Documents unique requirements for safe and compliant disposal operations.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; OSHA HAZWOPER 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized TSDF representative who signed and certified the disposal record. Provides accountability for disposal confirmation.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Manifest Signature Requirements

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the TSDF representative signed the disposal record, confirming receipt and disposal of the hazardous waste shipment.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Manifest Completion Timeline

attributes.name: tsdf_signature_title
attributes.business_glossary_term: Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF) Signature Title
attributes.description: Job title of the TSDF representative who signed the disposal record (e.g., Facility Manager, Environmental Compliance Officer). Establishes authority of signatory.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; TSDF Operating Procedures

attributes.name: waste_code_primary
attributes.description: Primary EPA hazardous waste code (D, F, K, P, or U list) identifying the principal hazardous characteristic or listing of the disposed waste. Determines regulatory requirements and disposal restrictions.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261; EPA Hazardous Waste Code System

attributes.name: waste_codes_additional
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional EPA hazardous waste codes applicable to the disposed waste. Captures multiple hazardous characteristics or listings for mixed waste streams.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 261; EPA Hazardous Waste Code System

attributes.name: waste_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste disposed, measured in pounds. Represents the actual weight accepted and disposed by the TSDF facility.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Waste Quantity Reporting Standards

attributes.name: waste_quantity_tons
attributes.description: Total quantity of hazardous waste disposed, measured in tons. Calculated or measured weight for regulatory reporting and capacity tracking purposes.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Waste Quantity Reporting Standards

attributes.name: waste_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Volume of liquid or semi-liquid hazardous waste disposed, measured in gallons. Used for liquid waste streams and deep well injection disposal methods.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Part 264; EPA Volume Measurement Standards

products.name: epa_id_registration

Captures EPA ID number, site name, site address, regulated activity types (generator, transporter, TSDF), RCRA notification form submission date, notification type (initial, subsequent, withdrawal), handler status, large/small/very small quantity generator classification, and state agency notification status. Serves as the regulatory identity anchor for all RCRA compliance activities. Sourced from EPA RCRAInfo and Enviance EHS.
products.reference: EPA ID Number / RCRA Site ID (RCRAInfo)

attributes.name: epa_id_number

attributes.name: handler_type

attributes.name: is_transporter

attributes.name: is_tsdf
