attributes.name: total_waste_managed_onsite_lbs
attributes.description: The total quantity of hazardous waste treated, stored, or disposed of on-site at the generator facility during the reporting year, measured in pounds.

attributes.name: total_waste_shipped_offsite_lbs
attributes.description: The total quantity of hazardous waste shipped off-site to Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facilities (TSDFs) during the reporting year, measured in pounds.

attributes.name: waste_minimization_achieved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility achieved measurable waste minimization or source reduction during the reporting year. True = minimization achieved, False = no reduction.

attributes.name: waste_minimization_activities
attributes.description: Narrative description of waste minimization, source reduction, and pollution prevention activities undertaken during the reporting year. Required disclosure per RCRA biennial reporting requirements.

products.name: waste_code
products.description: Reference table of EPA and state hazardous waste codes used to classify hazardous waste streams. Captures waste code (D001–D043, F-listed, K-listed, P-listed, U-listed), waste code description, hazard basis (ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity, toxicity, listed), regulatory citation (40 CFR Part 261 subpart), applicable treatment standards, state-specific code flag, and active status. Used across waste profiles, manifests, and regulatory reports for standardized waste classification.
products.reference: EPA Hazardous Waste Code (40 CFR Part 261)

attributes.name: waste_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the waste code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.dot_hazmat_classification. Business justification: waste_code has dot_hazard_class (STRING) as a denormalized field. Adding dot_hazmat_classification_id normalizes the DOT hazard class reference to the dot_hazmat_classification master record, enabling

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Each RCRA waste code is defined by and subject to specific regulatory requirements (LDR standards, treatment standards, reporting obligations). waste_code.regulatory_citation is a denormalized referen

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code is currently active and should be used for new waste classifications. True for codes in current regulatory use. False for obsolete, superseded, or delisted codes that are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: acute_hazardous_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code designates an acutely hazardous waste under RCRA. True for P-listed wastes and certain F-listed wastes that are subject to more stringent quantity thresholds (1 kg vs 100 kg for generator status determination) and management requirements.

attributes.name: container_type_restriction
attributes.description: Specific container or packaging requirements for this waste code during storage and transportation. May specify DOT-approved containers, compatibility requirements, or prohibited container materials. Critical for safe handling and DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations compliance.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Parts 172-173 - DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delisting_petition_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generators may petition EPA to delist this waste code for specific waste streams that do not exhibit hazardous characteristics. True for listed wastes (F, K, P, U codes) where site-specific delisting is possible. False for characteristic wastes (D codes) which cannot be delisted.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this waste code became effective under federal or state regulations. Used to determine applicability to historical waste streams and to track regulatory changes over time. Critical for legacy waste management and compliance audits.

attributes.name: generator_accumulation_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days a generator may accumulate this waste on-site before shipping to a TSDF. Typically 90 days for large quantity generators, 180 days for small quantity generators, or 270 days with approved extension. Shorter limits (e.g., 1 day) may apply to acutely hazardous wastes.

attributes.name: hazard_basis
attributes.description: Primary hazard characteristic that qualifies this waste as hazardous under RCRA. Ignitability (D001) covers flammable liquids and oxidizers. Corrosivity (D002) covers acids and bases. Reactivity (D003) covers unstable or explosive materials. Toxicity (D004-D043) covers materials that leach toxic constituents. Listed wastes are hazardous by definition regardless of characteristics. Multiple indicates waste exhibits more than one characteristic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste code record was last updated. Tracks regulatory changes, data corrections, and reference updates. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, clarifications, or internal guidance for using this waste code. May include common misclassifications to avoid, industry-specific interpretations, or cross-references to related codes. Free-text field for subject matter expert annotations.

attributes.name: prohibited_method_code
attributes.description: Management method codes that are prohibited for this waste code under Land Disposal Restrictions. Typically references disposal methods that are banned without prior treatment (e.g., landfill disposal, deep well injection). Comma-separated list if multiple methods are prohibited.

attributes.name: recycling_potential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code has known recycling or reclamation pathways that may qualify for reduced regulatory requirements under RCRA recycling exemptions. True if legitimate recycling options exist (e.g., solvent recovery, metal reclamation, fuel blending).

attributes.name: reportable_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: CERCLA reportable quantity in pounds. If a spill or release of this waste equals or exceeds this quantity, it must be reported to the National Response Center immediately. Values typically range from 1 lb (most hazardous) to 5,000 lbs. Null if no RQ is assigned.

attributes.name: small_quantity_exclusion_kg
attributes.description: Quantity threshold in kilograms below which a generator may qualify for reduced regulatory requirements. Typically 100 kg per month for hazardous waste or 1 kg per month for acutely hazardous waste. Used to determine generator category (VSQG, SQG, LQG).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for state-specific waste codes. Null for federal EPA codes. Used to identify which state jurisdiction defines and enforces this code. Critical for multi-state operations to ensure compliance with local regulations.

attributes.name: state_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code is a state-specific designation beyond federal EPA requirements. True when the code is defined by state environmental regulations and may not be recognized in other states. False for federal EPA codes that apply nationwide.

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Date when this waste code was or will be removed from regulatory lists. Null for active codes. Populated when EPA or state agencies delist a waste code or when state-specific codes are superseded. Historical record retention required for audit trails.
attributes.references: Federal Register or State Regulatory Updates

attributes.name: tclp_constituent
attributes.description: Specific toxic constituent measured in TCLP testing for toxicity characteristic wastes. Examples include arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, selenium, silver, benzene, trichloroethylene. Only populated for D-code toxicity characteristic wastes (D004-D043).

attributes.name: tclp_regulatory_level_mg_l
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Regulatory Level (mg/L)
attributes.description: Maximum concentration in milligrams per liter of TCLP extract that triggers hazardous waste classification for toxicity characteristic wastes. Waste exceeding this level must be managed as hazardous. Only applicable to D-code toxicity characteristic wastes.

attributes.name: toxicity_characteristic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste code is based on Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) test results. True for D004-D043 codes where waste is hazardous if TCLP extract exceeds regulatory levels for specific contaminants. Requires periodic testing to confirm classification.

attributes.name: treatment_standard_code
attributes.description: Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR) treatment standard code that applies to this waste before land disposal. References 40 CFR Part 268 treatment standards. Specifies required treatment technology or concentration limits (e.g., DEACT for deactivation, IMERC for incineration, specific mg/L or mg/kg limits for TCLP constituents).

attributes.name: treatment_subcategory
attributes.description: Subcategory designation for wastes with multiple treatment standards based on waste form or concentration. Used when a single waste code has different treatment requirements for wastewater versus non-wastewater forms, or for different concentration ranges.

attributes.name: universal_treatment_standard
attributes.description: Universal Treatment Standard concentration limits for underlying hazardous constituents. Specifies maximum allowable concentrations (in mg/L for TCLP or mg/kg total) for each constituent before the waste can be land disposed. Multiple constituents may be listed with their respective limits.

attributes.name: waste_code
attributes.description: EPA or state hazardous waste code identifier. Format follows EPA classification: D-codes (D001-D043 for characteristic wastes), F-codes (F001-F039 for non-specific source wastes), K-codes (K001-K181 for specific source wastes), P-codes (P001-P205 for acutely hazardous commercial chemical products), U-codes (U001-U411 for toxic commercial chemical products). This is the business identifier used across manifests, profiles, and regulatory reports.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 - Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: waste_code_type
attributes.description: Classification category of the waste code. D-listed are characteristic wastes (ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity, toxicity). F-listed are wastes from non-specific sources. K-listed are wastes from specific sources. P-listed are acutely hazardous discarded commercial chemical products. U-listed are toxic discarded commercial chemical products. State-specific codes are additional classifications imposed by state environmental agencies.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 Subparts C and D

attributes.name: waste_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the waste stream or material covered by this code. Includes physical characteristics, chemical composition, source process, and typical examples. Used by generators and TSDFs to match waste streams to appropriate codes.

attributes.name: waste_minimization_code
attributes.description: Code indicating applicable waste minimization or source reduction strategies for this waste stream. References EPA waste minimization guidance and best management practices. Used in biennial reports and pollution prevention planning.

products.name: dot_hazmat_classification
products.description: Reference table of DOT Hazardous Materials classifications per 49 CFR Parts 171–180 (HMR). Captures hazard class/division (1–9), UN/NA number, proper shipping name, packing group (I/II/III), label requirements, placard requirements, special provisions, packaging authorizations, quantity limits for passenger/cargo aircraft, and marine pollutant flag. Used to populate manifest shipping descriptions and ensure DOT HMR compliance for all hazardous waste transport.
products.reference: DOT HMR Hazardous Materials Table (49 CFR 172.101)

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_classification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Classification ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DOT hazardous materials classification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: surcharge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.surcharge. Business justification: DOT hazmat classifications (hazard class, packing group, placard requirements) trigger specific billing surcharges (hazmat handling surcharge, placard surcharge, emergency response surcharge). Billing

attributes.name: cargo_aircraft_quantity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum net quantity per package permitted on cargo-only aircraft. May be expressed as weight (kg), volume (L), or 'Forbidden' if not permitted.

attributes.name: classification_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this classification entry became effective in the Hazardous Materials Regulations. Used to track regulatory changes over time.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory status of this classification entry. Active = currently in force, Superseded = replaced by newer entry, Withdrawn = no longer valid.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this classification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: erg_guide_number
attributes.description: Three-digit guide number from the DOT Emergency Response Guidebook that provides first responders with initial action guidance for incidents involving this material.

attributes.name: excepted_quantity_code
attributes.description: Code (E0-E5) indicating the maximum quantity per inner packaging permitted under excepted quantity provisions, which allow minimal regulatory requirements for very small quantities.

attributes.name: exceptions
attributes.description: Reference to regulatory sections (e.g., 173.###) that provide exceptions or reduced requirements for limited quantities, small quantities, or specific transport modes.

attributes.name: forbidden_cargo_aircraft
attributes.description: Indicates whether transport of this material on cargo-only aircraft is prohibited under any circumstances.

attributes.name: forbidden_passenger_aircraft
attributes.description: Indicates whether transport of this material on passenger-carrying aircraft is prohibited under any circumstances.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Primary hazard class or division (1-9) assigned to the material based on its predominant hazard. Examples: 1.1 (explosives), 2.1 (flammable gas), 3 (flammable liquid), 4.1 (flammable solid), 5.1 (oxidizer), 6.1 (toxic), 7 (radioactive), 8 (corrosive), 9 (miscellaneous).

attributes.name: hazard_division
attributes.description: Subdivision within a hazard class that further categorizes the material by specific hazard characteristics (e.g., 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 6.1). May be null for classes without divisions.

attributes.name: inhalation_hazard_zone
attributes.description: For materials that are poisonous by inhalation, the hazard zone (A, B, C, or D) indicating the degree of inhalation toxicity. Zone A is the most toxic.

attributes.name: label_code
attributes.description: Code(s) identifying the required hazard warning label(s) that must be affixed to packages. Multiple labels may be required for materials with subsidiary hazards. Examples: 3 (flammable liquid), 6.1 (poison), 8 (corrosive).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this classification record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is eligible for limited quantity exceptions, which allow reduced packaging, marking, and labeling requirements when transported in small quantities.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_max_net
attributes.description: Maximum net quantity per inner receptacle or article permitted under limited quantity provisions. Expressed as weight or volume.

attributes.name: marine_pollutant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is designated as a marine pollutant under DOT and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code regulations. Requires special marking and handling for water transport.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to this classification entry. May include references to specific regulatory amendments or interpretations.

attributes.name: packaging_authorizations
attributes.description: Codes referencing the authorized packaging sections (e.g., 173.###) that specify which container types and specifications are approved for this material.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Degree of danger presented by the material during transport. I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Used to determine packaging requirements and quantity limits.

attributes.name: passenger_aircraft_quantity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum net quantity per package permitted on passenger-carrying aircraft. May be expressed as weight (kg), volume (L), or 'Forbidden' if not permitted.

attributes.name: placard_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific placard design required for the transport vehicle. Examples: FLAMMABLE, CORROSIVE, POISON, OXIDIZER, DANGEROUS.

attributes.name: placard_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether placards must be displayed on the transport vehicle for this material when transported in specified quantities.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: The official DOT-approved name used to describe the hazardous material on shipping papers, manifests, and labels. Must match the Hazardous Materials Table entry exactly.

attributes.name: reportable_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: The threshold quantity (in pounds) at or above which a spill or release of this material must be reported to the National Response Center under CERCLA. Null if no RQ applies.

attributes.name: severe_marine_pollutant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as a severe marine pollutant (PP designation) requiring enhanced environmental protection measures during marine transport.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special provision codes (e.g., B1, IB2, T4, TP1) that impose additional requirements or grant exceptions for packaging, handling, or transport of this material.

attributes.name: subsidiary_hazard_class
attributes.description: Secondary hazard class(es) for materials that present more than one type of hazard. Multiple subsidiary classes may be listed, separated by commas.

attributes.name: superseded_by_un_na_number
attributes.description: If this classification has been superseded, the UN/NA number of the replacement classification entry. Null if status is active.

attributes.name: technical_name_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technical or chemical name of the hazardous constituent(s) must be entered in parentheses after the proper shipping name on shipping papers.

attributes.name: un_na_number
attributes.description: Four-digit identification number assigned by the United Nations or North America to hazardous materials for international and domestic transport. Format: UN#### or NA####.

attributes.name: vessel_stowage_location
attributes.description: Code indicating where the material must be stowed on a vessel (e.g., A = on deck only, B = under deck, C = on or under deck). Applies to marine transport.

attributes.name: vessel_stowage_other
attributes.description: Additional stowage requirements or restrictions for marine transport, such as segregation from other materials, ventilation requirements, or temperature controls.

products.name: storage_unit
products.description: Master record for permitted hazardous waste storage units at generator sites or TSDFs. Captures unit ID, unit type (satellite accumulation area, 90-day accumulation area, permitted storage tank, container storage building, drip pad, containment building), physical location, maximum permitted capacity (gallons/lbs), secondary containment type, inspection frequency requirement, permit or exemption basis, current inventory quantity, and unit status (active, closed, under inspection). Supports RCRA storage time limit tracking.

attributes.name: storage_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste storage unit. Primary key for the storage unit master record.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TSDF facility or generator site where this storage unit is located. Links to the facility master record for site-level attributes.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fixed_asset. Business justification: Hazmat storage units (tanks, containment vaults, satellite accumulation areas) are capitalized fixed assets. Linking enables capital project planning for storage unit upgrades, depreciation tracking,

attributes.name: hazardous_waste_generator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hazardous waste generator that operates this storage unit. Applicable when the unit is at a generator site rather than a TSDF.

attributes.name: inspection_checklist_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.inspection_checklist. Business justification: RCRA mandates documented periodic inspections of hazmat storage units with standardized checklists. Linking storage_unit to asset.inspection_checklist assigns the regulatory-compliant inspection proto

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Storage units operate under facility permit with specific conditions (40 CFR 264/265 Subpart I). Permit defines storage capacity, waste codes, and time limits. Required for permit compliance verificat

attributes.name: tsdf_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.tsdf_facility. Business justification: storage_unit can exist at a generator site OR at a TSDF. Currently storage_unit links to asset.facility (via facility_id) and hazardous_waste_generator (for generator-side units). For TSDF-side storag

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.waste_stream. Business justification: Storage units are designated for specific waste streams; waste stream classification determines permitted waste codes, incompatibility restrictions, accumulation time limits, and inspection protocols.

attributes.name: building_location
attributes.description: Physical building or structure identifier where the storage unit is located within the facility campus.

attributes.name: closure_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification number issued by regulatory authority confirming that the storage unit closure was completed in accordance with RCRA requirements.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage unit was permanently closed and decommissioned. Applicable for units that have completed RCRA closure procedures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage unit record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: current_inventory_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of hazardous waste stored in the unit at the time of last inventory update. Measured in the unit of measure specified for this storage unit.

attributes.name: emergency_response_zone
attributes.description: Emergency response zone designation for this storage unit within the facility emergency action plan. Used for HAZWOPER response coordination.

attributes.name: exemption_basis
attributes.description: Regulatory basis under which this storage unit operates without a full RCRA permit. Identifies the specific exemption category that applies.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed to protect the storage unit. Required for certain hazardous waste storage configurations.
attributes.references: NFPA Fire Protection Standards, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the storage unit location in decimal degrees format for spatial tracking and emergency response.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the storage unit location in decimal degrees format for spatial tracking and emergency response.

attributes.name: incompatible_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA waste codes that must not be stored in this unit due to incompatibility concerns. Used to prevent dangerous chemical reactions.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Required frequency for routine inspections of the storage unit measured in days. Satellite accumulation areas require weekly inspections; 90-day areas require daily inspections per RCRA.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage unit was installed and commissioned for use. Used for tracking unit age and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: inventory_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used for tracking inventory quantity in this storage unit. Must align with the capacity measurement unit.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent routine inspection performed on this storage unit. Used to track compliance with inspection frequency requirements.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage capacity of the unit measured in gallons. Applicable for liquid waste storage tanks and container storage areas. Regulatory limit that must not be exceeded.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_pounds
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage capacity of the unit measured in pounds. Applicable for solid waste storage areas and satellite accumulation points. Regulatory limit that must not be exceeded.

attributes.name: maximum_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for safe storage of waste in this unit. Applicable when temperature control is required.

attributes.name: minimum_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for safe storage of waste in this unit. Applicable when temperature control is required.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage unit record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes to unit configuration or status.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date when the next routine inspection is required based on inspection frequency. Used for compliance scheduling and alerts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or historical information about the storage unit.

attributes.name: permitted_waste_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) Permitted Waste Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes that are authorized for storage in this unit. Restricts the types of waste that may be placed in the unit.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Description of personal protective equipment required for personnel working in or inspecting this storage unit. Based on hazard assessment of stored wastes.

attributes.name: room_area_designation
attributes.description: Specific room number, area code, or zone designation within the building for precise location identification.

attributes.name: storage_time_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days that hazardous waste may be stored in this unit before shipment is required. Varies by unit type: satellite accumulation has no time limit until 55 gallons accumulated; 90-day areas have 90-day limit.

attributes.name: temperature_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage unit requires active temperature control to maintain waste stability and prevent hazardous conditions. True for temperature-sensitive wastes.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation for the storage unit, used by facility personnel for identification and communication.

attributes.name: unit_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage unit, used in facility documentation, permits, and operational tracking. Externally visible unit designation.

attributes.name: unit_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage unit in its lifecycle. Active units are available for waste storage; inactive units are temporarily out of service; closed units have completed closure procedures.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage unit based on RCRA regulatory categories. Determines applicable storage time limits, capacity restrictions, and operational requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: satellite_accumulation_area|90_day_accumulation_area|permitted_storage_tank|container_storage_building|drip_pad|containment_building|less_than_90_day_area — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ventilation_system_type
attributes.description: Type of ventilation system installed to control vapor accumulation and maintain air quality in the storage area. Required for volatile hazardous waste storage.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106, EPA Air Quality Standards

products.name: transporter_registration
products.description: Master record for EPA-registered hazardous waste transporters authorized to transport waste on behalf of Waste Management. Captures transporter EPA ID, company name, DOT operating authority number, state transporter permits, insurance certificate details, vehicle types authorized, waste types authorized, HAZMAT employee training compliance status, and approval status for use on manifests. Distinct from the fleet domain's vehicle records — this is the regulatory transporter entity identity.
products.reference: EPA Hazardous Waste Transporter Registration / DOT Operating Authority

attributes.name: transporter_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous waste transporter registration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: epa_id_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.epa_id_registration. Business justification: Hazardous waste transporters must be EPA-registered. The epa_id_number string duplicates epa_id_registration data. Adding FK normalizes this relationship and provides a third inbound link to epa_id_re

attributes.name: hauling_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.hauling_agreement. Business justification: Registered hazmat transporters operate under hauling agreements defining routes, rates, insurance requirements, DOT compliance. Transporter assignment validates active agreement, insurance coverage, a

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the transporter was approved for use by Waste Management for hazardous waste transportation services.

attributes.name: approved_for_manifest_use
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transporter is currently approved for use on hazardous waste manifests. False indicates transporter cannot be selected for new shipments.

attributes.name: authorized_dot_hazard_classes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorized Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazard Classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of DOT hazard classes (1-9) that the transporter is authorized to transport based on DOT operating authority and vehicle placarding.

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle types the transporter is authorized and equipped to operate for hazardous waste transport (e.g., tanker truck, box truck, flatbed, roll-off, vacuum truck).
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 177 - DOT Carriage by Public Highway

attributes.name: authorized_waste_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EPA hazardous waste codes (D, F, K, P, U series) that the transporter is authorized and equipped to handle based on permits, equipment, and training.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 - Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company providing cargo insurance coverage for hazardous waste in transit.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total cargo insurance coverage amount in USD for hazardous waste shipments in transit.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current cargo insurance policy expires. Transporter must maintain continuous coverage to remain approved.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the cargo insurance coverage protecting hazardous waste shipments in transit.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 387 - Minimum Levels of Financial Responsibility

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the transporter company headquarters or principal place of business is located.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the transporter company headquarters. Typically USA for domestic transporters.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transporter registration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dot_operating_authority_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Operating Authority Number
attributes.description: DOT motor carrier operating authority number (MC, FF, or MX number) required for interstate hazardous materials transportation. Format: MC-XXXXXX or FF-XXXXXX.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 107 - DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the 24/7 emergency response contact at the transporter company for incident response and HAZWOPER coordination.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 emergency phone number for incident response and spill coordination. Must be monitored at all times during transport operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the transporter registration expires and must be renewed. Null for indefinite registrations subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: hazmat_employee_training_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Employee Training Compliance Status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the transporters HAZMAT employee training program per DOT HMR requirements. All drivers and handlers must receive training every 3 years.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart H - Training Requirements

attributes.name: hazmat_training_last_verified_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Training Last Verified Date
attributes.description: Date when Waste Management last verified that the transporter maintains compliant HAZMAT employee training records and certifications.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart H - Training Requirements

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance and performance review conducted for this transporter.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company providing hazardous waste transporter liability coverage for this transporter.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total liability insurance coverage amount in USD. Minimum coverage requirements vary by waste type and quantity transported.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current liability insurance policy became effective.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current liability insurance policy expires. Transporter must maintain continuous coverage to remain approved.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the transporter liability insurance coverage. Required for RCRA compliance and vendor approval.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transporter registration record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic compliance and performance review is scheduled for this transporter.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special handling requirements, restrictions, preferred use cases, or other relevant information about the transporter.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or ZIP+4 code for the transporter company headquarters or principal place of business.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address for the primary contact at the transporter company.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the transporter company for coordination and communication.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number for the primary contact at the transporter company.

products.name: waste_profile_code_listing
products.description: This association product represents the Waste Code Listing between waste_profile and waste_code. It captures the regulatory assignment of each applicable EPA or state hazardous waste code to a specific waste characterization profile, as required by RCRA and documented on the EPA Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest (Box 13). Each record links one waste_profile to one waste_code with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific profile-code pairing, including the measured concentration that triggered the code, the basis for listing, and whether this is the primary code for the profile.. Existence Justification: Under RCRA regulations, a single hazardous waste stream (waste_profile) must be characterized by ALL applicable EPA waste codes simultaneously — a drum of solvent waste may carry D001 (ignitability), D018 (benzene toxicity), and F005 (spent solvent) concurrently. Conversely, a single waste code (e.g., D001) applies to thousands of different waste profiles across different generators. This is a genuine operational M:N: the EPA manifest form (Box 13) explicitly lists multiple waste codes per waste stream, and the business actively manages which codes apply to each profile during the approval process.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Profile Code Listing - Waste Profile Code Listing Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the waste_profile_code_listing association

attributes.name: waste_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Profile Code Listing - Waste Code Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the EPA or state hazardous waste code assigned to this profile.

attributes.name: waste_profile_id

attributes.name: basis_for_listing
attributes.description: The specific reason or measured property that caused this waste code to apply to this waste profile. For characteristic codes (D-codes), this captures the measured property (e.g., flash point, pH, TCLP result). For listed codes (F/K/P/U), this captures the process or source that qualifies the waste. Belongs to the profile-code pairing, not to either entity alone.
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 Subparts B, C, D

attributes.name: concentration_threshold_mg_l
attributes.description: The measured TCLP extract concentration in mg/L for this specific waste stream that triggered a toxicity characteristic waste code (D004–D043). This value is specific to the waste profile and the code pairing — the same waste code may be triggered at different concentrations across different profiles.

attributes.name: epa_waste_codes

[Moved from waste_profile: This denormalized STRING field stores a comma-separated list of all applicable waste codes for the profile — the direct symptom of the suppressed M:N relationship. Once the waste_profile_code_listing association table is created, all waste code assignments are normalized into individual records and this field becomes redundant and should be removed.]
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 261 - Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste

attributes.name: primary_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_citation_override

products.name: storage_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between waste_profile and storage_unit. It captures the formal RCRA-required authorization that permits a specific hazardous waste profile to be stored in a specific storage unit. Each record documents that a named waste stream has been evaluated for compatibility with a named unit, approved by the responsible compliance officer, and assigned a quantity limit and expiration date. Records are created during the waste profile approval workflow, updated when permit conditions change, and revoked when incompatibilities are identified or permits lapse.. Existence Justification: In RCRA-regulated hazardous waste operations, a waste profile must be explicitly approved for storage in specific units before waste can be placed there — a single waste profile may be authorized for multiple compatible storage units (e.g., a corrosive liquid approved for both a satellite accumulation area and a permitted storage tank), and a single storage unit may hold multiple approved waste profiles simultaneously. This compatibility authorization is an active, managed operational record: facility managers create it during the profile approval process, update it when permits change, and revoke it when incompatibilities are discovered. The relationship carries its own data (approval date, quantity limits, compatibility verification, expiration) that belongs to neither the profile nor the unit alone.

products.name: billing_rate_schedule
products.description: Master rate schedule defining the complete pricing structure for waste management services, including individual rate components and tipping fee configurations. Header captures rate schedule name, effective date range, service type (residential MSW, commercial dumpster, roll-off, tipping fee, recycling processing), billing model (flat rate, per-pickup, per-ton, per-yard, container rental), applicable customer segment, geographic zone, facility (for tipping fees), waste stream type, and approval status. Component detail captures charge elements (base fee, fuel surcharge, environmental fee, overage, disposal surcharge) with calculation method (fixed, percentage, per-unit), unit of measure, rate value, min/max charges, taxability, and GL mapping. Supports both external customer billing and internal transfer pricing. Managed in Oracle Revenue Management and SAP SD condition records.

products.name: cycle
products.description: Configuration entity defining the recurring billing schedule for customer accounts. Captures cycle code, frequency (monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, per-haul for roll-off), billing run date, invoice generation date, payment terms (net 30, net 15, net 45), grace period days, late fee trigger rules, and applicable customer segments. Each billing account is assigned to one billing cycle that governs when invoices are generated and when payments are due. Drives the automated billing run schedule in Oracle Revenue Management and determines AR aging calculations.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Date
attributes.description: The target date by which the dispute should be resolved per service level agreement commitments.

attributes.name: sox_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the dispute resolution followed SOX-compliant approval and documentation procedures for financial adjustments.

products.name: payment_plan
products.description: Structured installment arrangement established for customers unable to pay their full outstanding AR balance, including individual scheduled installment records. Header captures plan start/end dates, total balance enrolled, number of installments, installment amount, frequency, down payment, plan status (active, completed, defaulted, cancelled), and collection agent ID. Each installment detail captures sequence number, scheduled due date, scheduled amount, actual payment date, actual amount paid, installment status (scheduled, paid, missed, waived), and days past due. Supports residential hardship programs, commercial account workout agreements, and enables collections teams to track compliance and trigger dunning on missed installments.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment plan arrangement. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account enrolled in this payment plan.

attributes.name: billing_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.billing_term. Business justification: Payment plans are negotiated deviations from standard contract billing terms. Referencing the original billing_term being modified supports collections management, dunning configuration, and contract

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract. Business justification: Payment plans are negotiated as part of contract terms. Collections and credit teams need to trace payment arrangements back to originating agreement for covenant compliance, early termination penalty

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the payment plan was approved by management. Null if no approval was required.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment plan required management approval before activation. Typically true for large balances, extended terms, or settlement plans.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this plan. When true, installments are automatically charged to the customers payment method on file on each due date.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Auto Pay Configuration

attributes.name: bankruptcy_case_number
attributes.description: Court-assigned bankruptcy case number if this payment plan is part of a bankruptcy arrangement. Null for non-bankruptcy plans.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_chapter
attributes.description: Type of bankruptcy filing if this payment plan is part of a bankruptcy arrangement. Chapter 7 is liquidation; Chapter 11 is business reorganization; Chapter 13 is individual debt adjustment. Null for non-bankruptcy plans.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: default_threshold_count
attributes.description: Number of missed installments allowed before the plan is automatically moved to defaulted status. Typically 2 for standard plans, may be higher for hardship programs.

attributes.name: down_payment_amount
attributes.description: Initial payment required at plan setup before installment schedule begins. May be zero for certain hardship programs.

attributes.name: down_payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date the down payment was received and processed. Null if no down payment was required or if down payment is still outstanding.

attributes.name: enrolled_balance_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the original balance that was enrolled into this payment plan. May be less than original balance if customer made partial payment or if certain charges were excluded from the plan.

attributes.name: final_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the last installment payment. Represents the planned completion date of the payment plan.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Final Payment Due Date

attributes.name: first_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the first installment payment. Subsequent installments are calculated based on this date and the installment frequency.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - First Payment Due Date

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after installment due date before payment is considered missed. Standard grace period is typically 10 days.

attributes.name: installment_amount
attributes.description: Standard amount due for each installment payment. Calculated as (enrolled_balance_amount - down_payment_amount) / total_installment_count. Final installment may differ to account for rounding.

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which installment payments are scheduled. Monthly is most common; weekly and biweekly are used for residential hardship programs; quarterly may be used for large commercial accounts.

attributes.name: interest_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Total interest charges accrued on this payment plan to date. Zero for interest-free plans.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the enrolled balance, if any. Most residential hardship plans have zero interest; commercial workout agreements may include interest. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard late fee charged for each missed installment payment. May be waived for hardship programs.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Late Fee Configuration

attributes.name: missed_installment_count
attributes.description: Number of scheduled installments that were not paid by their due date. Used to determine default status and trigger collections escalation.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Missed Payment Count

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment plan record was last modified. Updated whenever plan status, payment amounts, or other attributes change.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special terms, customer circumstances, negotiation details, or other relevant information about this payment plan.

attributes.name: original_balance_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding accounts receivable (AR) balance at the time the payment plan was established. Represents the full amount owed before any plan payments were made.

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date the payment plan was completed, defaulted, or cancelled. Null for active or suspended plans. For completed plans, this is the date the final payment was received; for defaulted or cancelled plans, this is the date the plan was terminated.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Arrangement End Date

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the payment plan, formatted as PP-NNNNNNNN.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Arrangement Number

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date when the payment plan became active and the installment schedule began. Typically the date the plan was approved and down payment (if required) was received.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Arrangement Start Date

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment plan. Draft indicates plan is being set up but not yet active; active means plan is in effect and installments are being processed; completed indicates all installments paid successfully; defaulted means customer missed installments per default criteria; cancelled indicates plan was terminated before completion; suspended means plan is temporarily on hold pending resolution of dispute or other issue.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Arrangement Status

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment plan based on the business program and customer segment. Residential hardship programs support customers facing temporary financial difficulty; commercial workout agreements are negotiated arrangements for business accounts; standard installment plans are routine payment schedules; seasonal deferral plans accommodate seasonal business fluctuations; bankruptcy arrangements comply with court-ordered payment terms; settlement plans represent negotiated reduced-balance agreements.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Payment Arrangement Type

attributes.name: remaining_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance remaining on the payment plan after all payments received to date. Calculated as enrolled_balance_amount minus sum of all installment payments received.

attributes.name: settlement_discount_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of discount applied to the original balance as part of a settlement agreement. Zero for standard payment plans.

attributes.name: settlement_discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the original balance as part of a settlement agreement. Zero for standard payment plans. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20% discount).

attributes.name: total_installment_count
attributes.description: Total number of scheduled installment payments in this plan. Typically ranges from 3 to 24 installments depending on plan type and balance amount.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Number of Installments

attributes.name: total_late_fees_assessed
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all late fees assessed on this payment plan due to missed installments.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Late Fee Total

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all payments received against this payment plan, including down payment and all installment payments to date.
attributes.references: Oracle Revenue Management - Total Payments Received

Managed centrally to ensure consistent application across all billing runs.

The existing regulatory_authority and regulatory_reference columns are denormalized representations

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|municipal|government|non_profit|construction — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: applicability_service_type

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: collection|disposal|recycling|hazardous_waste|roll_off|compactor|special_waste|medical_waste — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_required

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the surcharge amount: percentage_of_base (percentage of base service charge), flat_fee (fixed dollar amount), per_ton (rate per ton of waste), per_yard (rate per cubic yard), per_pickup (rate per pickup event), per_container (rate per container), tiered (tiered rate structure), formula (custom formula-based calculation). attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this surcharge definition expires and can no longer be applied to new invoices. Nullable for open-ended surcharges. Part of the temporal validity range.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this surcharge definition becomes effective and can be applied to customer invoices. Part of the temporal validity range.

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Chart of Accounts, GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Customer-facing description of the surcharge as it appears on invoices. May differ from internal surcharge_name to provide clearer customer communication.

attributes.name: invoice_display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence order in which this surcharge should appear on customer invoices. Lower numbers appear first. Used to control invoice line item presentation.

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this surcharge should be prorated for partial billing periods (e.g., mid-month service start/stop). True if prorated, False if charged in full regardless of period.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this surcharge is applied on a recurring basis (e.g., monthly fuel surcharge) or is a one-time charge. True if recurring, False if one-time.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this surcharge is mandated by regulatory authority (EPA, state environmental agency, local solid waste authority) or is a discretionary business charge. True if regulatory-mandated, False if discretionary.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Regulations, State Environmental Quality Departments

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this surcharge is subject to sales tax or other applicable taxes. True if taxable, False if tax-exempt.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this surcharge definition record was last updated. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: maximum_charge
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount for this surcharge regardless of calculation basis. Nullable if no maximum applies. Ensures surcharge does not exceed a cap value.

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount for this surcharge regardless of calculation basis. Nullable if no minimum applies. Ensures surcharge meets a floor value.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, business rules, or special instructions for applying this surcharge. Used for internal documentation and billing team guidance.

attributes.name: rate_value
attributes.description: Current rate value for the surcharge. Interpretation depends on calculation_basis: for percentage_of_base this is the percentage (e.g., 5.5 for 5.5%), for flat_fee this is the dollar amount, for per_ton/per_yard/per_pickup/per_container this is the unit rate.

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this surcharge recurs: monthly (every month), quarterly (every quarter), annually (every year), per_service (each service event), one_time (single occurrence). Populated only when is_recurring is True.

attributes.name: revenue_category

attributes.name: surcharge_code

attributes.name: surcharge_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the surcharge as it appears on customer invoices (e.g., Fuel Surcharge, Environmental Fee, Regulatory Recovery Fee, Administrative Fee, Late Payment Fee).

attributes.name: surcharge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surcharge definition: active (currently in use), inactive (not in use), pending (approved but not yet effective), expired (past effective end date), suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: surcharge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the surcharge by business purpose: fuel (fuel cost recovery), environmental (environmental compliance fees), regulatory (regulatory recovery fees), administrative (administrative processing fees), late_payment (late payment penalties), disposal (special disposal fees), contamination (contamination processing fees), distance (distance-based fees), special_handling (special handling fees), other (miscellaneous surcharges). attributes.name: rate_schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the rate schedule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.description: Landfill or disposal facility tipping fee per ton passed through to customer. Reflects actual disposal costs at destination facility.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for weight-based pricing components including standard weight limit and overweight fees.

Each bundle has its own lifecycle independent of component offerings. Referenced by contract and billing domains for bundle-level pricing and fulfillment.

products.name: waste_stream
products.description: Reference catalog of waste stream classifications managed by the business. Defines MSW, C&D, recyclables (paper, plastic, metal, glass), organic/food waste, yard waste, hazardous waste (RCRA Subtitle C), universal waste, e-waste, and SRF/WTE feedstock streams. Each record includes the waste stream code, regulatory classification (EPA/RCRA/state), accepted container types, disposal pathway (landfill, MRF, WTE, TSDF), and diversion eligibility. This is the SSOT for waste stream taxonomy referenced across collection, recycling, landfill, and hazmat domains.
products.reference: Waste Stream Classification / EPA Waste Code / RCRA Waste Category

attributes.name: waste_stream_id

Regulatory

attributes.name: required_inspection_checklist_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.inspection_checklist. Business justification: RCRA and DOT regulations mandate specific container inspection protocols per waste stream (e.g., hazardous, medical, universal waste). This link drives compliance reporting, ensures correct checklists

attributes.name: training_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_requirement. The waste stream catalog must reference the applicable training requirement so that driver/operato

attributes.name: accepted_container_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of container types (Container Identification - CID codes) that are approved for this waste stream (e.g., 96-GAL-CART, 2-YD-DUMPSTER, 20-YD-ROLLOFF, COMPACTOR). References container master data.
attributes.references: Internal Container Management Standards, AMCS Platform Container Codes

attributes.name: commodity_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream has commodity market value (True) or represents a disposal cost (False). Applies to recyclable materials with resale value (paper, metal, plastic).
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Standards, Commodity Market Data

attributes.name: compaction_ratio_avg
attributes.description: Average compaction ratio (volume reduction factor) for this waste stream when compacted in collection vehicles or at disposal facilities. Used for capacity planning and route optimization.
attributes.references: SWANA Compaction Standards, Internal Fleet Operations Data

attributes.name: compostable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream is suitable for composting operations (True) or not (False). Applies to organic waste, food waste, and yard waste streams.
attributes.references: EPA Composting Standards, State Organic Waste Regulations

attributes.name: contamination_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable contamination percentage for this waste stream before it is rejected or reclassified (e.g., 10% contamination threshold for single-stream recycling). Used for quality control at MRF facilities.
attributes.references: MRF Quality Standards, State Recycling Contamination Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste stream classification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: density_lbs_per_cubic_yard
attributes.description: Average density of this waste stream measured in pounds per cubic yard. Used for weight estimation, capacity planning, and tipping fee calculations.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Density Standards, SWANA Technical Guidelines

attributes.name: disposal_pathway
attributes.description: Primary disposal or processing pathway for this waste stream: Landfill, Materials Recovery Facility (MRF), Waste-to-Energy (WTE), Treatment Storage and Disposal Facility (TSDF), Composting, or Recycling.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Management Hierarchy, SWANA Best Practices

attributes.name: diversion_credit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of this waste stream that counts toward landfill diversion rate calculations (0-100%). Reflects the portion that is recycled, composted, or converted to energy rather than landfilled.
attributes.references: State Diversion Rate Calculation Standards, EPA Waste Diversion Metrics

attributes.name: diversion_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream is eligible for diversion from landfill (True) or must be landfilled (False). Used to calculate diversion rates and sustainability metrics.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Diversion Standards, State Diversion Goals

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: epa_waste_code

attributes.name: ghg_emission_factor_co2e_per_ton
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emission Factor (Carbon Dioxide Equivalent - CO2e per Ton)
attributes.description: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emission factor for this waste stream expressed as kilograms of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) per ton of waste. Used for sustainability reporting and carbon footprint calculations.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98, IPCC Emission Factors

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Department of Transportation (DOT) hazard class for transportation purposes if the waste stream is hazardous (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 6 Toxic Substances, Class 9 Miscellaneous). Null for non-hazardous streams.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 172, Hazardous Materials Table

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste stream classification record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: manifest_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a hazardous waste manifest (tracking document) is required for this waste stream under RCRA regulations (True) or not (False). Applies to hazardous and universal waste streams.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Description of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required for handling this waste stream (e.g., gloves, respirators, chemical suits, eye protection). Null for streams with no special PPE requirements.

attributes.name: rcra_subtitle
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Subtitle
attributes.description: RCRA subtitle classification: C for hazardous waste, D for non-hazardous solid waste, N/A for streams not regulated under RCRA.

attributes.name: recyclable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream contains recyclable materials (True) or is non-recyclable (False). Drives routing to MRF facilities and recycling programs.
attributes.references: EPA Recyclable Materials Standards, SWANA MRF Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Federal and state regulatory classification code (e.g., RCRA Subtitle C for hazardous waste, RCRA Subtitle D for non-hazardous solid waste, state-specific codes). Determines handling, transport, and disposal requirements.
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Parts 260-279, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional regulatory requirements, restrictions, or compliance notes specific to this waste stream (e.g., state-specific handling requirements, permit conditions, reporting obligations).
attributes.references: State Environmental Regulations, Local Enforcement Agency Requirements

attributes.name: seasonal_variation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream exhibits significant seasonal volume variations (True) or has consistent year-round volumes (False). Examples include yard waste (seasonal) and MSW (consistent).
attributes.references: Internal Operations Planning Data, SWANA Seasonal Trends

attributes.name: special_handling_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream requires special handling procedures, equipment, or certifications (True) or can be handled through standard collection processes (False).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910, DOT Hazmat Regulations, Internal Safety Protocols

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the waste stream (e.g., Paper, Plastic, Metal, Glass, Food Waste, Yard Waste, Concrete, Asphalt, Wood). Provides granular classification for material recovery and processing.

attributes.name: tclp_testing_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Testing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) testing is required to determine hazardous characteristics (True) or not (False). Used for waste characterization and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline, UN1090 for acetone). Required for hazardous waste manifests and transportation. Null for non-hazardous streams.

attributes.name: waste_stream_category

attributes.name: waste_stream_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the waste stream (e.g., Municipal Solid Waste, Construction and Demolition Debris, Mixed Recyclables).

attributes.name: waste_stream_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this waste stream classification: Active (currently accepted), Inactive (temporarily not accepted), Restricted (accepted with limitations), or Phased Out (no longer accepted).

attributes.name: wte_feedstock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this waste stream is acceptable as feedstock for Waste-to-Energy (WTE) or Solid Recovered Fuel (SRF) conversion processes (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: EPA WTE Standards, Clean Air Act Regulations

Supports service eligibility validation at the customer address level — determining which offerings are available at a given location. Referenced by collection (route planning), contract (franchise compliance), and billing (geographic rate differentiation) domains.

products.name: bundle_composition
products.description: This association product represents the Composition relationship between a service bundle and its constituent service offerings. It captures which offerings are included in each bundle, in what quantity, at what pricing contribution, and in what sequence — data that exists only in the context of a specific bundle-offering membership. Each record defines one offering's role within one bundle, supporting catalog governance, bundle pricing calculation, fulfillment orchestration, and versioned bundle lifecycle management.. Existence Justification: In waste management product catalog operations, a service bundle is explicitly defined as a packaged combination of multiple individual service offerings (e.g., residential collection + recycling cart + yard waste pickup). A single bundle contains many offerings, and a single offering (e.g., curbside recycling) can appear in multiple bundles (e.g., Residential Basic Pack, Residential Complete Care Pack, Commercial Eco Bundle). This is a textbook product composition M:N — the business actively creates, manages, and prices these bundle-offering memberships as part of catalog governance.

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the parent service bundle that contains this offering component.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the service offering that is a component of the bundle.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this offering was removed from the bundle composition. Null if the offering is currently active within the bundle. Enables historical bundle composition queries.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this offering was added to the bundle composition. Supports versioned bundle definitions where components change over time without invalidating historical contracts.

attributes.name: is_primary_offering_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offering is the anchor or lead service within the bundle (e.g., the core collection service in a residential bundle). Used for fulfillment prioritization and marketing display.

attributes.name: pricing_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount this offering contributes to the bundle's total price. Distinct from the offering's standalone base_price_amount and the bundle's aggregate base_price. Enables bundle pricing decomposition and margin analysis.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of this offering included in the bundle (e.g., 2 recycling carts, 1 curbside pickup). Supports bundles where the same offering appears at different quantities.

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this offering within the bundle for display, fulfillment sequencing, and contract line ordering. Lower values appear first.

products.name: compliance_inspection
products.description: Records of regulatory inspections and internal compliance audits conducted at Waste Management facilities and operations. Covers EPA/state agency inspections, OSHA workplace safety inspections, DOT vehicle and driver inspections, LEA solid waste inspections, and internal EHS audits. Tracks inspection ID, inspection type, inspecting authority or internal auditor, facility/site inspected, scheduled and actual inspection date, inspection scope, overall result (pass/fail/conditional), number of findings, and follow-up due date. Sourced from Enviance EHS. Central operational record for all compliance verification activities.

Each finding is linked to a parent inspection record and captures the finding type (violation, observation, recommendation), regulatory citation violated, description of the deficiency, severity classification, responsible facility area, and whether a corrective action has been initiated. Enables granular tracking of inspection outcomes and drives the corrective action workflow. Child entity of inspection.

products.name: regulated_facility

products.name: facility_regulatory_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the formal Applicability Determination between a regulated_facility and a regulatory_requirement. It captures the documented compliance determination that a specific regulatory requirement applies (or is exempt) to a specific facility, including the determination date, current compliance status, exemption basis, review schedule, and responsible compliance officer. Each record links one regulated_facility to one regulatory_requirement and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this facility-requirement pairing. Managed in Enviance EHS as a core compliance business object used for regulatory defense, audit response, and compliance program management.. Existence Justification: In environmental compliance management, determining which regulatory requirements apply to which facilities is a formal, documented business process called 'applicability determination.' A single regulated facility (e.g., a RCRA TSDF landfill) is subject to dozens of simultaneous regulatory requirements (RCRA, CAA Title V, CWA NPDES, OSHA 1910, DOT 49 CFR, state solid waste codes), and a single regulatory requirement (e.g., 40 CFR 258 Subpart D) applies to hundreds of facilities across Waste Management's portfolio. This relationship is actively managed in Enviance EHS as a distinct business object — compliance officers create, update, and close applicability determinations with their own lifecycle data including determination dates, compliance status, exemption flags, and responsible officers.
