attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Time-Dependent Data

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fixed asset including make, model, capacity, and distinguishing characteristics. Used for identification and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Asset Master

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the asset. Used across SAP FI-AA, Infor EAM, and operational systems for asset tracking and reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Asset Master

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity value. Must align with industry standards and operational reporting requirements.

attributes.name: capacity_value
attributes.description: Rated capacity or size of the asset in appropriate units. Examples: cubic yards for containers, tons per day for processing equipment, square feet for buildings.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was placed in service and capitalized on the balance sheet. Marks the start of depreciation calculations per GAAP/IFRS standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Depreciation Start Date

attributes.name: cid
attributes.description: Container Identification number used for tracking dumpsters, roll-offs, and carts. Unique identifier printed on container and linked to RFID tags for automated tracking.

attributes.name: condition_rating
attributes.description: Current physical condition assessment of the asset based on inspection and maintenance history. Used for replacement planning and risk assessment.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center to which the asset is assigned. Used for depreciation expense allocation and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Cost Center Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Change Documents

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the asset after accumulated depreciation. Calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Updated with each depreciation run.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Asset Values

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense. Must comply with GAAP/IFRS standards and IRS regulations for tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Depreciation Key Configuration

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was retired, sold, scrapped, or otherwise disposed of. Marks the end of the assets lifecycle and triggers final accounting entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Retirement Transactions

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was disposed of. Used for accounting treatment, tax reporting, and asset lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Retirement Types

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Retirement Transactions

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset requires environmental compliance monitoring per EPA, RCRA, or state regulations. Used for regulatory reporting and inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA)

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the assets current or primary location. Used for asset tracking, route optimization, and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the assets current or primary location. Used for asset tracking, route optimization, and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the asset. Used for risk management, claims processing, and insurance compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection or condition assessment of the asset. Used for compliance tracking and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset master record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Change Documents

attributes.name: lease_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number for leased assets. Links to lease agreement master data for payment tracking and lease accounting compliance.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed physical location description of where the asset is deployed or stored. Examples: customer site address, facility name, yard location, route assignment.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured or produced the asset. Used for warranty claims, parts sourcing, and vendor management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Vendor Data

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for the asset. Used for parts compatibility, maintenance procedures, and specifications lookup.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection or condition assessment. Used for preventive maintenance planning and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership status of the asset. Determines accounting treatment, balance sheet classification, and lease accounting compliance per ASC 842 or IFRS 16.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in depreciation calculations to determine depreciable base.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Depreciation Parameters

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for the asset. Used for warranty tracking, parts ordering, and equipment identification.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation purposes. Determined by asset class and regulatory guidelines per IRS Publication 946 or IFRS standards.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage expires. Used for maintenance cost planning and warranty claim eligibility.

products.name: class
products.description: Reference classification hierarchy for fixed assets aligned with SAP asset class configuration and GAAP/IFRS capitalization policies. Defines asset categories such as containers, compactors, balers, weighing scales, landfill infrastructure, MRF equipment, WTE plant equipment, transfer station equipment, and buildings. Each class carries depreciation method defaults, useful life ranges, capitalization thresholds, GL account assignments, and RCRA/EPA reporting flags. Enables consistent depreciation calculation and regulatory asset reporting across all Waste Management facilities.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Class / GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset class. Primary key for the asset class reference hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Asset Class Master

attributes.name: parent_asset_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent asset class in the classification hierarchy, enabling multi-level asset categorization (e.g., Containers > Roll-Off Containers > 20-Yard Roll-Offs).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Asset classes in waste management are governed by specific regulations (all underground storage tanks subject to RCRA Subtitle I, all roll-off containers subject to DOT 49 CFR). class has rcra_regulat

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the asset class aligned with Waste Management operational divisions. Containers include dumpsters, roll-offs, carts; stationary equipment includes compactors, balers, scales; infrastructure includes landfill cells, liners, caps, leachate systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: container|stationary_equipment|landfill_infrastructure|mrf_equipment|wte_equipment|transfer_station_equipment|building|land|vehicle_attachment|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Waste Management Asset Taxonomy, SAP FI-AA Asset Class Grouping

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the asset class used in SAP and financial reporting. Typically a 4-12 character alphanumeric code aligned with chart of accounts structure.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class Configuration, GAAP Fixed Asset Classification

attributes.name: asset_class_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset class including scope, typical assets included, and business purpose.

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the asset class (e.g., Roll-Off Containers, Front-End Loaders, Compactors, Landfill Infrastructure, MRF Equipment).

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Specific type within the asset category providing granular classification (e.g., Front-End Loader, Rear-End Loader, Automated Side Loader, Stationary Compactor, Baler, Weighbridge, Landfill Cell, MRF Sorting Line).
attributes.references: Waste Management Asset Master Data Standards

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum acquisition cost required for an asset in this class to be capitalized rather than expensed, aligned with GAAP/IFRS policies and company materiality thresholds.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment, IFRS IAS 16, SAP FI-AA Capitalization Policy

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the capitalization threshold amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset class in the master data system. Active classes are available for new asset creation; deprecated classes are retained for historical assets only.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class Master Data Governance

attributes.name: cost_center_default
attributes.description: Default cost center code for assets in this class, used for management accounting and operational expense allocation in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting, Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business criticality classification for assets in this class based on operational impact of failure. Critical assets require immediate response; low criticality assets can tolerate longer downtime.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Infor EAM Criticality Analysis

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Default depreciation calculation method for assets in this class. Straight-line is most common for buildings and infrastructure; units of production may apply to equipment with measurable usage (e.g., compactors by cycle count).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, IFRS IAS 16, SAP FI-AA Depreciation Key Configuration

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this asset class configuration is no longer valid for new asset creation. Null for currently active configurations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this asset class configuration becomes effective for new asset creation and depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_tracked
attributes.description: Indicates whether energy consumption (electricity, natural gas, diesel) is tracked at the asset class level for sustainability reporting and cost allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 50001 Energy Management, GHG Protocol Scope 1 and 2 Emissions

attributes.name: environmental_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of potential environmental impact from failure or improper operation of assets in this class. High for landfill liners and leachate systems; medium for compactors and balers; low for administrative assets.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EPA Risk Assessment Framework

attributes.name: epa_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Reporting Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class must be included in EPA regulatory reporting (e.g., landfill gas collection systems, leachate treatment equipment, air emission control devices).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 258 Landfill Criteria, Clean Air Act Reporting

attributes.name: ghg_emission_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are direct sources of greenhouse gas emissions requiring monitoring and reporting (e.g., landfill gas collection systems, WTE combustion equipment, stationary engines).
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98, Clean Air Act Title V

attributes.name: gl_accumulated_depreciation_account
attributes.description: General Ledger contra-asset account number for accumulated depreciation of assets in this class. Maps to SAP FI chart of accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Balance Sheet Classification, SAP FI-AA Account Determination

attributes.name: gl_asset_account
attributes.description: General Ledger account number for capitalizing assets in this class on the balance sheet. Maps to SAP FI chart of accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Balance Sheet Classification, SAP FI-AA Account Determination

attributes.name: gl_depreciation_account
attributes.description: General Ledger account number for recording depreciation expense for assets in this class. Maps to SAP FI chart of accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Income Statement Classification, SAP FI-AA Account Determination

attributes.name: gl_gain_loss_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Gain/Loss on Disposal Account
attributes.description: General Ledger account number for recording gains or losses on disposal or retirement of assets in this class.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360-10-40, SAP FI-AA Retirement Account Determination

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard interval in days between required inspections for assets in this class. Null if periodic inspection is not required.
attributes.references: OSHA Inspection Requirements, EPA Facility Inspection Schedules

attributes.name: insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class must carry specific insurance coverage beyond general property insurance (e.g., environmental liability insurance for landfill cells, equipment breakdown insurance for WTE plants).
attributes.references: Corporate Risk Management Policy, CERCLA Financial Assurance Requirements

attributes.name: insurance_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage required for assets in this class (e.g., Environmental Liability, Equipment Breakdown, Pollution Legal Liability, Property and Casualty). Null if no specific insurance required.
attributes.references: Corporate Insurance Policy, EPA Financial Assurance Mechanisms

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: Default maintenance approach for assets in this class. Preventive for scheduled maintenance; predictive for sensor-monitored equipment; reactive for low-criticality items; condition-based for inspection-driven maintenance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Maintenance Strategy Configuration, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: manufacturer_warranty_months
attributes.description: Typical manufacturer warranty period in months for new assets in this class. Used for warranty tracking and maintenance planning during warranty period.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this asset class record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was last modified.

attributes.name: rcra_regulated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are subject to RCRA hazardous waste management regulations (e.g., hazardous waste storage containers, treatment equipment, TSDF infrastructure).
attributes.references: RCRA 40 CFR Parts 260-279, EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: requires_gps_tracking
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Global Positioning System (GPS) Tracking Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class require GPS tracking devices for location monitoring. May apply to mobile equipment and high-value portable assets.
attributes.references: Geotab Fleet Telematics Standards, Asset Location Tracking Policy

attributes.name: requires_periodic_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are subject to mandatory periodic safety or compliance inspections (e.g., pressure vessels, lifting equipment, hazardous waste storage units).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910, RCRA 40 CFR 264, State Environmental Quality Regulations

attributes.name: requires_rfid_tracking
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class must be equipped with RFID tags for automated tracking and inventory management. Typically true for containers (CID tracking), false for fixed infrastructure.
attributes.references: Waste Management Container Tracking Standards, AMCS Platform RFID Integration

attributes.name: salvage_value_percentage
attributes.description: Expected residual value as a percentage of original cost at end of useful life. Containers and equipment may have 5-15% salvage value; buildings typically higher; landfill cells near zero.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, IFRS IAS 16, SAP FI-AA Scrap Value Configuration

attributes.name: serialized_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual assets in this class must be tracked by unique serial number in addition to asset ID. True for high-value equipment and containers; false for bulk infrastructure.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master, Infor EAM Serial Number Tracking

attributes.name: useful_life_years_default
attributes.description: Standard useful life in years applied by default when creating new assets in this class, typically the midpoint or most common value within the min-max range.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class Defaults, Company Depreciation Policy

attributes.name: useful_life_years_max
attributes.description: Maximum expected useful life in years for assets in this class, providing a range for depreciation planning based on usage intensity and maintenance quality.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, IFRS IAS 16, IRS Publication 946 MACRS

attributes.name: useful_life_years_min
attributes.description: Minimum expected useful life in years for assets in this class, used for depreciation calculation and asset lifecycle planning.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360, IFRS IAS 16, IRS Publication 946 MACRS

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this asset class record.

products.name: asset_container
products.description: Master record for all waste containers deployed in the field, including front-load dumpsters, rear-load dumpsters, roll-off boxes, residential carts, and compactor units. Each container is identified by a unique CID (Container Identification) and optionally an RFID tag or GPS device. Tracks container type, size (cubic yards), material, color, lid type, ownership (owned/leased/customer-owned), deployment status, current service address, last inspection date, condition grade, tare weight, and AMCS container tracking reference. Distinct from fleet (rolling stock) — containers are stationary assets placed at customer sites.
products.reference: CID / RFID Container Master — AMCS Platform

attributes.name: asset_container_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the waste container. Primary key. This is the system-generated surrogate key that uniquely identifies each container record in the enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: approved_waste_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hazmat.waste_profile. Business justification: Containers must be approved for specific waste profiles based on material compatibility, DOT ratings, and waste characteristics. Links containers to approved waste profiles for safe deployment, regula

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Container types (front-load, rear-load, roll-off) should be classified within the asset class hierarchy for consistent depreciation rules, capitalization thresholds, and GL account mapping. Currently

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the customer account that is currently being serviced by this container. Links to customer.customer_account. Null if container is not currently assigned to a customer.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fixed_asset. Business justification: Container is a specialized type of fixed asset. Containers have acquisition_date, acquisition_cost, depreciation_method, useful_life_years, accumulated_depreciation, net_book_value, sap_asset_number,

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the collection route that services this container. Links to collection.route. Used for route optimization and service scheduling.

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the service address where this container is currently deployed. Links to customer.service_address. Null if container is not currently deployed (e.g., in inventory or maintenance).

attributes.name: service_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.vehicle. Business justification: Containers are serviced by specific vehicles on routes. While route_id exists, direct vehicle linkage enables container-to-vehicle assignment validation, RFID read reconciliation for billing disputes,

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accumulated Depreciation in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense recognized to date for this container asset in USD. Used to calculate net book value. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Container Acquisition Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The original purchase price or capitalized cost of the container in USD. Used for depreciation calculations, asset valuation, and financial reporting. Confidential business financial data.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date the container was acquired by Waste Management, either through purchase or lease inception. Used for depreciation calculations and asset lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: amcs_container_reference
attributes.description: The external identifier for this container in the AMCS Platform system. Used for integration and cross-system reconciliation between the enterprise data warehouse and the operational AMCS system.

attributes.name: capacity_cubic_yards
attributes.description: The volumetric capacity of the container measured in cubic yards. Standard sizes include 2, 4, 6, 8 cubic yards for front/rear-load dumpsters; 10, 20, 30, 40 cubic yards for roll-off boxes; and 32, 64, 96 gallons (converted to cubic yards) for residential carts. This is the principal quantitative measurement for the container resource.
attributes.references: ASTM D5033 Standard for Container Volume Measurement

attributes.name: cid
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for the container, typically an alphanumeric code printed on the container and used by field operations, customer service, and AMCS Platform for tracking. This is the operational identifier used in day-to-day business processes.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: The exterior color of the container, often used to designate waste stream type (e.g., blue for recycling, green for organics, black for MSW). Color coding helps drivers and customers identify the correct container for each waste stream. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: green|blue|black|gray|brown|yellow|red — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Municipal Solid Waste Color Coding Best Practices

attributes.name: compaction_ratio
attributes.description: The volume reduction ratio achieved by compactor units. For example, a ratio of 4.0 means the compactor reduces waste volume by 4:1. Only applicable to compactor_unit container types. Used to calculate effective capacity and optimize service frequency.

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the container based on inspection findings. Excellent means like-new; good means minor wear; fair means functional with visible wear; poor means needs repair soon; critical means unsafe or non-functional.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Condition Assessment Standard

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Classification of the container by its operational design and collection method. Front-load dumpsters are serviced by Front End Loader (FEL) trucks, rear-load by Rear End Loader (REL) trucks, roll-offs by specialized roll-off trucks, residential carts by Automated Side Loader (ASL) trucks, and compactor units are stationary compression equipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this container record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Immutable after initial creation.

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: The date this container was most recently deployed to a customer service address. Used to track deployment history and calculate time-in-service metrics.

attributes.name: gps_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the GPS tracking device installed on high-value containers (typically roll-offs and compactors) for real-time location monitoring via Geotab Fleet Telematics or similar systems.

attributes.name: infor_eam_asset_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Infor Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Asset Identifier
attributes.description: The asset identifier for this container in the Infor EAM system. Used for maintenance work order management, preventive maintenance scheduling, and parts inventory tracking.

attributes.name: is_gps_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this container is equipped with an active GPS tracking device. True means GPS device is installed and transmitting; false means no GPS tracking.

attributes.name: is_rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this container is equipped with an active RFID tag for automated scanning. True means RFID tag is attached and functional; false means no RFID capability.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent physical inspection of the container. Regular inspections are required for safety, compliance, and preventive maintenance. Inspection frequency varies by container type and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: lid_type
attributes.description: The type of lid or cover on the container. Lids help control odor, prevent unauthorized dumping, and keep out rain. Locking lids provide security for customer-specific waste. Some roll-offs have no lids.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: The name of the company that manufactured the container. Used for warranty tracking, parts sourcing, and quality analysis.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Manufacturer Field

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The primary construction material of the container body. Steel is common for commercial dumpsters and roll-offs; plastic (high-density polyethylene) for residential carts; fiberglass for specialized applications; aluminum for lightweight applications.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's model or part number for this container design. Used for parts compatibility, warranty claims, and standardization.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Model Field

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Book Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The current book value of the container calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation in USD. Used for financial reporting and asset valuation. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next required inspection of the container. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or observations about the container. May include placement instructions, access restrictions, damage reports, or customer-specific requirements.
attributes.references: Waste Logics Container Management Notes Field

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is owned by Waste Management, leased from a third party, or owned by the customer. Owned containers are capitalized assets; leased containers have associated lease obligations; customer-owned containers are tracked for service purposes but not capitalized.

attributes.name: retrieval_date
attributes.description: The date this container was retrieved from a customer service address and returned to inventory or maintenance. Null if container is currently deployed.

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: The RFID tag identifier embedded in or attached to the container for automated tracking and scanning during collection operations. Used by AMCS Platform and collection vehicles equipped with RFID readers.

attributes.name: sap_asset_number
attributes.description: The asset number assigned to this container in the SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets (FI-AA) module. Used for financial asset tracking, depreciation runs, and general ledger integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master Data

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's unique serial number for this specific container unit. Used for warranty tracking, recall management, and asset verification.

attributes.name: service_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which this container is serviced (emptied). Daily is common for high-volume commercial accounts; weekly/biweekly for residential; on-demand for roll-offs.

attributes.name: tare_weight_lbs
attributes.description: The empty weight of the container in pounds. Used to calculate net waste weight by subtracting tare weight from gross weight measured at scales. Critical for accurate tonnage reporting and billing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this container record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization. Updated automatically on any record modification.

attributes.name: waste_stream_type
attributes.description: The type of waste this container is designated to hold. MSW is Municipal Solid Waste (general trash); recycling for recyclable materials; organics for compostable waste; C&D for Construction and Demolition debris; hazardous for RCRA-regulated waste; universal waste for batteries, electronics, etc.
attributes.references: EPA Waste Classification System, RCRA Subtitle C and D

products.name: facility
products.description: Master record for all Waste Management fixed facilities including landfill sites, MRF (Materials Recovery Facility) plants, WTE (Waste-to-Energy) plants, transfer stations, hazardous waste TSDFs (Treatment Storage and Disposal Facilities), maintenance shops, and administrative offices. Tracks facility name, type, physical address, GPS coordinates, permitted capacity (TPD), operating hours, regulatory permit numbers (air, water, solid waste), LEA (Local Enforcement Agency) jurisdiction, SWIS number, EPA facility ID, operational status, and owning business unit. Serves as the geographic and operational anchor for all site-level asset and compliance data.
products.reference: EPA Facility Registry / SAP Plant Master

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the facility. Primary key.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Facilities (landfills, MRFs, transfer stations, WTE plants) are fixed assets and should be classified in the asset class hierarchy. Facility types have distinct depreciation rules, capitalization thre

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility was acquired, purchased, or brought into service by Waste Management.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the facility (street number and name).

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, building, unit) if applicable.

attributes.name: air_permit_number
attributes.description: Permit number issued under the Clean Air Act (CAA) for facilities with air emissions (e.g., landfills with LFG flares, WTE plants).
attributes.references: Clean Air Act (CAA) Title V Permit Program

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the facility is located.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility became fully operational and began accepting waste or providing services.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the facility is located (USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility was permanently closed and decommissioned. Null for active facilities.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for facility correspondence and notifications.

attributes.name: epa_facility_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the U.S. EPA for tracking environmental compliance and reporting (e.g., FRS Registry ID).

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used for internal identification and reporting (e.g., 'LF-001', 'MRF-023').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module - Functional Location

attributes.name: facility_name

products.name: valuation
products.description: Stores point-in-time valuation snapshots for fixed assets beyond standard depreciation, including insurance appraisals, fair market value assessments, impairment testing results, and replacement cost estimates. Captures valuation date, valuation type (insurance, impairment, fair value, replacement cost), appraised value, valuation methodology, appraiser reference, and whether an impairment write-down was triggered. Supports GAAP ASC 360 impairment testing, insurance renewal negotiations, and capital planning for asset replacement programs.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being valued (container, facility, equipment, building, etc.).

attributes.description: Name of the external appraisal firm or internal department that conducted the valuation.

attributes.description: Name of the individual or firm that performed the valuation (internal valuation team member or external certified appraiser).

attributes.description: The date on which the valuation was formally approved for use in financial reporting or insurance negotiations.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved the valuation (e.g., CFO, Controller, Asset Manager).

attributes.name: carrying_amount
attributes.description: The book value (net book value after accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the valuation date, used for impairment comparison.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the appraised value (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: physical_condition_rating
attributes.description: Appraiser assessment of the physical condition of the asset at the valuation date: excellent (like new), good (minor wear), fair (moderate wear), poor (significant deterioration), critical (near end of life).

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business purpose for this valuation (e.g., annual insurance renewal, quarterly impairment testing, pre-disposal assessment, merger and acquisition due diligence).

attributes.name: replacement_cost_new
attributes.description: The estimated cost to replace the asset with a new equivalent asset at current market prices, used for insurance and capital planning.

attributes.name: report_reference

attributes.name: salvage_value

attributes.name: useful_life_remaining_years

attributes.name: valuation_date

attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: valuation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the valuation event, often assigned by appraiser or internal valuation team.

attributes.name: valuation_status

attributes.name: valuation_type

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) for complex fixed assets and stationary equipment, defining the component parts and sub-assemblies that make up each asset. Tracks parent asset, component part number, component description, quantity, unit of measure, manufacturer part number, criticality rating, lead time for replacement, and whether the component is a consumable or capital spare. Sourced from Infor EAM BOM management and SAP PM equipment BOM. Enables preventive maintenance planning, spare parts inventory management, and total cost of ownership analysis for compactors, balers, WTE boilers, and MRF sorting equipment.

attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the component within the BOM structure. Level 0 is the parent asset; level 1 is a direct child assembly; level 2 is a sub-assembly of level 1, etc. Supports multi-level BOM explosion.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM line item: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), obsolete (superseded by newer component), or pending approval (engineering change pending).

attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the component part, including specifications, model information, and functional purpose within the parent asset.

attributes.description: Business criticality of the component to asset operation. Critical components cause immediate downtime if failed; low criticality components have minimal operational impact. Drives spare parts stocking strategy.

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of alternative or equivalent part numbers that can substitute for this component. Supports flexible sourcing and reduces downtime when primary part is unavailable.

attributes.name: is_consumable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is a consumable item (regularly replaced during preventive maintenance, such as filters, belts, fluids) versus a durable part. Consumables are expensed immediately.

attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified this BOM record. Tracks engineering change ownership.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last updated in the source system. Tracks engineering changes and BOM revisions.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days required to procure and receive the component from the supplier. Used for preventive maintenance planning and spare parts inventory optimization.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or supplier of the component part.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number for the component. Used for sourcing genuine replacement parts and warranty claims.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures_hours
attributes.description: Average operating hours between failures for this component, based on historical maintenance data. Used for predictive maintenance scheduling and reliability analysis.

attributes.name: unit_cost
